units.la: Per te accessum habeamus ad filium, ô benedicta inventrix gratia, genetrix vita, mater salutis, ut per te nos suscipiat, qui per te datus est nobis. Post quæ apud Bernhardum ista quoque sequuntur: Excuset apud ipsum integritas tua culpam nostra corruptionis: & humilitas Deo grata nostra veniam impetret vanitati: copiosa charitas tua nostrorum cooperiat multitudinem peccatorum, & fæcunditas gloriosa fæcunditatem nobis conferat meritorum. Domina nostra, mediatrix nostra, advocata nostra, tuo filio nos reconcilia, tuo filio nos commenda, tuo filio nos repræsenta. Fac ô benedicta per gratiam, quam invenisti, per prærogativam, quam meruisti per misericordiam, quam peperisti, ut, qui te mediante fieri dignatus est particeps infirmitatis & miseriæ nostræ, te quoque intercedente parti-
units.tr: Through you let us have access to the Son, O blessed finder of grace, bearer of life, mother of salvation, so that through you he may receive us, who through you was given to us. After which the following words also come in Bernard: Let your integrity excuse our fault before him, and let your humility, pleasing to God, obtain pardon for our vanity; let your abundant charity cover the multitude of our sins, and let your glorious fruitfulness bring us the fruitfulness of merits. Our Lady, our mediatrix, our advocate, reconcile us to your Son, commend us to your Son, present us to your Son. Do this, O blessed one, through the grace that you found, through the prerogative that you merited, through the mercy that you bore, so that he who through you deigned to become a partaker of our weakness and misery may, by your intercession also, make us partakers of his glory and blessedness:

units.la: cipâ sipes faciat nos gloria & beatitudinis sua, Jesus Christus filius tuus, Dominus noster, qui est super omnia Deus benedictus in secula.
units.tr: Jesus Christ, your Son, our Lord, who is God over all, blessed for ever.

units.la: Sed invaluerat jam Bernhardi tempore superstitio, nimium tribuens Mariae & caeteris Sanctis mortuis: & ut caeterae stipulae in Bernhardi scriptis, sic iste quoque error de invocatione Mariae, infelicitati temporum tribuendus est. Neque tamen vel propter authoritatem Bernhardi, aut ullius alterius hominis, vel propter longitemporis consuetudinem, errores ulli, contra verbi Dei authoritatem approbandi sunt. etsi nec orthodoxorum scriptorum veterum perspicua testimonia desunt, quibus error pe cultu Mariae gravissime refutatus est. Ex quibus satis nobis sit, pauca quaedam dicta Epiphanii recitare, quibus efficacissime jugulatur tota haec de Mariae cultu superstitio & idololatria.
units.tr: But superstition had already grown strong in Bernard's time, attributing too much to Mary and to the other dead saints; and, like the other chaff in Bernard's writings, this error about the invocation of Mary must be ascribed to the unhappy condition of the times. Yet errors are not to be approved against the authority of the Word of God, either on account of Bernard's authority or that of any other man, or on account of long custom; and yet clear testimonies of the orthodox ancient writers are not lacking, by which the error concerning the worship of Mary has been most severely refuted. From these it is enough for us to recite a few sayings of Epiphanius, by which this whole superstition and idolatry about the worship of Mary is most effectively throttled.

units.la: RECENSE VERBA IPSIUS Epiphanii.
units.tr: THE WORDS OF EPIPHANIUS HIMSELF, RECITED

units.la: In haeresi Antidicomarianitarum sic scribit: Admirati sumus, cum audivimus aliquos ita delirare, ut in tractatione de Sancta semper virgine, pro Deo hanc introducere studuerint, & adhuc studeant, & furore quodam & amentia ducantur. Narrant enim, quod quaedam mulieres in Arabia, a partibus Thraces, hanc G vani-
units.tr: In the heresy of the Antidicomarianites he writes thus: We were amazed when we heard that some people are raving so much that, in treating of the holy ever-virgin, they have sought to introduce her as God, and still seek to do so, and are driven by a certain frenzy and madness. For they relate that certain women in Arabia, from the parts of Thrace, have brought in this vani-

units.la: G vanitatem invexerunt, ut in nomen semper-virginis collyriden quandam sacrificent, & simul congregentur, & in nomen Sanctæ virginis ultra modum quid tentent aggredi, nefario ac blasphemo negotio, & in nomen ipsius sacra celebrent per mulieres. Quod totum impium est ac nefarium, alienum à prædicatione Spiritus Sancti, ut sit totum diabolicum opus, & spiritus immundi doctrina. Impletur enim & in his hoc: Deficient quidam à sana doctrina attendentes fabulis & doctrinis dæmoniorum. Erunt enim, inquit, mortuis cultum divinum præstantes, quemadmodum etiam in Israel co-luerunt. Et sanctorum juxta tempus in Deum gloria, facta est aliis non videntibus veritatem, in errorem.
units.tr: vanity, that they offer a certain cake in the name of the ever-virgin, and gather together, and attempt beyond measure something in the name of the holy virgin, in a wicked and blasphemous business, and celebrate sacred rites in her name through women. All of this is impious and wicked, foreign to the preaching of the Holy Spirit, so that the whole thing is a diabolical work and a doctrine of the unclean spirit. For this is fulfilled in them too: some will fall away from sound doctrine, attending to fables and doctrines of demons. For, he says, they will render divine worship to the dead, just as they also did in Israel. And the glory of the saints toward God, according to the time, has become an error for others who do not see the truth.

units.la: Et paulò post: Non convenit colere sanctos ultra decorum, sed honorare ipsorum Dominum. Cesset itaque error seductorum: Neque enim Deus est Maria, neque de cælo corpus habet, sed ex conceptione viri & mulieris, secundum promissionem vero velut Isaac disposita. Et nemo in nomen hujus offerat: suam enim animam perdet. Neque rursus debacchetur contumelia afficiens sanctam virginem. Absit enim: Non fuit copulata carni post partum, neque ante partum Salvatoris.
units.tr: And a little after: It is not fitting to honour the saints beyond what is seemly, but to honour their Lord. Let the error of the deceivers therefore cease: for Mary is not God, nor does she have a body from heaven, but was conceived of a man and a woman, and was set apart according to the promise, as Isaac was. And let no one offer anything in her name: for he will lose his soul. Nor again let him rage with insult against the holy virgin. Far be it: she was not joined to flesh after childbirth, nor before the birth of the Saviour.

units.la: Rursus, contra Collyridianos, Mariæ offerentes: Revera sanctum erat corpus Mariæ, non tamen Deus. Revera virgo erat ipsa virgo virgo & honorata, sed non ad adorationem nobis data, sed ipsa adoranseum, qui ex ipsa genitus est carne, de cælis verò ex sinibus paternis accessit. Et mox: Quae scriptura narravit? Quis Prophetarum praecepit, homines adorari, nedum mulierem? Eximium equidem est vas, sed mulier, & nihil à natura immutata. Verum & intellectu & sensu in honore honorata, velut corpora sanctorum, & si quid amplius ad glorificationem dixerim: sicut Helias ex matre virgo, & sic manens in perpetuum, & translatus, & mortem non conspicatus: sicut Johannes, qui super pectus Domini recubuit, quem diligebat Iesus: sic Thecla sancta, & Maria adhuc honoratior hac est, propter dispensationem mysterii, quâ digna facta est: Sed neque Helias adorandus est, etiamsi in vivis sit: neque Johannes adorandus, quanquam per preces suas proprias dormitionem suam admirandam effecerit, imò potius ex Deo gratiam acceperit. Sed neque Thecla, neque quisquam Sanctorum adorandus. Non enim dominabitur nobis antiquus error, ut relinquamus viventem, & adoremus ea quae ab ipso facta sunt. Coluerunt enim & adorarunt creaturam prater creatorem, & stulti facti sunt, &c.
units.tr: Again, against the Collyridians who offer to Mary: Truly the body of Mary was holy, yet not God. Truly she was a virgin, a virgin and honoured, but she was not given to us for adoration; rather she herself adores him who was born of her flesh, and who came down from the heavens out of the bosom of the Father. And soon after: What Scripture has related this? Which of the Prophets commanded men to be adored, let alone a woman? She is indeed an excellent vessel, but a woman, and nothing changed from nature. Yet she is honoured in understanding and sense, like the bodies of the saints; and if I may say something more by way of glorification: like Elijah, a virgin from his mother, who remained so forever, and was taken up, and did not see death; like John, who lay on the breast of the Lord, whom Jesus loved; so too holy Thecla. And Mary is more honoured than these, because of the dispensation of the mystery for which she was made worthy. But neither is Elijah to be adored, even though he is alive; nor John to be adored, though by his own prayers he brought about his wondrous sleep, and rather received grace from God. Neither Thecla nor any of the saints is to be adored. For the ancient error shall not rule over us, so that we leave the living God and adore the things he has made. For they worshipped and adored the creature rather than the Creator, and became foolish, etc.

units.la: Et rursus: Sit in honore Maria. Pater, Filius, & spiritus sanctus adoretur. Mariam nemo nemo adoret, non dico mulierem, imo neque vi‑rum. Deo debetur hoc mysterium, neque Angeli capiunt talem gloriationem.
units.tr: And again: Let Mary be held in honour. Let the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit be adored. Let no one adore Mary; I do not say a woman, but not even a man. This mystery is owed to God, and the angels do not claim such glory.

units.la: Epitafis teterrimæ idololatriæ, quæ in cultu Mariæ sub Papatu invaluit.
units.tr: Epitaph of the most foul idolatry which prevailed under the Papacy in the worship of Mary.

units.la: Hæc cum tanto zelo scripserit Epiphanius contra prima illa femina cultus Mariæ, quid facturum existimamus, si audivisset illa magis enormia: ut quòd ex Pontificiis aliqui asseruerunt, ut est apud Gabrielem Biel (uper Canonem: Patrem cœlestem dimisi‑dium sui regni dedisse beatissima virgini, cœlorum regina: idque in Hester significatum, cui Assuerus promisit, si petenti dimidium regni daturum. Atque hoc in Maria completum esse, in quam Deus regni sui, quod judicio & misericordia constat, dimidium, hoc est, misericordiam transtulerit, altera regni parte sibi retenta.
units.tr: Since Epiphanius wrote with such zeal against those first women who worshipped Mary, what do we think he would have done had he heard of things more outrageous: such as some of the Papists have asserted, as is found in Gabriel Biel (on the Canon): The heavenly Father gave half of his kingdom to the most blessed Virgin, queen of heaven. This was signified in Esther, to whom Ahasuerus promised to give half of his kingdom if she asked it. And this has been fulfilled in Mary, to whom God transferred the half of his kingdom, which consists of judgement and mercy, that is, mercy, keeping the other part of the kingdom for himself.

units.la: Sed & ante Gabrielem Biel passim apud Pontificios tituli illi attributi sunt Mariæ virgini: Regina cœli, regina & mater misericordiæ, vita nostra, spes Ecclesia, advocata & mediatrix. Quorum titulorum mentio est in cantico illo adhuc hodie de Maria celebri apud Pontificios: Salve Regina misericordiæ, vita dulcedo & spes nostra, salve: ad te clamamus exules filii Evæ. Ad te suspiramus gementes & flentes. flentes in hac lachrymarum valle. Ea ergo advocata nostra illos tuos misericordes oculos ad nos converte: Et Iesum benedictum fructum ventris tui nobis post hoc exilium ostende, o clemens, o pia, o dulcis Maria. In omni tribulatione & angustia nostra succurre nobis piissima virgo Maria.
units.tr: But even before Gabriel Biel, those titles were attributed to the Virgin Mary throughout the Papists: Queen of heaven, queen and mother of mercy, our life, the hope of the Church, advocate and mediatrix. Mention of these titles is found in that canticle about Mary, still celebrated today among the Papists: Hail, Queen of mercy, our life, sweetness and hope, hail! To you we cry, exiled sons of Eve. To you we sigh, groaning and weeping in this valley of tears. Turn then, our advocate, those merciful eyes of yours upon us; and after this exile show us Jesus, the blessed fruit of your womb, O clement, O pious, O sweet Mary. In every tribulation and distress of ours, come to our aid, most pious Virgin Mary.

units.la: Item in orationibus Anshelmi, quas de quinq; doloribus Mariæ compositit.
units.tr: Likewise in the prayers of Anselm, which he composed on the five sorrows of Mary.

units.la: I. Mediatrix Dei & hominum, & fons misericordiæ, indesinenter effundens rivos copiosæ gratiæ Maria, &c.
units.tr: I. Mary, mediatrix of God and men, and fount of mercy, pouring out without ceasing streams of abundant grace, etc.

units.la: II. Auxiliatrix Dei & hominum: & pacis æterna condimentum Maria, &c.
units.tr: II. Helper of God and men, and Mary, the everlasting seasoning of peace, etc.

units.la: III. Reparatrix debilium, & vulnerata animæ efficacissima medicina Maria &c.
units.tr: III. Restorer of the weak, and most effective medicine of the wounded soul, Mary, etc.

units.la: IV. Illuminatrix excorum, et lucerna salutiferæ gratiæ Maria, &c.
units.tr: IV. Enlightener of the blind, and lamp of saving grace, Mary, etc.

units.la: V. Advocatrix omnium peccatorum, quos damnabiliter moles vitiorum depulit, finisque nostra miseria Maria. Omitto, quòd eò quoque in Papatu perventum est, ut etiam Christus jam in cœlo regnans matri subjiceretur, quemadmodum adhuc in nonnullis Ecclesiis Pontificiis canitur: O felix Puerpera, Nostra pians scelera, Iure matris impera Redemptori. Quid? quòd totum Psalterium sublato u-biq; Domini nomine, in nomen Domina commutatum legitur? Talia Psalteria antequam fabricare coeperunt Pontificii: in usu habuerunt Rosaria Mariæ virginis, quæ narrant Dominicum primò invenisse, videlicet, ut quinquaginta salutationes angelicæ recitarentur, & singulis X. salutationibus, una oratio dominica interponeretur: hoc est, ut ipsi loquuntur, quinquaginta Ave Maria, & quinque Pater noster, facerent unum Rosarium. In quem usum narratur Dominicus fabricasse lapillos quinquaginta quinque, ita in motem ferti conjunctos, ut inter singulos decem minores, unus grandior interponeretur.
units.tr: V. Advocate of all sinners whom the burden of vices has damnably cast down, and the end of our misery, Mary. I pass over the fact that in the Papacy they have gone so far that even Christ, already reigning in heaven, is made subject to his mother, as is still sung in some Papist churches: O happy Mother, atoning for our crimes, by a mother's right command the Redeemer. What of the fact that the whole Psalterium, with the Domini nomine removed everywhere, is read changed into the name Domina? Before the Papists began to fabricate such Psalters, they used the Rosaria of the Virgin Mary, which they say Dominic first devised, namely that fifty angelic salutations should be recited, and after every ten salutations one Lord's Prayer be interposed: that is, as they themselves put it, fifty Ave Maria and five Pater noster made one Rosary. For this purpose, it is said, Dominic made fifty-five little stones, joined in a row in such a way that between each ten smaller ones one larger was placed.

units.la: Ex hujusmodi verò Rosariis Psalteria postea ejuscemodi fabricârunt, ut tria Rosaria, hoc est, centum & quinquaginta Ave Maria, & quindecim Pater noster, facerent unum Psalterium Mariæ: quia tot Psalmi Davidis essent, videlicet 150. quot salutationes in Mariæ honorem dicerentur.
units.tr: From such Rosaries, however, they afterwards fabricated Psalters of this kind: three Rosaries, that is, a hundred and fifty Ave Marias and fifteen Pater nosters, made one Psalter of Mary, because there were as many Psalms of David, namely 150, as salutations said in honour of Mary.

units.la: In his Psalteriis, alii singulis salutationibus etiam preculas peculiares ad Mariam interjecerunt: Donec tandem alii singulos Psalmos quoque, non sine summa Dei contumelia, ad Mariam accommodârunt. Exstitit etiam fraternitas peculiaris de Psalterio Mariæ, quam Sixtus IV, additis multis indulgentiis, gentiis,circa annum Domini 1470. confirmavit: Innocentius verò VIII.ad reliquas indulgentias addidit plenariam remissionem à poena & culpa, fraternitatem illam ingredientibus.
units.tr: In these Psalters some also inserted special little prayers addressed to Mary between the salutations; until at last others applied singulos Psalmos too to Mary, not without great contumely toward God. There also arose a special fraternitas peculiaris de Psalterio Mariæ, which Sixtus IV, adding many indulgences, confirmed around the year of the Lord 1470. Innocent VIII, however, added to the other indulgences a plenary remission of punishment and guilt for those who entered that fraternity.

units.la: Extat Psalterium hoc Mariæ, cum hac inscriptione: Psalterium beatæ virginis, compilatum per seraphicum doctorem, sanctum Bonaventuram, Episcopum Albanensem, nec non sanctæ Romanæ Ecclesiæ presbyterum Cardinalem. Sed falsò tribui Bonaventuræ hoc, existimari poterit, cùm longè aliter doceat super Magistrum sententiarum. Ubi ait:
units.tr: This Psalterium Mariæ exists, with this inscription: The Psalter of the blessed Virgin, compiled by the seraphic doctor, St Bonaventure, Bishop of Albano, and also presbyter and Cardinal of the holy Roman Church. But that this was falsely attributed to Bonaventure may be judged from the fact that he teaches quite otherwise in his commentary on the Master of the Sentences. There he says:

units.la: Etiamsi mater sit habenda in reverentia, multò major tamen est habenda erga filium, ex quo est, illi omnis honor & gloria, qui est omnium redemptor & Salvator, qui omnibus aperuit januam, & unus pro omnibus mortuus est. Idem: Cavendum est, ne, dum matris excellentia ampliatur, filii gloria minuatur, & sic in illo mater provocetur, in quo magis vult filium extolli & honorari, quàm seipsam, utpote creatorem creatura.
units.tr: Even if the mother is to be held in reverence, the son is to be held in much greater reverence, from whom she herself is, and to whom belongs all honour and glory, who is the redeemer and Saviour of all, who opened the door to all, and who alone died for all. Again: Care must be taken lest, while the mother's excellence is magnified, the son's glory be diminished, and thus the mother be offended in that very thing in which she herself would rather have the son exalted and honoured than herself, as creature to Creator.

units.la: Hæc Bonaventuræ verba non modò suspectum reddunt titulum illum Psalterii Mariæ, quasi autor ejus sit: sed etiam honores illos virginis blasphemos refutant, quibus non solùm æquatur, sed etiam antefertur filio. Quemadmodum etiam fit in cantico Prophetarum veteris & novi Testamenti. Item Symbolo Athanasii: & cantico Ambrosii atque Augustini, ad Mariam detortis, Itemque cum Litania peculiari Mariæ assignata & canticum de Spiritu Sancto translatum est ad Mariam in Concilio Constantiensi.
units.tr: These words of Bonaventure not only make that title of the Psalter of Mary suspect, as if he were its author, but also refute those blasphemous honours paid to the Virgin, by which she is not only made equal to her Son but even placed above him. The same is done in the canticles of the prophets of the Old and New Testaments, likewise in the Athanasian Creed, and in the canticles of Ambrose and Augustine, twisted to refer to Mary. Likewise, a peculiar litany has been assigned to Mary, and the canticle concerning the Holy Spirit was transferred to Mary at the Council of Constance.

units.la: Habeo gratiam pro opera, quam fideliter navâsti, dum hactenus, tum de Idololatria Pontificia in invocatione Sanctorum, tum etiam de Salutatione Angelica, quam Monachi in formam precum (impudenter dicam, an imprudenter, dubito) transmutare non erubuerunt, nervosè disseruisti. Restat, ut exempla quædam recites ex illis detorsionibus Psalmorum & Canticorum: ut qualis, & quàm cum summa Dei contumelia atq; injuria conjuncta fuerit invocatio Mariæ apud Pontificios, intelligi possit?
units.tr: I am grateful for the work you have faithfully carried out. Up to now you have argued vigorously both about Papist idolatry in the invocation of the saints and about the Angelic Salutation, which the monks have not been ashamed to turn into a form of prayer (I hesitate whether to say impudently or imprudently). It remains for you to recite some examples of those distortions of the Psalms and Canticles, so that it may be understood how, and how greatly, the invocation of Mary among the Papists is joined with the highest contumely and injury to God.

units.la: I.
units.tr: I.

units.la: Psalmo 1. sic dicitur: Beatus vir, qui diligit nomen tuum, virgo Maria, gratia tua animam illius confortabit, &c.
units.tr: Psalm 1 says this: "Blessed is the man who loves your name, Virgin Mary; by your grace he shall strengthen his soul," etc.

units.la: II.
units.tr: II.

units.la: Psalmo secundo. Quare fremuerunt inimici nostri, adversum nos meditati sunt insania? Protegat nos dextra tua, mater Dei, ut acies terribilis confundes ac destrues eos. Venite ad eam omnes, qui laboratis & tribulati estis: & refrigerium & solatium dabit animabus vestris. Accedite ad eam in tentationibus vestris, & stabiliet vos serenitas vultus illius. Benedicito illam in toto corde vestro. Misericordia enim illius plena est omnis terra.
units.tr: Psalm 2. "Why have our enemies raged, and devised madness against us? May your right hand protect us, Mother of God, so that you may confound and destroy them like a terrible army. Come to her, all you who labour and are burdened, and she will give refreshment and comfort to your souls. Approach her in your temptations, and the serenity of her countenance will steady you. Bless her with your whole heart, for her mercy fills the whole earth."

units.la: III.
units.tr: III.

units.la: Psalmo tertio. Domina, quid multiplicati sunt, qui tribulant me? in tempestate tua persequeris & dissipabis eos. Dissolve colligationes impietatis nostræ. Tolle fasciculos peccatorum nostrorum. Miserere mei Domina, & sana infirmitatem meam. Tolle dolorem & angustiam cordis mei. Ne tradas me manibus inimicorum meorum, & in die mortis conforta animam meam. Deduc me ad portum salutis, & spiritum redde factori & creatori meo.
units.tr: Psalm 3. "Lady, why are they multiplied who trouble me? In your tempest you will pursue and scatter them. Loosen the bonds of our impiety. Take away the bundles of our sins. Have mercy on me, Lady, and heal my infirmity. Take away the pain and anguish of my heart. Do not hand me over to the hands of my enemies, and in the day of death strengthen my soul. Lead me to the harbour of salvation, and render my spirit to my Maker and Creator."

units.la: IIII.
units.tr: IIII.

units.la: Psalmo quarto. Cùm invocarem, exaudivisti me Domina, de sublimi solio tuo, mei dignata es recordari. A rugientibus præparatis ad escam, & de manibus quærentium me, liberavit me gratia tua. Quoniam benigna est misericordia tua, & pietas tua in omnes, qui invocant nomen sanctum tuum.
units.tr: Psalm 4. "When I called, you heard me, Lady, from your high throne; you deigned to remember me. From the roaring beasts made ready for food, and from the hands of those who seek me, your grace has freed me. For your mercy is kind, and your piety reaches all who call upon your holy name."

units.la: G s BeneBenedicta sis Domina in aeternum, majestas tua in seculum seculi. Glorificate eum gentes in virtute vestra, & cuncti populi terræ, extollite magnificicentiam ejus.
units.tr: "Blessed be you, Lady, forever; your majesty to the age of ages. Let the nations glorify him in your power, and all the peoples of the earth exalt his magnificence."

units.la: PSALMO QUINTO.
units.tr: PSALM FIVE.

units.la: Verba mea auribus percipe Domina, & ne avertas à me fpeciofitatem vultus tui. Converte luctum nostrum in gaudium, & tribulationem nostram in jubilationem. Corruant ante pedes nostros inimici nostri. Virtute tua eorum capita conterantur. Benedicat te omnis lingua, & nomen sanctum tuum confiteatur omnis caro, &c.
units.tr: "Hear my words with your ears, Lady, and do not turn away from me the beauty of your face. Turn our mourning into joy, and our tribulation into rejoicing. Let our enemies fall down before our feet. Let their heads be crushed by your power. Let every tongue bless you, and let every flesh confess your holy name," etc.

units.la: VI.
units.tr: VI.

units.la: Psalmo sexto. Domina, ne in furore Dei sinas corripi me, neq; in ira illius judicati: de porta inferni, & te ventre abyssi, tuis sanctis precibus libera nos. Non mortui, neq; qui in inferno sunt, laudabunt te Domina, sed qui tua gratia vitam æternam obtinebunt.
units.tr: Psalm 6. "Lady, do not let me be chastened in the wrath of God, nor judged in his anger. From the gate of hell and from the belly of the abyss, free us by your holy prayers. The dead, and those who are in hell, will not praise you, Lady, but those who obtain eternal life through your grace."

units.la: VII.
units.tr: VII.

units.la: Psalmo septimo. Domina, in te speravi, de inimicis meis libera animam meam. Concludes ora leonis, dentes ejus & labia persequentium confringe. Ne moreris propter nomen tuum impartiri nobis misericordiam tuam. Splendor vultus tui fulgeat super nos, ut serenetur conscientia nostra apud altissimum.
units.tr: Psalm 7. "Lady, in you I have hoped; free my soul from my enemies. Shut the lion's mouth; break its teeth and the lips of those who persecute. Do not delay, for the sake of your name, in imparting your mercy to us. Let the splendour of your face shine upon us, so that our conscience may be made serene before the Most High."

units.la: Psalmo
units.tr: Psalm.

units.la: VIII.
units.tr: VIII.

units.la: Psalmo octavo. Domina, Dominus noster factus est per te Frater noster & Salvator noster: Ut ignis in rubo, & ros in vellere: ita descendit in te æternum verbum Dei. Spiritu Sancto fœcundante, obumbravit tibi virtus altissimi. Benedictus sit munitissimus conceptus tuus. Benedictus sit partus tuus virgineus. Benedicta sit misericordia carnis tuæ. Benedicta si dulcedo misericordiæ cordis tui.
units.tr: Psalm 8. "Lady, our Lord has become our Brother and our Saviour through you: as fire in the bush, and dew on the fleece, so the eternal Word of God has descended into you. With the Holy Spirit making you fruitful, the power of the Most High overshadowed you. Blessed be your most guarded conception. Blessed be your virginal birth. Blessed be the mercy of your flesh. Blessed be the sweetness of the mercy of your heart."

units.la: IX.
units.tr: IX.

units.la: Psalmo nono. Confitebor tibi Domina in toto corde meo, & narrabo in populis laudem & gloriam tuam. Inveniant peccatores gratiam apud Deum per te inventricem gratiæ & salutis, &c.
units.tr: Psalm 9. "I will confess to you, Lady, with my whole heart, and among the peoples I will tell of your praise and glory. Let sinners find grace before God through you, the discoverer of grace and salvation," etc.

units.la: X.
units.tr: X.

units.la: Psalmo decimo. In Domina confido, propter dulcedinem misericordiæ nominis sui. Oculi ejus in pauperem respiciunt, & manus ejus ad pusillum & viduam sunt extentæ. Exquirite jam a juventute vestræ, &c.
units.tr: Psalm 10. "In you, Lady, I trust, because of the sweetness of the mercy of your name. Her eyes look upon the poor, and her hands are stretched out to the little one and the widow. Seek now from your youth," etc.

units.la: XI.
units.tr: XI.

units.la: Psalmo undecimo. Gloria tibi sit virgo virginum. Ducnos oblecramus ad regna cælorum. Quæ clausula repetitur etiam Psalmo 22.
units.tr: Psalm 11. Glory be to you, Virgin of virgins. Lead us, we beseech you, to the kingdoms of heaven. This clause is repeated also in Psalm 22.

units.la: XII.
units.tr: XII.

units.la: Psalmo duodecimo. Esto nobis Domina turris fortitudinis, & petra durissima contTerens inimicum.
units.tr: Psalm 12. Be to us, O Lady, a tower of strength and a most solid rock, crushing the enemy.

units.la: Psalmo
units.tr: Psalm

units.la: XIII.
units.tr: XIII.

units.la: Psalmo decimotertio. Exurge Domina, praeveni inimicum. Tuo tactu levissimo sanantur infirmi, tuo odore roseo mortui revivisc̄unt.
units.tr: Psalm 13. Arise, O Lady, and forestall the enemy. By your lightest touch the sick are healed; by your rosy fragrance the dead come back to life.

units.la: XIIII.
units.tr: XIIII.

units.la: Psalmo decimoquarto. Amplectamur Mariae vestigia peccatores, & ejus beatis pedibus provolvamur. Teneamus eam fortiter, nec dimittamus, donec ab ea mercuerimus benedici.
units.tr: Psalm 14. Let us sinners embrace the footsteps of Mary, and let us fall prostrate at her blessed feet. Let us hold her fast and not let her go until we have deserved to be blessed by her.

units.la: XV.
units.tr: XV.

units.la: Psalmo decimoquinto. Conserva me Domina, quoniam speravi in te, mihiq; stillicidia gratiae misericorditer impartire.
units.tr: Psalm 15. Keep me, O Lady, for I have hoped in you, and in your mercy bestow upon me the drops of grace.

units.la: XVI.
units.tr: XVI.

units.la: Psalmo decimosexto. Exaudi Domina justiciam meam, & amove a me tribulationem meam.
units.tr: Psalm 16. Hear, O Lady, my righteousness, and remove my tribulation from me.

units.la: XVII.
units.tr: XVII.

units.la: Psalmo decimoseptimo. Diligam te Domina coeli & terrae, in gentibus nomen tuum glorificabo. Confitemini illi tribulati corde, & roborabit vos contra inimicos vestros, &c.
units.tr: Psalm 17. I will love you, O Lady of heaven and earth, and I will glorify your name among the nations. Confess to her, you who are troubled in heart, and she will strengthen you against your enemies, etc.

units.la: XVIII.
units.tr: XVIII.

units.la: Psalmo decimooctavo. Coeli enarrant gloriam tuam virgo Maria, laudate eam coelorum, & nomen ejus glorificet omnis terra.
units.tr: Psalm 18. The heavens declare your glory, Virgin Mary; praise her, you of heaven, and let every land glorify her name.

units.la: Psal.
units.tr: Psal.

units.la: XIX.
units.tr: XIX.

units.la: Psal. XIX. Exaudias nos Domina in die tribulationis, & precibus nostris converte clementem faciem tuam. Ne projicias nos in hora mortis nostræ. Succurre animæ meæ, cùm deseruerit corpus suum. Mitte Angelum bonum in occursum ejus. Sentiat in pœnis refrigerium tuum, & concede ei locum inter electos Dei.
units.tr: Psalm XIX. Hear us, O Lady, in the day of tribulation, and turn your gracious face to our prayers. Do not cast us away in the hour of our death. Come to the help of my soul when its body has left it. Send a good Angel to meet it. Let it feel your refreshment in its pains, and grant it a place among the elect of God.

units.la: XX.
units.tr: XX.

units.la: Psalmo XX. Domina in virtute tua lætabitur cor nostrum. Gloriam & honorem psallam tibi, & in nomine tuo gloriabor in seculum.
units.tr: Psalm XX. Lady, our heart will rejoice in your power. I will sing praise and honour to you, and I will glory in your name for ever.

units.la: XXI.
units.tr: XXI.

units.la: Psalmo XXI. Domina mea, clamavi ad te per diem & noctem, & fecisti cum servo tuo misericordiam tuam. Quia ego speravi in gratia tua, Sempiternum à me opprobrium abstulisti.
units.tr: Psalm XXI. My Lord, I have cried to you day and night, and you have shown your mercy to your servant. For I have hoped in your grace; you have taken away from me the everlasting reproach.

units.la: XXII.
units.tr: Chapter XXII.

units.la: Psalmo XXII. Benedicti sunt oculi tui splendidissimi, quos digneris misericorditer convertere super peccatores.
units.tr: Psalm XXII. Blessed are your most splendid eyes, which you deign mercifully to turn upon sinners.

units.la: XXIII.
units.tr: XXIII.

units.la: Psalmo XXIII. Domini est terra & plenitudo ejus. Tu autem sanctissima mater cum eo regnas in æternum. Memento nostri Domina, in beneplacito tuo, & fac nos digno glorificandi nomen tuum sanctum.
units.tr: Psalm 23. The earth is the Lord's, and the fullness thereof. But you, most holy Mother, reign with him for ever. Remember us, Lady, in your good pleasure, and make us worthy to glorify your holy name.

units.la: Psalmo
units.tr: Psalm

units.la: XXIIII.
units.tr: XXIV.

units.la: Psalmo XXIV. Ad te Domina leuaui animam meam. In iudicio Dei precibus tuis non erubescam. Ductrix mea esto ad patriam: Me coetui Angelorum digneris aggregare.
units.tr: Psalm XXIV. To you, O Lady, I have lifted up my soul. At the judgment of God I shall not blush, if you pray for me. Be my guide to the homeland; deign to join me to the company of the angels.

units.la: XXV.
units.tr: XXV.

units.la: Psalmo XXV. Iudica me Domina: Quia speraui in te, non infirmabor.
units.tr: Psalm XXV. Judge me, O Lady: because I have hoped in you, I shall not be weakened.

units.la: XXVI.
units.tr: XXVI.

units.la: Psalmo XXVI. Domina illuminatio mea sit, splendor faciei tuæ, & serenitas gratiæ tuæ refulgeat menti meæ. Misericordiam & gratiam tuam ne subtrahas à seruo tuo.
units.tr: Psalm XXVI. May my Lady be my illumination, the splendour of your face, and may the serenity of your grace shine upon my mind. Do not withdraw your mercy and grace from your servant.

units.la: XXVII.
units.tr: XXVII.

units.la: Psalmo XXVII. Ad te Domina clamabo, & exaudies me. Miserere mei in die angustiæ meæ, & in luce veritatis tuæ libera me.
units.tr: Psalm XXVII. To you, O Lord, will I cry, and you will hear me. Have mercy on me in the day of my distress, and in the light of your truth set me free.

units.la: XXVIII.
units.tr: XXVIII.

units.la: Psalmo XXVIII. Afferte Domino, filii Dei, afferte Domino gloriam & reverentiam. Da virtutem seruis tuis, mater sancta, & benedictionem laudantibus & glorificantibus te. Exaudi gemitus suspirantium ad te, & ne spernas vota inuocantium nomen tuum. Sit manus tua ad succurrendum mihi parata, & auris tua intendens ad deprecationem meam.
units.tr: Psalm XXVIII. Bring to the Lord, sons of God, bring to the Lord glory and reverence. Give strength to your servants, holy mother, and blessing to those who praise and glorify you. Hear the groans of those who sigh toward you, and do not scorn the prayers of those who call upon your name. Let your hand be ready to help me, and your ear attentive to my supplication.

units.la: XXIX.
units.tr: XXIX.

units.la: XXIX.
units.tr: XXIX.

units.la: Psalmo XXIX. Exaltabo te Domina, quoniam suscepisti me. Ab iniquo adversario meo liberabis me. Convertere ad me, & vivifica bis me, de portis mortis reduc me, & de fluctibus tribulationum, quæ circumdederunt me.
units.tr: Psalm XXIX. I will exalt you, Lady, for you have taken me up. You will deliver me from my unjust adversary. Turn to me and revive me; bring me back from the gates of death, and from the waves of the troubles that have surrounded me.

units.la: XXX.
units.tr: XXX.

units.la: Psalmo XXX. In te, Domina, speravi, non confundar in æternum. In gratiam tuam suscipe me. Inclina ad me aurem tuam, & in mœrore meo lætifica me. Tu es fortitudo mea, & refugium meum, consolatio mea, & protectio mea. In manus tuas Domina commendo Spiritum meum, totam vitam meam, & diem ultimum meum.
units.tr: Psalm XXX. In you, Lady, I have hoped; let me never be confounded. Receive me into your grace. Incline your ear to me, and gladden me in my sorrow. You are my strength and my refuge, my consolation and my protection. Into your hands, Lady, I commend my spirit, my whole life, and my last day.

units.la: XXXI.
units.tr: XXXI.

units.la: Psalmo XXXI. Beati quorum corda te diligunt, virgo Maria. Peccata ipsorum a te misericorditer diluentur.
units.tr: Psalm XXXI. Blessed are those whose hearts love you, Virgin Mary. Their sins shall be washed away by you in mercy.

units.la: XXXII.
units.tr: XXXII.

units.la: Psalmo XXXII. Exultate justi in virgine gloriosa, &c.
units.tr: Psalm XXXII. Rejoice, you just, in the glorious Virgin, &c.

units.la: XXXIII.
units.tr: XXXIII.

units.la: Psalmo XXXIII. Benedicam Dominam omni tempore. In periculis, in rebus dubiis, invocate illam, & in necessitatibus vestris invenietis auxilium & refrigerium dulce.
units.tr: Psalm XXXIII. I will bless the Lady at all times. In dangers and in doubtful matters, call upon her, and in your needs you will find help and sweet refreshment.

units.la: XXXIV.
units.tr: XXXIV.

units.la: XXXIIII.
units.tr: XXXIV.

units.la: Psalmo XXXIV. Judica Domina nocentes me, & contra eos exurge: defende & vindica causam meam.
units.tr: Psalm XXXIV. Judge, Lady, those who harm me, and rise up against them; defend and vindicate my cause.

units.la: XXXV.
units.tr: XXXV.

units.la: Psalmo XXXV. Inclina vultum filii tui super nos, coge illum precibus, nobis peccatoribus misereri. Domina in cœlo misericordia, & gratia tua diffusa est super terram.
units.tr: Psalm XXXV. Turn the face of your Son upon us; move him by your prayers to have mercy on us sinners. Lady, mercy is in heaven, and your grace is poured out upon the earth.

units.la: XXXVI.
units.tr: XXXVI.

units.la: Psalmo XXXVI. Noli æmulari in malignantibus. Domina furorem illorum dulcifica per gratiam tuam.
units.tr: Psalm XXXVI. Do not envy the wicked. Lady, sweeten their rage by your grace.

units.la: XXXVII.
units.tr: XXXVII.

units.la: Psalmo XXXVII. In conspectu tuo Domina fit omne desiderium nostrum, spes nostra, & confidentia nostra. Ne derelinquas nos Domina, mater Dei, gratia tua & virtus tua à dextris meis.
units.tr: Psalm XXXVII. In your sight, Lady, is every desire of ours, our hope and our confidence. Do not forsake us, Lady, Mother of God; let your grace and your power be at my right hand.

units.la: XXXVIII.
units.tr: XXXVIII.

units.la: Psalmo XXXVIII. Miserere mei de cœlis, & de altitudine throni tui, & ne permittas me in valle miseriæ conturbari. Custodi pedem meum, ne labatur, & corruat, & in fine meo sit mihi præsens gratia tua.
units.tr: Psalm XXXVIII. Have mercy on me from the heavens, and from the height of your throne, and do not allow me to be troubled in the valley of misery. Guard my foot, that it may not slip and fall, and at my end let your grace be present to me.

units.la: XXXIX.
units.tr: XXXIX.

units.la: Psalmo XXXIX. Expectans expectavi gratiam tuam Domina, & fecisti mihi secundum multitudinem misericordiæ nominis tui.
units.tr: Psalm XXXIX. Waiting, I have waited for your grace, Lady, and you have dealt with me according to the multitude of the mercy of your name.

units.la: XL.
units.tr: XL.

units.la: Psalmo XL. Domina Angelorum, & regina mundi. Emunda cor meum igne amoris & charitatis tuæ. Te desiderat anima mea exorare, quia tuitioni tuæ se commendat tota substantia mea.
units.tr: Psalm XL. O Lady of the Angels and Queen of the world, cleanse my heart with the fire of your love and charity. My soul desires to pray to you, for my whole substance commends itself to your protection.

units.la: XLI.
units.tr: XLI.

units.la: Psalmo XLI. Quemadmodum desiderat cervus ad fontes aquarum: Ita ad amorem tuum anhelat anima mea, virgo sancta. Exaudi me Domina, ut mundentur sordes meæ: illumina me, ut illustrentur tenebræ meæ.
units.tr: Psalm 41. As the hart pants after the water brooks, so my soul pants after your love, holy Virgin. Hear me, my Lady, that my stains may be cleansed; enlighten me, that my darkness may be illumined.

units.la: XLII.
units.tr: XLII.

units.la: Psalmo XLII. Judica me Domina, & discerne causam meam. A serpente maligno, & à dracone pestifero libera me. Sanctæ preces tuæ corroborent nos contra eum: Sancta merita tua exinaniant virtutem ejus. Persecutorem animæ meæ mitte in abyssum.
units.tr: Psalm XLII. Judge me, O Lady, and decide my cause. Deliver me from the malignant serpent and from the pestilent dragon. Let your holy prayers strengthen us against him; let your holy merits drain away his power. Send the persecutor of my soul into the abyss.

units.la: XLIII.
units.tr: XLIII.

units.la: Psalmo XLIII. Ineffabilia sunt merita tua, Domina, & valde stupenda sunt miracula tua. Quoniam innumerabiles sunt virtutes tuæ, & inæstimabiles misericordiæ tuæ.
units.tr: Psalm XLIII. Your merits are unspeakable, Lady, and your miracles are most wonderful. For your virtues are countless, and your mercies beyond all estimation.

units.la: XLIV.
units.tr: XLIV.

units.la: Psalmo XLIV. Eructavit cor meum verbum bonum, Domina. Per tuam sanctitatem tatem peccata mea purgantur. Per tuam in- tegritatem corruptibilitas mihi condonatur.
units.tr: Psalm XLIV. My heart has poured forth a good word, O Lady. Through your holiness my sins are cleansed. Through your integrity my corruptibility is forgiven me.

units.la: XLV.
units.tr: XLV.

units.la: Psalmo, XLV. Domina refugium no- strum tu es in omni necessitate nostra, & vir- tus potentio conterens inimicum. Benefi- ciis tuis plenus est mundus.
units.tr: Psalm XLV. O Lady, you are our refuge in every need, and a power that crushes the enemy. The world is full of your benefits.

units.la: XLVI.
units.tr: XLVI.

units.la: Psalmo XLVI. Omnes gentes psallite in jubilo gloriosæ virgini. Quoniam ipsa est porta vitæ, janua salutis, & via nostræ reconciliationis, spes pœnitentium, solamen lugentium, pax beata cordium atque salus. Miserere mei Domina, miserere mei, quoniam tu es spes & lux omnium confidentium in te.
units.tr: Psalm XLVI. All nations, sing psalms with jubilation to the glorious Virgin. For she is the gate of life, the door of salvation, and the way of our reconciliation, the hope of penitents, the comfort of mourners, the blessed peace and health of hearts. Have mercy on me, Lady, have mercy on me, for you are the hope and light of all who trust in you.

units.la: XLVII.
units.tr: XLVII.

units.la: Psalmo XLVII. Magna es Domina, & laudabilis valde in civitate Dei cœli. Dedisti ei Deus principatum super omnem locum dominationis tuæ.
units.tr: Psalm XLVII. Great are you, Lady, and greatly to be praised in the city of God in heaven. God has given you the rule over every place of your dominion.

units.la: XLVIII.
units.tr: XLVIII.

units.la: Psalmo XLVIII. Audite hæc omnes gentes: Auribus percipite, qui ingredi cupitis in regnum Dei. Virginem Mariam honorate, & invenietis viam & salutem perpetuam.
units.tr: Psalm XLVIII. Hear these things, all nations. Give ear, you who desire to enter the kingdom of God. Honour the Virgin Mary, and you will find the way and everlasting salvation.

units.la: XLIX.
units.tr: XLIX.

units.la: Psalmo XLIX. Deus Dei Dei Dei Deorum Mariæ locutus est per Gabrielem nuntium suum, dicens: cens: Ave gratia plena, Dominus tecum: per te salus mundi reparatur. Speciem & decore tuum, altissimi filius concupiscit. Adorna thalamum tuum Sion, praeparate in occursum Dei tui. Per Spiritum enim Sanctum concipies, qui tuum partum faciet virgineum & jucundum.
units.tr: Psalm XLIX. God of God, God of God, God of Gods, spoke to Mary through Gabriel his messenger, saying: Hail, full of grace, the Lord is with you. Through you the salvation of the world is restored. The Son of the Most High desires your beauty and your grace. Adorn your bridal chamber, O Sion; prepare to meet your God. For you shall conceive through the Holy Spirit, who will make your childbirth virginal and joyful.

units.la: L.
units.tr: L.

units.la: Psalmo L. Miserere mei Domina, quae mater misericordiae nuncuparis, & secundum viscera misericordiarum tuarum, munda me ab omnibus iniquitatibus meis. Quoniam peccata mea tibi confitebor.
units.tr: Psalm L. Have mercy on me, Lady, you who are named mother of mercy, and according to the bowels of your mercies, cleanse me from all my iniquities, for I will confess my sins to you.

units.la: LI.
units.tr: LI.

units.la: Psalmo LI. O maligne serpens, & draco infernalis. Submitte caput tuum mulieri, cujus fortitudine demergeris in profundum. Contere eum Domina pede virtutis tuae.
units.tr: Psalm LI. O malignant serpent and infernal dragon, bow your head to the woman, by whose strength you shall be thrust down into the depths. Crush him, Lady, with the foot of your virtue.

units.la: LII.
units.tr: LII.

units.la: Psalmo LII. Noli extolli de casu mulieris. Qui mulier conteret caput tuum.
units.tr: Psalm LII. Do not exalt yourself over the woman's fall. The woman who shall crush your head.

units.la: LIII.
units.tr: LIII.

units.la: Psalmo LIII. Domina in nomine tuo salvum me fac. Sub umbra alarum tuarum protege me. O Domina adjuva me. Gratiam tuam largire animae meae.
units.tr: Psalm LIII. Lady, save me in your name. Protect me under the shadow of your wings. O Lady, help me. Pour out your grace on my soul.

units.la: LIV.
units.tr: LIV.

units.la: Psalmo LIV. Glorifica manum & brachium dextrum tuum, ut prosternantur a nobis inimici nostri.
units.tr: Psalm LIV. Glorify your hand and your right arm, that our enemies may be laid low by us.

units.la: H 2 Psalmo
units.tr: H 2 Psalm

units.la: LV.
units.tr: LV.

units.la: Psalmo LV. Glorifica nomen tuum super nos, ut cognoscamus, quoniam in secundum misericordiam tuam.
units.tr: Psalm LV. Glorify your name over us, that we may know that you deal with us according to your mercy.

units.la: LVI.
units.tr: LVI.

units.la: Psalmo LVI. Tu es anchora spei, portus indulgentiae, & janua salutis.
units.tr: Psalm LVI. You are the anchor of hope, the harbour of forgiveness, and the door of salvation.

units.la: LVII.
units.tr: LVII.

units.la: Psalmo LVII. Ad laudē & gloriam pertinet Salvatoris, quicquid honorificum impensum fuerit suae genitrici.
units.tr: Psalm LVII. Whatever honour is paid to the Saviour's mother pertains to the praise and glory of the Saviour.

units.la: LVIII.
units.tr: LVIII.

units.la: Psalmo LVIII. Eripe me ab inimicis meis, Domina mund: exurge in occursum meum, Regina pietatis.
units.tr: Psalm LVIII. Deliver me from my enemies, O Lady, pure one. Rise up to meet me, Queen of piety.

units.la: LIX.
units.tr: LIX.

units.la: Psalmo LIX. Deus repulisti nos propter peccata nostra, & misericors es nobis propter virginem Mariam. Intercede pro nobis salutifera mater Dei.
units.tr: Psalm LIX. God, you have cast us off for our sins, and you are merciful to us for the sake of the Virgin Mary. Intercede for us, saving Mother of God.

units.la: LX.
units.tr: LX.

units.la: Psalmo LX. Esto mihi Domina turris fortitudinis. Me tuearis a facie crudelis vastatoris.
units.tr: Psalm LX. Be to me, Lady, a tower of strength. Shelter me from the face of the cruel destroyer.

units.la: LXI.
units.tr: LXI.

units.la: Psalmo LXI. Nonne Domina tibi subjecta erit anima mea, quae salvatorem omnium genuisti? Memento nostri, perditorum salvatrix. Infunde gratiam de thesauris fauris tuis. Ablue omnia peccata nostra, sana omnes infirmitates nostras.
units.tr: Psalm LXI. Shall not my soul, Lady, be subject to you, you who bore the Saviour of all? Remember us, saviour of the lost. Pour grace from your treasuries. Wash away all our sins; heal all our infirmities.

units.la: LXII.
units.tr: LXII.

units.la: Psalmo LXII. Custodi animam meam Domina, ut non currat in peccato.
units.tr: Psalm LXII. Keep my soul, Lady, that it may not run into sin.

units.la: LXIII.
units.tr: LXIII.

units.la: Psalmo LXIII. Da mihi Domina in te confidentiam bonam, in vita & in fine meo.
units.tr: Psalm LXIII. Give me, Lady, good confidence in you, in my life and at my end.

units.la: LXIV.
units.tr: LXIV.

units.la: Psalmo LXIV. Te decet hymnus Domina nostra in Sion, laus & jubilatio in Jerusalem.
units.tr: Psalm LXIV. A hymn becomes you, our Lady, in Sion; praise and jubilation in Jerusalem.

units.la: LXV.
units.tr: LXV.

units.la: Psalmo LXV. Jubilate Dominae nostrae omnis terra. Aufer tribulationem meam, Domina.
units.tr: Psalm LXV. Rejoice to our Lady, all the earth. Take away my tribulation, Lady.

units.la: LXVI.
units.tr: LXVI.

units.la: Psalmo LXVI. Miserere nostri Domina, & ora pro nobis. In laetitiam bonam converte maestitiam nostram. Illumina me stella maris, Clarifica me virgo clarissima. Protegat me semper dextra tua, praesentia tua illustrat finem meum.
units.tr: Psalm LXVI. Have mercy on us, Lady, and pray for us. Turn our sadness into good joy. Enlighten me, star of the sea; make me bright, most bright Virgin. May your right hand always protect me; your presence brightens my end.

units.la: LXVII.
units.tr: LXVII.

units.la: Psalmo LXVII. Exurgat Maria, & dissipentur inimici ejus, & conterantur omnes sub pedibus ejus. Pax multa diligentibus te, Domina. Anima eorum non videbit mortem in aeternum.
units.tr: Psalm LXVII. Let Mary arise, let her enemies be scattered, and let all be crushed under her feet. Great peace to those who love you, Lady. Their soul shall not see death for ever.

units.la: LXVIII.
units.tr: LXVIII.

units.la: LXVIII.
units.tr: LXVIII.

units.la: Psalmo LXVIII. Salvum me fac Domi-na. Salva animam meam genitrix Salvato-ris.
units.tr: Psalm LXVIII. Save me, O Lady. Save my soul, O Mother of the Saviour.

units.la: LXIX.
units.tr: LXIX.

units.la: Psalmo LXIX. Domina in adjutorium meum intende, & luce misericordiæ tuæ illustra mentem meam, ostende potentiam tuam contra inimicos nostros, ut sanctificeris in nationibus procul. Miserere servorum tuorum, super quos invocatum est nomen tuum, & ne sinas eos angustiari in tentatio-nibus suis.
units.tr: Psalm LXIX. Lady, hasten to my help, and illumine my mind with the light of your mercy. Show your power against our enemies, that you may be sanctified among the distant nations. Have mercy on your servants, over whom your name has been invoked, and do not allow them to be distressed in their trials.

units.la: LXX.
units.tr: LXX.

units.la: Psalmo LXX. In te Domina speravi: non confundar in æternum. Et in tua misericordia libera me, & eripe me. Vide Domina mea, quoniam tribulor. Expande manus tuas, & succurre pereunti. Ne moreris propter gratiam nominis tui, ut efficaris mihi in gaudium & in salutem.
units.tr: Psalm 70. In you, O Lord, have I hoped; let me never be put to shame. Deliver me in your mercy, and rescue me. See, O my Lord, how I am afflicted. Stretch out your hands and help me, who am perishing. Do not delay, for the sake of the grace of your name, but be to me for joy and for salvation.

units.la: LXXI.
units.tr: LXXI.

units.la: Psalmo LXXI. Deus judicium tuum Regi da, & misericordiam tuam regiæ matri ejus. In manu tua, Domina, salus & vita consistunt, lætitia perpetua, & æternitas gloriosa. Trahe me post te vinculis misericordiæ tuæ.
units.tr: Psalm 71. O God, give your judgment to the King, and your mercy to his royal mother. In your hand, O Lady, safety and life rest, everlasting joy and glorious eternity. Draw me after you with the bonds of your mercy.

units.la: LXXII.
units.tr: LXXII.

units.la: Psalmo LXXII. Quam bonus Israël
units.tr: Psalm LXXII. How good is God to Israel

units.la: Deus his, qui matrem suam colunt, & venerantur. Ipsa est enim solatium vitæ nostræ. In laboribus subventio nostra optima. Avertatur à me ira Dei per te, placa eum meritis & precibus tuis. In judicio pro me assiste coram ipso, suscipe causam meam: Mea sis advocata.
units.tr: to those who cherish and venerate his mother. For she is the solace of our life, our best help in our labours. May the anger of God be turned away from me through you; appease him by your merits and prayers. Stand by me before him in judgement and take up my cause: be my advocate.

units.la: LXXIII.
units.tr: LXXIII.

units.la: Psalmo LXXIII. Ut quid Domina repulisti nos, nec subvenis in die tribulationis?
units.tr: Psalm LXXIII. Why, Lady, have you cast us off, and do not help us in the day of trouble?

units.la: LXXIV.
units.tr: LXXIV.

units.la: Psalmo LXXIV. Confitebimur te Domina, & laudabimus nomen tuum &c.
units.tr: Psalm LXXIV. We will confess you, Lady, and praise your name, etc.

units.la: LXXV.
units.tr: LXXV.

units.la: Psalmo LXXV. Notus in Judæa Deus, in Israël honorificentia matris illius. Date illi omnes creaturæ laudem, & stupendam misericordiam ejus extollite gratulanter.
units.tr: Psalm LXXV. God is known in Judea, and in Israel his mother's honour. Give praise to him, all creatures, and joyfully extol his wonderful mercy.

units.la: LXXVI.
units.tr: LXXVI.

units.la: Psalmo LXXVI. Gratias Deo, & tibi mater pia, de omnibus, quæ afflecutus sum pietate & misericordia tua.
units.tr: Psalm LXXVI. Thanks be to God, and to you, loving mother, for all the things I have obtained by your goodness and mercy.

units.la: LXXVII.
units.tr: LXXVII.

units.la: Psalmo Lxxvii. Attendite populi Dei præcepta Dei, & reginæ gratiæ nolite oblivisci. Aperite cor ad investigandam eam, & labia ad glorificandam illam. Miserere mei regina gloriæ & honoris, & ab omni periculo custodi mentem meam.
units.tr: Psalm LXXVII. Hear, O people of God, the precepts of God, and do not forget the queen of grace. Open your heart to search her out, and your lips to glorify her. Have mercy on me, queen of glory and honour, and keep my mind safe from every danger.

units.la: LXXVIII.
units.tr: LXXVIII.

units.la: Psalmo LXXVIII. Domina, venerunt gentes in hæreditatem Dei, quas tu mericis tuis Christo confœderasti.
units.tr: Psalm LXXVIII. Lady, the nations have come into God's inheritance, which you, by your merits, have joined in covenant with Christ.

units.la: LXXIX.
units.tr: LXXIX.

units.la: Psalmo LXXIX. Qui regis Israël, intende ad me, fac me dignè matrem tuam collaudare. Charismatum suorum fragrantia suavianimæ mortuæ suscitantur.
units.tr: Psalm LXXIX. O you who rule Israel, give ear to me; make me worthy to praise your mother with words. By the fragrance of her gifts, the dead are raised to life in their souls.

units.la: LXXX.
units.tr: LXXX.

units.la: Psalmo LXXX. Exultate Dominæ adjutrici nostræ. Currite ad illam devotione (sancta), & de bonis suis participabit vobis.
units.tr: Psalm LXXX. Rejoice in our Lady, our helper. Run to her with (holy) devotion, and she will share her goods with you.

units.la: LXXXI.
units.tr: LXXXI.

units.la: Psalmo LXXXI. Terge fœditatem meam, Domina, quæ semper rutilas puritate. Fons vitæ influe in os meum, ex quo viventes aquæ profluunt. Omnes sitientes venite ad illam. Qui hauriet ex ea, saliet in vitam æternam, & qui bibit ex ea, non sitiet unquam.
units.tr: Psalm LXXXI. Cleanse my filthiness, O Lady, you who always shine with purity. Fountain of life, flow into my mouth, from which living waters pour forth. All you who thirst, come to her. Whoever draws from her will spring up into eternal life, and whoever drinks from her will never thirst.

units.la: LXXXII.
units.tr: LXXXII.

units.la: Psalmo LXXXII. Domina mea, quis similis tibi? quia gratia & gloria supereminet universa. Fac me desiderare honorificare honorificentiam tuam & gloriam, ut per te recipiar ad pacem Jesu Christi.
units.tr: Psalm LXXXII. My Lady, who is like you? For your grace and glory surpass all things. Grant that I may desire to honour your honour and glory, so that through you I may be received into the peace of Jesus Christ.

units.la: LXXXIII.
units.tr: LXXXIII.

units.la: Psalmo LXXXIII. Quàm dilecta tabernacula tua, Domina virtutum. Intercede pro me Domina apud Christum tuum, nec derelinquas me in vita, neque in morte.
units.tr: Psalm LXXXIII. How lovely are your tabernacles, O Lady of virtues! Intercede for me, Lady, with your Christ, and do not forsake me in life or in death.

units.la: LXXXIIII.
Psalmo LXXXIV. Benedixisti Domina domum tuam, &c.
units.tr: Psalm 84. "Lord, you have blessed your house," etc.

units.la: LXXXV.
units.tr: LXXXV.

units.la: Psalmo LXXXV. Inclina Domina aurem tuam, & exaudi me. Converte vultum tuum, & miserere mei: scire & cognoscere te, est radix immortalitatis, & enarrare virtutes tuas, est via salutaris.
units.tr: Psalm LXXXV. Incline, O Lord, your ear, and hear me. Turn your face, and have mercy on me: to know and to recognise you is the root of immortality, and to recount your powers is the way of salvation.

units.la: LXXXVI.
units.tr: LXXXVI.

units.la: Psalmo LXXXVI. Fundamenta, vita in anima justi, perseverare in charitate tua usque in finem. Gratia tua relevat pauperem in adversitate, & invocatio tui numinis immittit ei confidentiam bonam.
units.tr: Psalm LXXXVI. The foundations: life in the soul of the just is to persevere in your love until the end. Your grace raises up the poor man in adversity, and calling upon your divine majesty gives him good confidence.

units.la: LXXXVII.
units.tr: LXXXVII.

units.la: Psalmo LXXXVII. Domina auxiliatrix salutis meæ, in die clamavi, & nocte coram te. Expurga animam meam à sordibus & peccatis.
units.tr: Psalm LXXXVII. O Lady, helper of my salvation, I have cried out by day, and by night before you. Cleanse my soul from filth and sins.

units.la: LXXXVIII.
units.tr: LXXXVIII.

units.la: Psalmo LXXXVIII. Misericordias tuas, DomiDomina, in sempiternum cantabo. Libera me ab omni tribulatione mala, & ab omni peccato custodi animam meam.
units.tr: Psalm 88. "I will sing of your mercies, O Lady, for ever. Free me from every grievous tribulation, and keep my soul from every sin."

units.la: LXXXIX.
units.tr: LXXXIX.

units.la: Psalmo Lxxxix Domina, refugium facta es nobis in cunctis necessitatibus nostris, Qui sperant in te, amictu luminis induentur, gaudium & perpetuam laetitiam sortientur.
units.tr: Psalm 89. "Lady, you have become our refuge in all our necessities. Those who hope in you shall be clothed with the mantle of light, and shall obtain joy and everlasting gladness."

units.la: XC.
units.tr: XC.

units.la: Psalmo x c. Qui habitat in adjutorio matris Dei, in protectione ipsius commorabitur. Fructus gratiae inveniet, qui sperave-rit in illam, porta Paradisi reserabitur ei.
units.tr: Psalm 90. "He who dwells in the help of the Mother of God shall abide under her protection. He who hopes in her shall find the fruit of grace, and the gate of Paradise shall be opened to him."

units.la: XCI.
units.tr: XCI.

units.la: Psalmo x c i. Bonum est confiteri virgini Mariae. Qui acquirit gratiam ejus, cognoscetur a civibus Paradisi, & qui habuerit characterem nominis ejus, annotabitur in libro vitae.
units.tr: Psalm 91. "It is good to confess to the Virgin Mary. He who gains her grace shall be known by the citizens of Paradise, and he who bears the mark of her name shall be enrolled in the book of life."

units.la: XCII.
units.tr: XCII.

units.la: Psalmo x c ii. Adimpleat propitiationem suam in nobis mater pacis, & viam aequitatis doceat servos suos.
units.tr: Psalm 92. "May the mother of peace fulfil her propitiation in us, and teach her servants the way of righteousness."

units.la: XCIII.
units.tr: XCIII.

units.la: Psalmo x c iii. Deus ultionum Dominus. Sed tu mater misericordiae ad miserandum inflectis eum, Qui colunt te, invenient vi-[illegible, ~8 letters]
units.tr: Psalm 93. "God is the Lord of vengeances. But you, mother of mercy, bend him to pity: those who worship you shall find vi-[illegible]"

units.la: Psalmo
units.tr: Psalm

units.la: XCIV.
units.tr: XCIV.

units.la: Psalmo xciv. Venite, exultemus Domino nostrae, jubilemus virgini salvatrici nostrae. Venite, adoremus & procidamus ante eam. Confiteamur illi cum fletibus peccata nostra. Impetra nobis Domina indulgentiam plenam. Assiste pro nobis ante tribunal Dei. Suscipe in fine nostro animas nostras, & introduc nos in requiem tuam aeternam.
units.tr: Psalm 94. "Come, let us exult to our Lord, let us rejoice to our Virgin Saviour. Come, let us adore and fall down before her. Let us confess our sins to her with tears. Lady, obtain for us full indulgence. Stand by us before the judgment seat of God. Receive our souls at our end, and bring us into your eternal rest."

units.la: XCV.
units.tr: XCV.

units.la: Psalmo xcv. Cantate plenae gratia canticum novum. Admirabile commercium habetis per eam, ex quo vocati estis filii Dei excelsi.
units.tr: Psalm 95. "Sing a new canticle, you who are full of grace. Through her you have a wonderful exchange, by which you were called sons of the Most High God."

units.la: XCVI.
units.tr: XCVI.

units.la: Psalmo xcvi. Dominus regnavit. Exultet Maria in omni imperio dominationis illius.
units.tr: Psalm 96. "The Lord has reigned. Let Mary exult in every realm of her dominion."

units.la: XCVII.
units.tr: XCVII.

units.la: Psalmo xcvii. Cantate Dominae nostrae canticum novum, quia mirabilia fecit in conspectu gentium, revelavit misericordiam suam, in extremis terrae auditum est nomen ejus.
units.tr: Psalm 97. "Sing a new canticle to our Lady, for she has done wonders in the sight of the nations; she has revealed her mercy, and her name has been heard to the ends of the earth."

units.la: XCVIII.
units.tr: XCVIII.

units.la: Psalmo xcviii. Dominus regnavit. Maria super Cherubin sedet a dextris ejus.
units.tr: Psalm 98. "The Lord has reigned. Mary sits above the Cherubim at his right hand."

units.la: XCIX.
units.tr: XCIX.

units.la: Psalmo xcix. Quibus auxiliata fueris Domina, erit refrigerium pacis: & quibus averaverteris vultum tuum, non erit spes ad salutem. Recordare nostri Domina, & non apprehendent nos mala. Succurre nobis in fine, & inveniemus vitam æternam.
units.tr: Psalm 99. "To those whom you, Lady, help, there shall be the refreshment of peace; and from those on whom you turn your face, there shall be no hope of salvation. Remember us, Lady, and evils shall not seize us. Succour us at the end, and we shall find eternal life."

units.la: C.
units.tr: C.

units.la: Psalmo C. Misericordiam & judicium cantabo tibi, Domina.
units.tr: Psalm 100. "I will sing to you of mercy and judgment, Lady."

units.la: CI.
units.tr: CI.

units.la: Psalmo CI. Domina exaudi orationem meam, & clamor meus ad te veniat. Qui confidunt in te, non timebunt colubrum tortuosum, & qui exaltant te præconiis, evadent manus Acherontis.
units.tr: Psalm 101. "Lady, hear my prayer, and let my cry come to you. Those who trust in you will not fear the twisting serpent, and those who extol you with praises shall escape the hand of Acheron."

units.la: CII.
units.tr: CII.

units.la: Psalmo CII. Benedic anima mea matri Jesu Christi, & omnia præcordia mea glorificate nomen ejus. Gratia ejus peccata relaxantur, & misericordia illius ægritudines reparantur.
units.tr: Psalm 102. "Bless, my soul, the mother of Jesus Christ, and let all my inmost hearts glorify her name. By her grace sins are relaxed, and by her mercy sicknesses are repaired."

units.la: CIII.
units.tr: CIII.

units.la: Psalmo CIII. Benedic anima mea virgini Mariæ. De te procedit peccatorum medela, ac placis disciplina, ac fervor charitatis. Imple nos servos tuos virtutibus sanctis, & ira Dei non appropinquet nobis.
units.tr: Psalm 103. "Bless, my soul, the Virgin Mary. From you proceed the healing of sinners, the discipline of appeasement, and the fervour of charity. Fill us, your servants, with holy virtues, and let not the wrath of God draw near to us."

units.la: CIIII.
units.tr: CIIII.

units.la: Psalmo CIV. Confitemini Domino, nostræ, & invocate nomen ejus. Salus sempiterna est in manu tua, Domina: qui te digne honoraverint, suscipient illam.
units.tr: Psalm 104. "Confess to our Lord, and call upon his name. Eternal salvation is in your hand, Lady; those who have honoured you worthily shall receive it."

units.la: Psalmo
units.tr: Psalm

units.la: CV.
units.tr: CV.

units.la: Psalmo CV. Miserere nostri fulgentissima Regina cœli, & præsta consolationem de gratia tua.
units.tr: Psalm 105. "Have mercy on us, most resplendent Queen of heaven, and grant consolation through your grace."

units.la: CVI.
units.tr: CVI.

units.la: Psalmo CVI. Innocentiam & viam prudentiæ ostende nobis Domina, & viam intelligentiæ indica servis tuis.
units.tr: Psalm 106. "Show us innocence and the way of prudence, Lady, and point out the way of understanding to your servants."

units.la: CVII.
units.tr: CVII.

units.la: Psalmo CVII. Esto umbraculum protectionis in tentationibus nostris, expansio alarum tuarum defendet nos à devorante.
units.tr: Psalm 107. "Be a shade of protection in our temptations; the spreading of your wings will defend us from the devourer."

units.la: CVIII.
units.tr: CVIII.

units.la: Psalmo CVIII. Domina laudem meam ne despexeris, & hoc dedicatum tibi Psalterium digneris acceptare. Propera ad visitandum servos tuos, sub tegumento manus tuæ illæsi conserventur. Illuminationem Spiritus sancti per te suscipiant, &c.
units.tr: Psalm 108. "Lady, do not despise my praise, and deign to accept this Psalter dedicated to you. Hasten to visit your servants; under the covering of your hand may they be preserved unharmed. May they receive the illumination of the Holy Spirit through you, etc."

units.la: CIX.
units.tr: CIX.

units.la: Psalmo CIX. Dixit Dominus Domino meæ, sede mater mea à dextris meis. Miserere mei Domina, mater luminis & splendoris. Illumina nos Domina veritatis & virtutis.
units.tr: Psalm 109. "The Lord said to my Lord: sit, mother of mine, at my right hand. Have mercy on me, Lady, mother of light and splendour. Enlighten us, Lady of truth and virtue."

units.la: CX.
units.tr: CX.

units.la: Psalmo CX. Gloriosum & admirabile est nomen tuum: qui illud in corde retinet, non expavescet in puncto mortis.
units.tr: Psalm 110. "Glorious and wonderful is your name; he who keeps it in his heart shall not tremble at the moment of death."

units.la: CXI.
units.tr: CXI.

units.la: Psalmo CXI, Beatus vir, qui timet Dominam. nam, & beatum cor, quod diligit eam. Dis-perge Domina gratiam pauperibus tuis.
units.tr: Psalm 111. "Blessed is the man who fears the Lady, and blessed the heart that loves her. Scatter, Lady, your grace among your poor."

units.la: CXII.
units.tr: CXII.

units.la: Psalmo CXII. Laudate pueri matrem Dei, glorificate senes nomen ejus. Misericordia ejus super omnem carnem, & eleemosyna illius usque ad extremum terræ.
units.tr: Psalm 112. "Boys, praise the Mother of God; old men, glorify her name. Her mercy is over all flesh, and her alms reach to the ends of the earth."

units.la: CXIII.
units.tr: CXIII.

units.la: Psalmo CXIII. In exitu animæ meæ de hoc mundo, occurre illi, & suscipe illam, consolare illam vultu tuo sancto. Esto illi scala ad regnum cœlorum, & iter rectum ad Paradisum.
units.tr: Psalm 113. "At the departure of my soul from this world, meet it and receive it; comfort it with your holy countenance. Be to it a ladder to the kingdom of heaven and a straight road to Paradise."

units.la: CXIV.
units.tr: CXIV.

units.la: Psalmo CXIV. Dilexi matrem Dei Domini mei, & lux miserationum ejus infulsit mihi. Circumdederunt me dolores mortis, & visitatio Mariæ lætificavit me. Dolorem & periculum incurri, & recreatus sum gratia illius. Nomen ejus, & memoriale illius sit in medio cordis nostri, & non nocebit nobis ictus malignantis. Convertere anima mea in laudem ipsius: & invenies refrigerium in novissimis tuis.
units.tr: Psalm CXIV. I have loved the mother of my Lord God, and the light of her mercies has shone upon me. The sorrows of death surrounded me, and the visitation of Mary gladdened me. I incurred pain and danger, and I was refreshed by her grace. Let her name and her memorial be in the midst of our heart, and the blow of the malignant one will not harm us. Turn, my soul, to her praise, and you will find refreshment in your last days.

units.la: CXV.
units.tr: CXV.

units.la: Psalmo CXV. Credidi, propter quod locutus sum laudem & gloriam tuam, Domina, orbi terræ. Compatere animæ meæ, & dilige illam, dignare beneplacitum tuum insinuare illi. Statue illi testamentum pacis & dilectionis tuæ, præbe illi jugem memoriam nominis tui. De benedictione ventris tui da mihi sustentationem, & de pinguedine gratiæ tnæ dulcora animam meam. Distumpe vincula peccatorum meorum: & de virtutibus tuis exorna faciem animæ meæ.
units.tr: Psalm CXV. I believed, and therefore I have spoken your praise and glory, Lady, to the world. Have pity on my soul and love it; deign to make your good pleasure known to it. Establish for it the covenant of your peace and love, and grant it the continual memory of your name. From the blessing of your womb give me sustenance, and from the fatness of your grace sweeten my soul. Break the chains of my sins, and adorn the face of my soul with your virtues.

units.la: CXVI.
units.tr: CXVI.

units.la: Psalmo CXVI. Laudate Dominam nostram omnes Gentes. Quoniam confirmata est gratia & misericordia ejus super nos, & virtus illius permanet in seculum. Qui digne coluerit eam, justificabitur.
units.tr: Psalm CXVI. Praise our Lady, all you nations. For her grace and mercy have been confirmed upon us, and her power endures for ever. Whoever worships her worthily will be justified.

units.la: CXVII.
units.tr: CXVII.

units.la: Psalmo CXVII. Confitemini Domino, quoniam bonus: cōfitemini matri ejus, quoniam in seculum misericordia ejus. Gratia illius expiat conscientiam peccatorū. Via veniendi ad Christū, est appropinquare ad illam.
units.tr: Psalm CXVII. Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good; give thanks to his mother, for his mercy endures for ever. Her grace expiates the conscience of sinners. The way of coming to Christ is to draw near to her.

units.la: CXVIII.
units.tr: CXVIII.

units.la: Psalmo CXVIII. Retribue servo tuo Domina, vivifica me, & faciam voluntatem tuam. Memor esto verbi tui Dominarum primiceria, in quo mihi spem dedisti. Hæc in temptationum fluctibus potenter tenuit me, quia eloquium tuum vivificavit me. Adjuva me, & salvus ero, Domina mundi. Misericordia tua irrigat mundum universum. Domina in salutari tuo vivifica me. Omnes viæ tuæ misericordia & veritas.
units.tr: Psalm CXVIII. Repay your servant, Lady; quicken me, and I will do your will. Remember your word, O foremost of ladies, in which you gave me hope. This word has held me powerfully amid the waves of temptation, because your utterance has quickened me. Help me, and I shall be saved, Lady of the world. Your mercy waters the whole world. Lady, quicken me in your salvation. All your ways are mercy and truth.

units.la: CXIX.
units.tr: CXIX.

units.la: Psalmo CXIX. Ad beatam Mariam, eūn tributribulårer,clamavi, & exaudivit me. Domi-na, libera nos ab omni malo cunctis diebus vitæ nostræ. Ad Dominum accede oratura pro nobis, ut per te nostra peccata deleantur.
units.tr: Psalm CXIX. To the blessed Mary: when I was troubled, I cried out, and she heard me. Lady, deliver us from every evil all the days of our life. Go to the Lord and pray for us, that through you our sins may be blotted out.

units.la: CXX.
units.tr: CXX.

units.la: Psalmo CXX. Levavi oculos meos ad te, mater Christi, per quam venit solatium omni carni. Auxilium tuum & gratiam tuam nobis impende, in omni tribulatione nostra. Cu-stodi nos Domina jugiter, virgo Maria. Non dormiret neque dormiat pupilla oculi tui, ut tua semper custodia protegamur.
units.tr: Psalm CXX. I lifted my eyes to you, mother of Christ, through whom comfort has come to all flesh. Bestow on us your help and your grace in every tribulation of ours. Keep us continually, Lady, virgin Mary. Let the pupil of your eye neither sleep nor slumber, so that we may be protected by your constant custody.

units.la: CXXI.
units.tr: CXXI.

units.la: Psalmo CXXI. Lætatus sum in te, regi-na cœli. Quia te duce in Domini domum ibimus.
units.tr: Psalm CXXI. I rejoiced in you, Queen of heaven, for under your leadership we shall go into the house of the Lord.

units.la: CXXII.
units.tr: CXXII.

units.la: Psalmo CXXII. Ad te levavi oculos meos, Regina, quæ regnas in cœlis. Adjutorium nostrum in virtute sit nominis tui. Per te om-nia opera nostra dirigantur.
units.tr: Psalm CXXII. I lifted my eyes to you, Queen, who reign in the heavens. Let our help be in the power of your name. Through you let all our works be directed.

units.la: CXXIII.
units.tr: CXXIII.

units.la: Psalmo CXXIII. Nisi quia Domina nostra erat in nobis, invehiflent nos pericula multa. Esto virgo defensatrix nostra, & ante Deum advocata propitia. Ostende nobis Domina misericordiam tuam, & conforta nos in sancto servitio tuo.
units.tr: Psalm CXXIII. Unless our Lady had been in us, many dangers would have overwhelmed us. Be our defending virgin, and a gracious advocate before God. Show us your mercy, Lady, and strengthen us in your holy service.

units.la: CXXIIII.
units.tr: CXXIV.

units.la: Psalmo CXXIV. Qui confidunt in te, mater Dei, non timebunt à facie inimici. Reminiscere miserationum tuarum Domina, & releva peregrinationem incolatus nostri.
units.tr: Psalm CXXIV. Those who trust in you, Mother of God, shall not fear the face of the enemy. Remember your mercies, Lady, and relieve the pilgrimage of our sojourn.

units.la: CXXV.
units.tr: CXXV.

units.la: Psalmo CXXV. In convertendo faciem tuam serenissimam super nos, lætificabis nos virginea mater Dei.
units.tr: Psalm CXXV. When you turn your most serene face upon us, you will make us glad, virgin Mother of God.

units.la: CXXVI.
units.tr: CXXVI.

units.la: Psalmo CXXVI. Nisi Domina ædificaveris domum cordis nostri, non permanebit ædificium ejus. Ædifica nos gratia & virtute tua, ut maneamus firmi in perpetuum.
units.tr: Psalm CXXVI. Unless you, Lady, build the house of our heart, its building will not endure. Build us up by your grace and your power, that we may remain firm for ever.

units.la: CXXVII.
units.tr: CXXVII.

units.la: Psalmo CXXVII. Beati omnes, qui timent te Domina nostra, & beati omnes, qui sciunt facere beneplacitum tuum. Convertere misericordiam tuam super nos, & deprecabilis esto super servos tuos. Intuere & respice opprobrium nostrum. Aufer cunctas iniquitates nostras.
units.tr: Psalm CXXVII. Blessed are all who fear you, our Lady, and blessed are all who know how to do your good pleasure. Turn your mercy upon us, and be gracious to your servants. Look upon and regard our reproach. Take away all our iniquities.

units.la: CXXVIII.
units.tr: CXXVIII.

units.la: Psalmo CXXVIII. Obtine nobis veniam peccatorum, & per te Spiritus Sancti gratia nobis detur.
units.tr: Psalm CXXVIII. Obtain for us forgiveness of sins, and through you let the grace of the Holy Spirit be given to us.

units.la: CXXIX.
units.tr: CXXIX.

units.la: Psalmo CXXIX. De profundis clamavi ad te Domina, Domina exaudi vocem meam. Erue me in die mala, & in die mortis ne obliviscaris animæ meæ. Deduc me ad portum salutis, & inter justos scribatur nomen meum.
units.tr: Psalm CXXIX. Out of the depths I have cried to you, Lady; Lady, hear my voice. Rescue me in the evil day, and in the day of death do not forget my soul. Lead me to the harbour of salvation, and let my name be written among the just.

units.la: CXXX.
units.tr: CXXX.

units.la: Psalmo CXXX. Benedic nos Domina, & conforta nos in gratia tua, ut per te ante conspectum Domini praesentemur.
units.tr: Psalm CXXX. Bless us, O Lord, and strengthen us in your grace, so that through you we may be presented before the sight of the Lord.

units.la: CXXXI.
units.tr: CXXXI.

units.la: Psalmo CXXXI. Memento Domina David, & omnium invocantium nomen tuum. Da nobis in nomine tuo fiduciam, ut confundantur adversarii nostri.
units.tr: Psalm CXXXI. Remember, O Lord, David, and all who call upon thy name. Give us confidence in thy name, that our adversaries may be put to shame.

units.la: CXXXII.
units.tr: CXXXII.

units.la: Psalmo CXXXII. Ecce quam bonum & quam jucundum, Maria, diligere nomen tuum. Quam magna multitudo dulcedinis tuae, Domina, quam praeparasti diligentibus & sperantibus in te. Esto refugium pauperum in tribulatione, & baculus miserorum.
units.tr: Psalm CXXXII. Behold how good and how pleasant it is, O Mary, to love thy name. How great is the multitude of thy sweetness, O Lady, which thou hast prepared for those who love and trust in thee. Be a refuge for the poor in tribulation, and a staff for the wretched.

units.la: CXXXIII.
units.tr: CXXXIII.

units.la: Psalmo CXXXIII. Ecce nunc benedicite Dominam, omnes qui speratis in nomine sancto ejus.
units.tr: Psalm CXXXIII. Behold now, bless the Lady, all you who hope in her holy name.

units.la: CXXXIV.
units.tr: CXXXIV.

units.la: Psalmo CXXXIV. Mariae precamina frequentate, & suscitabit vobis voluptates aeternas. In anima contrita veniamus ad illa, &c. Respiremus ad illam in finitione nostra, & reserabit nobis atria triumphantium.
units.tr: Psalm 134. Frequent the prayers of Mary, and she will raise up for you eternal delights. Let us come to them with a contrite soul, etc. Let us breathe upon her at the close of our life, and she will open to us the courts of the triumphant.

units.la: CXXXV.
units.tr: CXXXV.

units.la: Psalmo CXXXV. Confitemini Domino, quoniam bonus, quoniam per Mariam datur Misericordia ejus.
units.tr: Psalm 135. "Confess to the Lord, for he is good" — for through Mary his mercy is given.

units.la: Psalmo
units.tr: Psalm

units.la: CXXXVI.
units.tr: CXXXVI.

units.la: Psalmo CXXXVI. Non invenietur propitiatio sine illa. Per illam peccata purgātur. Per illam fit vera satisfactio de peccatis.
units.tr: Psalm CXXXVI. Propitiation will not be found without it. Through it sins are purged away. Through it true satisfaction is made for sins.

units.la: CXXXVII.
units.tr: CXXXVII.

units.la: Psalmo CXXXVII. In quacunque die invocavero, exaudi me, & multiplica virtutem in anima mea. Ab omni perturbatione libera servos tuos, & fac eos vivere sub pace & protectione tua.
units.tr: Psalm CXXXVII. On whatever day I call, hear me, and multiply strength in my soul. Free your servants from every disturbance, and make them live under your peace and protection.

units.la: CXXXVIII.
units.tr: CXXXVIII.

units.la: Psalmo CXXXVIII. Domina probasti me, & cognovisti me. Copiosa facta est super me misericordia tua, & dilatata est super me clementia tua.
units.tr: Psalm CXXXVIII. O Lord, thou hast proved me, and known me. Thy mercy is multiplied toward me, and thy kindness is enlarged over me.

units.la: CXXXIX.
units.tr: CXXXIX.

units.la: Psalmo CXXXIX. Eripe me Domina ab omni malo, & ab hoste inferni defende me.
units.tr: Psalm 139. Deliver me, O Lord, from every evil, and defend me from the enemy of hell.

units.la: CXL.
units.tr: CXL.

units.la: Psalmo CXL. Domina clamavi ad te, exaudi me. Dirigatur oblecratio mea, ut insensum coram facie tua.
units.tr: Psalm 140. Lord, I have called upon you; hear me. Let my prayer be directed like incense before your face.

units.la: CXLI.
units.tr: CXLI.

units.la: Psalmo CXLI. Adjuva me Domina, ne corruam coram hoste, fac ut conteratur sub pedibus meis.
units.tr: Psalm CXLI. Help me, O Lord, that I may not fall before the enemy; cause him to be crushed beneath my feet.

units.la: CXLII.
units.tr: CXLII.

units.la: Psalmo CXLII. Emitte lucem tuam & gratiam tuam, & repara denuò vitam & consolationem meam.
units.tr: Psalm CXLII. Send forth your light and your grace, and restore my life and my comfort anew.

units.la: CXLIII.
units.tr: CXLIII.

units.la: Psalmo CXLIII. Benedicta sis Domina, q instruis servos tuos ad prælium. Glorifica de alto manum tuam.
units.tr: Psalm 143. Blessed be you, Lady, who trains your servants for battle. Glorify your hand from on high.

units.la: CXLIV.
units.tr: CXLIV.

units.la: Psalmo CXLIV. Oculi nostri in te speDrant, Domina: Mitte nobis cibum & escam delectantem.
units.tr: Psalm 144. Our eyes, Lady, look hopefully to you: send us food and delightful nourishment.

units.la: CXLV.
units.tr: CXLV.

units.la: Psalmo CXLV. Lauda anima mea Dominam: cum exierit Spiritus meus, Domina, fit tibi commendatus, &c.
units.tr: Psalm 145. Praise the Lady, O my soul: when my spirit departs, Lady, it is committed to you, etc.

units.la: CXLVI.
units.tr: CXLVI.
