units.la: Psalmo CXLVI. Laudate Dominam, Ipsa enim medetur contritis corde, &c.
units.tr: Psalm 146. Praise the Lady, for she heals those who are broken in heart, etc.

units.la: CXLVII.
units.tr: CXLVII.

units.la: Psalmo CXLVII. Lauda Hierusalem Dominam. Ipsa enim construit muros tuos, & filios tuos benedicit. Gratia sua te impinguat, pacemque donat terminis tuis.
units.tr: Psalm 147. Praise the Lady, O Jerusalem. For she builds your walls and blesses your sons. By her grace she enriches you and grants peace to your borders.

units.la: CXLVIII.
units.tr: CXLVIII.

units.la: Psalmo CXLVIII. Laudate Dominum nostram de cœlis.
units.tr: Psalm 148. Let us praise our Lady from the heavens.

units.la: CXLIX.
units.tr: CXLIX.

units.la: Psalmo CXLIX. Cantate Domino nostræ canticum novum.
units.tr: Psalm 149. Sing to our Lady a new song.

units.la: CL.
units.tr: CL.

units.la: Et Psalmo CL. Laudate Dominam in Sanctis ejus: Laudate eam in virtutibus & miraculis ejus. Omnis spiritus laudet Dominam nostram. Cohorresco, blasphemam istam & in Deum contumeliosam Psalmorum Davidicorum ad Mariam detorsionem, audiens. Jam ex te cognoscere cupio, anne de aliis Sacris canticis, à Papistis idem factitatum?
units.tr: And Psalm 150. Praise the Lady in her saints; praise her in her powers and her miracles. Let every spirit praise our Lady. I shudder to hear this blasphemous distortion of the Davidic Psalms into a song to Mary, an insult to God. Now I long to learn from you whether the Papists have done the same with the other sacred canticles.

units.la: Quin imò non puduit Monachos & Sacrificulos alia etiam cantica Prophetica & Sanctorum Patrum symbola sacra, unà cum ipsâ Litaniâ, incredibili pene superstitione sceleratè atq; impiè ad Mariam detorquere. Id quod ex sequentibus luce, quod dicere consuevimus, meridiana clarius evadet, spero.
units.tr: Indeed, the monks and petty priests were not ashamed to twist other prophetic canticles and the sacred creeds of the holy Fathers, together with the Litany itself, to Mary, with an almost incredible superstition, wickedly and impiously. I hope the following will make this clearer than the noonday light, as we are wont to say.

units.la: EX CANTICO MIRIAM SO-roris Moysi, Exod. 15.
units.tr: FROM THE SONG OF MIRIAM, THE SISTER OF MOSES, Exod. 15.

units.la: Cantemus Dominæ nostræ gloriosæ virginis Mariæ, in hymnis & confessionibus benedicamus eam. Domina nostra, omnipotens post Deū nomen ejus. Dextera tua, Domina, magnificata est in fortitudine, quia in multitudine misericordiæ tuæ, stravisti adversarios meos. O Domina charissima mea. Velut pullū gallinæ tege me mirabili possessione mea. Tuus totus ego sum, & omnia mea tua sunt. Ponam te sicut signaculum super cor meum.
units.tr: Let us sing to our glorious Virgin Mary, our Lady; let us bless her in hymns and confessions. Our Lady, almighty after God, is her name. Your right hand, Lady, is magnified in strength, for in the multitude of your mercy you have overthrown my adversaries. O my most beloved Lady. Cover me like a chick of a hen with your wondrous possession. I am wholly yours, and all that is mine is yours. I will set you as a seal upon my heart.

units.la: EX CANTICO MOYSI, Deut. 32.
units.tr: FROM THE SONG OF MOSES, Deut. 32.

units.la: Audite cœli, quæ loquar de Maria. Generatio prava atq; perversa, agnosce Dominam nostram salvatricem tuam. Si hanc dimit-tis, ... tis, non es amicus summi Caesaris: Quia ipse sine ea non salvabit te. Quemadmodum infans sine nutrice non potest vivere: Ita nec sine Domina nostra potes habere salutem. Sitiat ergo anima tua adipsam, tene eam, nec dimitte, donec benedixerit te, &c.
units.tr: Hear, O heavens, what I will say of Mary. Perverse and crooked generation, acknowledge our Lady, your saviour. If you dismiss her, ... you are not a friend of the highest Caesar, for he himself will not save you without her. Just as an infant cannot live without a nurse, so you cannot have salvation without our Lady. Let your soul therefore thirst for her; hold her and do not let her go until she blesses you, etc.

units.la: EX CANTICO ANNAE, MATRIS SAMUELIS, 1.Sam.2.
units.tr: FROM THE SONG OF ANNA, MOTHER OF SAMUEL, 1 Sam. 2.

units.la: Exultavit cor meum in Domino, & exaltatum est cor meum in Domina mea. Quia fecit magna, qui potens est per Mariam matrem ejus. Exulta & lauda Mariam Sion & Hierusalem: Quia maxima in dominabus Israel. Ipsa pauperem facit & ditat, humiliat & sublimat. Altior coelo, terra latior, stel-lis purior est haec Domina nostra.
units.tr: My heart has exulted in the Lord, and my heart has been exalted in my Lady. For he who is mighty has done great things through Mary his mother. Exult and praise, Mary, Sion and Jerusalem, for she is the greatest among the ladies of Israel. She makes the poor man rich and raises up the lowly. Higher than heaven, broader than the earth, purer than the stars is this our Lady.

units.la: EX CANTICO ESAIAE XII.
units.tr: FROM THE CANTICLE OF ISAIAH 12.

units.la: Confitebor tibi Domina, quoniam per te placatus est mihi Dominus, & consolata es me. Ecce Domina salvatrix mea. Fiducialiter agam in te, & non timebo. Hauriam aquas in gaudio de rivulo tuo, & semper invocabo nomen tuum. Exulta & lauda totum genus humanum: Quia talem dedit tibi mediatricem Dominus Deus tuus.
units.tr: I will give thanks to you, Lady, because through you the Lord has been appeased toward me, and you have comforted me. Behold, my Lady and saviour. I will act towards you with confidence, and I will not fear. I will draw water with joy from your rivulet, and I will always call upon your name. Rejoice and praise, all the human race, because the Lord your God has given you such a mediatrix.

units.la: EX CANTICO EZECHIAE
units.tr: FROM THE CANTICLE OF HEZEKIAH

units.la: Esaiae 38.
units.tr: Isaiah 38.

units.la: Ego dixi circa dimidium dierum meorum, Vadam ad Mariam, ut me Christo reconciliet. Pater & mater & amici dereliquerunt me: Maria autem assumpsit me. Sperabo in illam mane, sero, & in meridie. Quasi leo contrivit omnia ossa peccatorum meorum. Et tu Domina eruisti animam meam, ut non periret, & de manu canis unicam meam. Domina salvum me fac, & laudem tuam cantabo cunctis diebus vitae meae, o pia mater Domini mei.
units.tr: I said, in the middle of my days, "I will go to Mary, that she may reconcile me to Christ." Father and mother and friends have forsaken me, but Mary has taken me up. I will hope in her in the morning, in the evening, and at noon. Like a lion she has crushed all the bones of my sins. And you, Lady, have rescued my soul, that it might not perish, and my only one from the hand of the dog. Lady, make me safe, and I will sing your praise all the days of my life, O pious mother of my Lord.

units.la: EX CANTICO TRIUM ADOLESCENTUM, Dan. 3.
units.tr: FROM THE CANTICLE OF THE THREE YOUTHS, Dan. 3.

units.la: Benedicite omnia opera Domini, Dominam gloriosam. Laudate & superexaltate eam in saecula. In nomine tuo omne genu flectatur, caelestium, terrestrium, & infernorum.
units.tr: Bless the Lord, all you works of the Lord, the glorious Lady. Praise her and exalt her for ever. In your name let every knee bow, of those in heaven, on earth, and in hell.

units.la: CANTICUM EX DIVERSIS Scripturae locis.
units.tr: A CANTICLE FROM VARIOUS PLACES OF SCRIPTURE.

units.la: Domina audivi auditionem tuam & obstupui: consideravi opera tua, & expavi. Domina mea, opus tuum, circa medium annorum vivificasti illud. Confitebor tibi Domina, quia abscondisti haec a sapientibus, & revelasti ea parvulis. Operuit coelos gloria tua, & misericordia tua plena est terra. Egressa es virgo in salutem populi tui, in salutem cum Christo tuo. O benedicta, in manibus tuis est reposita salus nostra; recordare pia pauperitatis nostrae. Quae vis, ipse salvus erit: & a quo avertis vultum tuum, vadit in interitum.
units.tr: Lady, I have heard your report and I am astonished; I have considered your works, and I am afraid. My Lady, your work: in the midst of the years you have quickened it. I will give thanks to you, Lady, because you have hidden these things from the wise and revealed them to little ones. Your glory has covered the heavens, and the earth is full of your mercy. Virgin, you have gone forth for the salvation of your people, for the salvation with your Christ. O blessed one, our salvation is laid up in your hands; remember, pious one, our poverty. Whatever you will, he himself will be saved; and whoever you turn your face from goes to destruction.

units.la: EX CANTICO ZACHARIÆ,
units.tr: FROM THE CANTICLE OF ZECHARIAH,

units.la: Luc. 1.
units.tr: Luc. 1.

units.la: Benedicta sis Domina, & mater Dei mei Israël, qui per te visitavit & fecit redemptionem plebis suæ. Et erexit unicornu salutaris castitatis tuæ in domo David. Salutem ex inimicis præsta virginum virgo, & de manu omnium, qui nos oderunt, pacem tribue. Et fac misericordiam pro parentibus & nobis, &c. Per viscera multitudinis misericordiæ tuæ, visita nos stella matutina oriens ex alto. Illumina tenebras sedentium in morte, &c.
units.tr: Blessed art thou, O Lady, and mother of my God, of Israel, who through thee visited and wrought redemption for his people. And thou hast raised up a horn of salvation, thy chastity, in the house of David. Grant salvation from enemies, O virgin of virgins, and bestow peace from the hand of all who hate us. And show mercy to our parents and to us, etc. Through the bowels of thy abundant mercy, visit us, O morning star rising from on high. Enlighten those who sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, etc.

units.la: EX CANTICO MARIÆ
units.tr: FROM THE CANTICLE OF MARY

units.la: & Psalmis.
units.tr: and from the Psalms.

units.la: Magnificat anima mea Dominam Mariam. A Solis ortu usque ad occasum, laudabile nomen Mariæ. Rënuit consolavi anima mea: memor fui Mariæ, & delectata exercitata sum, & defecit spiritus meus. Ideo dilexi Mariam, super aurum & topazion. Accedite ad Mariam, & illuminamini, & facies vestræ non confundantur, &c.
units.tr: My soul magnifies the Lady Mary. From the rising of the sun to its setting, the name of Mary is to be praised. My soul refused to be comforted: I remembered Mary, and I was delighted and exercised, and my spirit fainted. Therefore I loved Mary above gold and topaz. Come to Mary, and be enlightened, and your faces shall not be ashamed, etc.

units.la: EX CANTICO SIMEONIS,
units.tr: FROM THE CANTICLE OF SIMEON,

units.la: Luc. 2.
units.tr: Luke 2.

units.la: Nunc dimittis ancillam Mariæ Domine in pace, quia viderunt oculi mei Salutare Mariæ, quod parasti ante faciem omnium populorum. Lumen ad revelationem gentium, & gloriam plebis tuæ Israël.
units.tr: Now, Lord, you dismiss Mary's handmaid in peace, for my eyes have seen Mary's salvation, which you have prepared before the face of all peoples: a light for the revelation of the Gentiles, and the glory of your people Israel.

units.la: EX SYMBOLO
units.tr: FROM THE CREED

units.la: Athanasii.
units.tr: Of Athanasius.

units.la: Quicunque vult salvus esse, ante omnia opus est, ut teneat de Maria firmam fidem. Quam nisi quisq; integram inviolatamque servaverit, absque dubio in aeternum peribit, &c. Quoniam ipsa sola virgo manendo peperit, sola haereses interemit. Confundatur & erubescat Hebraeus, qui dicit, Christum ex Joseph esse natum. Confundatur Manichaeus, qui Christum fictum dicit habere corpus. Palleat omnis, qui hoc ipsum aliunde, non de Maria dicit assumsisse. Idem namque filius, qui est Patris in divinis unigenitus, est & verus unigenitus Mariae filius: In coelis sine Matre, in terra sine Patre. Nam sicut anima rationalis & caro, propter unionem, de homine vere nascitur: ita Deus & homo Christus de Maria vere generatur, induens carnem de carne virginis: quia sic humanum genus redimi congruebat. Qui secundum divinitatem aequalis Patri, secundum humanitatem vero minor Patre. Conceptus est in utero Mariae virginis, Angelo annuntiante, de Spiritu Sancto. Non tamen Spiritus Sanctus Pater est. Genitus in mundo sine poena carnis virginis Matris: quia sine delectatione conceptus. Quem lactavit Mater ubere de coelo pleno, quam circumstabant Angeli obstetricum vice, nuntiantes pastoribus gaudium magnum.
units.tr: Whoever wishes to be saved must above all hold a firm faith concerning Mary. Unless each person keeps this whole and inviolate, without doubt he will perish forever, etc. For she alone, remaining a virgin, bore a child; she alone destroyed heresies. Let the Hebrew be confounded and put to shame, who says that Christ was born of Joseph. Let the Manichaean be confounded, who says that Christ had a feigned body. Let everyone turn pale who says that he assumed this flesh from elsewhere and not from Mary. For the same Son, who is the only-begotten of the Father in the divine nature, is also the true only-begotten son of Mary: without a mother in heaven, without a father on earth. For just as the rational soul and the flesh are truly born of man, because of their union, so God and man Christ is truly begotten of Mary, putting on flesh from the flesh of the virgin, since in this way it was fitting that the human race be redeemed. He, equal to the Father according to his divinity, is less than the Father according to his humanity. He was conceived in the womb of the virgin Mary, the angel announcing it, by the Holy Spirit. Yet the Holy Spirit is not the Father. Born into the world without pain to the flesh of his virgin Mother, because he was conceived without pleasure. His Mother nursed him at a breast full of heaven, and angels stood round her in the place of midwives, announcing great joy to the shepherds.

units.la: magnum. Hic à Magis muneribus adoratus, ab Herode in Ægyptum fugatus, à Johanne in Jordane baptizatus, traditus, captus, flagellatus, crucifixus, mortuus & sepultus, cum gloria resurrexit, ad cœlos ascendit, Spiritum Sanctum in discipulos & in Matrem misit, quam demum in cœlum ipse assumsit, & sedet ad dexteram Filii, non cessans pro nobis Filium exorare. Hæc est fides de Maria matre virgine, quam nisi quisque fideliter firmiterque crediderit, salvus esse non poterit.
units.tr: great joy. Here he, adored by the gifts of the Magi, driven into Egypt by Herod, baptized by John in the Jordan, betrayed, seized, scourged, crucified, dead and buried, rose again in glory, ascended into the heavens, sent the Holy Spirit upon the disciples and upon his Mother, whom at last he himself took up into heaven, and sits at the right hand of the Son, not ceasing to pray the Son on our behalf. This is the faith concerning Mary the virgin mother, and unless each person believes it faithfully and steadfastly, he will not be able to be saved.

units.la: EX CANTICO AMBROSII & Augustini.
units.tr: FROM THE CANTICLE OF AMBROSE AND AUGUSTINE.

units.la: Te matrem Dei laudamus, Te Mariam virginem confitemur. Te æterni Patris sponsam omnis terra veneratur. Tibi omnes Angeli & Archangeli, tibi Throni, Potestates & Principatus fideliter serviunt. Tibi omnes virtutes cœli cœlorum, & universæ dominationes obœdiunt. Tibi omnes Chori, tibi Cherubim & Seraphim exultanter assistunt. Tibi omnis Angelica creatura, incessabili voce proclamant: Sancta, Sancta, Sancta Maria Dei genitrix, Mater & virgo. Pleni sunt cœli, & terra, & mare, majestatis gloriosæ fructus ventris tui. Te gloriosus Apostolorum chorus, sui Creatoris matrem collaudat. Te beatorum Martyrum cætus candidatus datus genitricem glorificat. Te gloriosus Confessorum exercitus, Trinitatis templum appellat. Te sacrarum Virginum chorea amabilis, virginitatis & humilitatis exemplum prædicat. Te tota cœlestis curia, cœlorum Reginam honorat. Te per universam orbem Ecclesia sancta invocando celebrat, Matrem divinæ majestatis. Te verandam, te veram Regis cœlestis puerperam. Sanctam quoq; dulcem ac piam. Tu angelorum domina. Tu Paradisi janua. Tu scala regni cœlestis & gloriæ. Tu thalamus, & tu arca pietatis & gratiæ. Tu vena misericordiæ. Tu Sponsa & mater Regis æterni. Tu templum & sacrarium Spiritus sancti, totius Trinitatis beatissimæ nobile triclinium. Tu mediatrix Dei & hominum, amatrix mortalium, reparatrix cœlestium illuminatrix fidelium. Tu agonisatrix pugnantium, advocata pauperum, miseratrix & refugium peccatorum. Tu erogatrix munerum, Superatrix & terror dæmonum superborum. Tu mundi Domina, cœli Regina, post Deum sola spes nostra. Tu salus te invocantium, Portus naufragantium, miserorum solatiu, pereuntium refugiu. Tu mater omnium beatorum, gaudiu plenu post Deum, omnium supernorum civiu solatium. Tu promotrix justorum, congregatrix errantium, promissio Patriarcharum.
units.tr: We praise you, Mother of God; we confess you, Mary the virgin. The whole earth reveres you as the bride of the eternal Father. All angels and archangels, thrones, powers and principalities serve you faithfully. All the powers of the heavens of heavens and all dominions obey you. All the choirs, the Cherubim and Seraphim stand by you in exultation. All the angelic creation proclaims you with unceasing voice: Holy, holy, holy Mary, Mother of God, mother and virgin. Heaven and earth and sea are full of the glorious majesty of your womb's fruit. The glorious chorus of the Apostles praises you, the mother of their Creator. The white-robed company of the blessed Martyrs glorifies you as the Mother of God. The glorious army of the Confessors calls you the temple of the Trinity. The lovely dance of the holy virgins proclaims you an example of virginity and humility. The whole heavenly court honors you as the Queen of heaven. The holy Church throughout the whole world celebrates you with invocation, as Mother of the divine majesty. You are the venerable one, you the true bearer of the heavenly King, holy also, sweet and pious. You are the lady of the angels. You are the gate of Paradise. You are the ladder of the heavenly kingdom and of glory. You are the bridal chamber and the ark of piety and grace. You are the vein of mercy. You are the bride and mother of the eternal King. You are the temple and sanctuary of the Holy Spirit, the noble banqueting hall of the most blessed Trinity. You are the mediatrix between God and men, the lover of mortals, the restorer of the heavenly, the illuminatrix of the faithful. You are the helper of those who fight, the advocate of the poor, the pitying one and refuge of sinners. You are the dispenser of gifts, the conqueror and terror of proud demons. You are the Lady of the world, the Queen of heaven, our only hope after God. You are the salvation of those who invoke you, the harbor of the shipwrecked, the comfort of the wretched, the refuge of those who perish. You are the mother of all the blessed, joy full after God, the solace of all the citizens above. You are the promoter of the just, the gatherer of the wandering, the promise made to the Patriarchs.

units.la: Tu veritas Prophetarum, præconium & doctrix Apostolorum, magistra Evangelistarum. Tu fortitudo Martyrum, exemplar Confessorum, honor & festivitas viginum. Per te expugnato hoste antiquo, sunt aperta fidelibus regna cœlorum. Tu cum filio sedes in gloria Patris. Tu ipsum pro nobis roga virgo Maria: quem nos ad judicandum credimus esse venturum. Te ergo poscimus nobis tuis famulis subveni, qui pretioso sanguine filii tui redempti sumus. Æterna fac pia virgo cum sanctis tuis nos gloria munerari. Salvum fac populum tuum Domina, & ut simus participes hæreditatis Filii tui. Et rege nos, & custodi nos in æternum. Per singulos dies ô pia te salutamus. Et laudare te cupimus usq; in æternum mente & voce. Dignare dulcis Maria nunc & semper sine delicto nos conservare. Miserere pia nobis, miserere nobis. Fiat Misericordia tua magna nobiscum, quia in te virgo Maria confidimus. In te Maria speramus. Nos defendas in æternum. Te decet laus, te decet imperium, tibi virtus & gloria, in secula seculorum. Amen.
units.tr: You are the truth of the Prophets, the herald and teacher of the Apostles, the mistress of the Evangelists. You are the strength of the Martyrs, the model of the Confessors, the honor and festival of the virgins. Through you, the ancient enemy having been overthrown, the kingdoms of heaven are opened to the faithful. You sit with your Son in the glory of the Father. You, Virgin Mary, pray him for us, whom we believe will come to judge. We therefore beseech you: help us your servants, who have been redeemed by the precious blood of your Son. Holy virgin, make us to be rewarded with your saints in eternal glory. Lady, save your people, and let us be partakers of the inheritance of your Son. And rule us, and keep us forever. Each day, O holy one, we greet you and wish to praise you forever in mind and voice. Sweet Mary, deign to keep us now and always without sin. Holy one, have mercy on us, have mercy on us. Let your great mercy be with us, for we trust in you, Virgin Mary. We hope in you, Mary. Defend us forever. To you belongs praise, to you belongs dominion, to you belong power and glory, world without end. Amen.

units.la: IN LITANIA MARIÆ.
units.tr: THE LITANY OF MARY.

units.la: Kyrie eleyson. Christe eleyson. Christe audi nos.
units.tr: Kyrie eleyson [Κύριε ἐλέησον]. Christe eleyson [Χριστὲ ἐλέησον]. Christ, hear us.

units.la: Pater de cœlis Deus, Mariæ conditor gloriosus, miserere nobis.
units.tr: Father, God of heaven, glorious creator of Mary, have mercy on us.

units.la: Fili redemtor mundi Deus, Mariæ nobilis fœcundator, miserere nobis.
units.tr: Son, God, redeemer of the world, noble fertiliser of Mary, have mercy on us.

units.la: Spiritus Sancte Deus, Mariæ mirabilis obumbrator, miserere nobis.
units.tr: Holy Spirit, God, wondrous overshadower of Mary, have mercy on us.

units.la: Sancta Trinitas, unus Deus, quæ Mariam glorificas, miserere nobis. Quæ totum orbem illuminas Quæ tuos servientes exaltas Quæ pro peccatoribus supplicas Illuminatrix cordium Fons misericordiæ Flumen sapientiæ Splendor sanctæ Ecclesiæ Ab Angelo salutata, Per Spiritū Sanctū obumbrata, In cœlis glorificata, Rosa veris gratiosa, Vitis frondens genetosa, Dulcis virgo & speciosa, A Deo patre sponsa electa, Dei Verbi mater præelecta, A Spiritu Sancto virgo protecta, Quæ Deum in utero concepisti, Quæ Dominum in tuis visceribus habuisti, Quæ Deum & hominē peperisti, Virgo, virginum signifera, Virga Jesse Christifera. Arbor vitæ fructifera, Fœminarum pulcherrima, Humilium humilima, Sanctorum sanctissima, Super omnes diligentius amanda, Super omnes reverentius celebranda, Super omnes excellentius magnificanda, Mater conditoris, Mater redemtoris, Mater salvatoris, Mater mundo desiderabilis, Mater inferis terribilis, Mater amabilis, Virgo, plena gratia,Sancta Maria. Ora pro nobis. Virgo, plena clementia, Pia fundens solaria, Flos & decor virginalis, Fluvius sapientialis. Splendor & lux orientalis, Virtutum cœli Regina, Domus Dei cypressina, Fenestra cœli crystallina, Perpetuæ lucis aurora, Virgo pulchra & decora, Melodia dulcis & sonora, Deliciarum Dei dapifera, Cœlestis curiæ pincerna, Paradisi porta pervia, Placitum deitatis umbraculum, Purissimum cœlestis gratiæ vasculum. Dignū Dignum Christi cœnaculum, Virgo Virginum, nova exultatio, Mulierum prima benedictio, Miserorum pia consolatio, Vera salus & beatitudo, Charitatis magnitudo, Pietatis latitudo,Sancta Maria Ora pro nobis. Mater orphanorum, Mammilla parvulorum, Nobilis Regina cœlorum, Cui Angeli obediunt & obsequuntur, Cui Sancti & Sanctæ congaudent & congratulantur, Quam omnia laudant & venerantur. Propitia esto Parce nobis Domina. Propitia esto Libera nos Domina. Ab omni malo Ab omni mala tentatione Ab ira Dei & indignatione A periclitatione & desperatione A superbia præcipitante A luxuria deturbante Ab avaritia devastante A peccato iræ, & invidia cruciante A peccato gulæ & gastrimargiæ commaculante Ab incursu hostis malignantis Per dulcorem & gaudiū de Christi incarnatione, Per dolorem & angustiam ipsius Passionis, Per gaudium & lætitiam de ejus Ascensione, Per gaudium & lætitiam de tua coronatione. In mortis hora devastante, In Judicis strido examine, Ab inferni horribili cruciamine Peccatores, Ut sanctam Ecclesiam piissima co- servare digneris, Ut justis gloriam, peccatoribus gra- tiam impetrare digneris. Ut navigantibus portum, peregrinantibus reditum, infirmantibus sanitatem, tribulatis consolationem, captivis liberationem impetrare digneris. Ut famulos & famulas tuas, tibi devote servientes consolari digneris. Ut cunctum populum Christianum, filii tui preciofo sanguine redemptū, conservare digneris. Ut cunctis fidelibus defunctis æternam requiem impetrare digneris.
units.tr: Holy Trinity, one God, who glorify Mary, have mercy on us. You who illuminate the whole world; who exalt your servants; who make supplication for sinners; Illuminatress of hearts; Fount of mercy; River of wisdom; Splendour of the holy Church; Greeted by the angel; Overshadowed by the Holy Spirit; Glorified in the heavens; Graciously true rose; Flourishing and fruitful vine; Sweet and beautiful virgin; Chosen bride of God the Father; Mother of the Word of God, chosen beforehand; Protected as a virgin by the Holy Spirit; You who conceived God in your womb; who had the Lord within your body; who bore God and man; Virgin, bearer of the standard of virgins; Christ-bearing branch of Jesse; Fruitful tree of life; Most beautiful of women; Most humble of the humble; Most holy of the saints; To be loved most diligently above all; To be celebrated most reverently above all; To be magnified most excellently above all; Mother of the Creator; Mother of the Redeemer; Mother of the Saviour; Mother desired by the world; Mother terrible to the lower regions; Lovable Mother; Virgin, full of grace; Holy Mary, pray for us. Virgin, full of clemency, pouring forth pious comforts; Flower and ornament of virginity; River of wisdom; Splendour and light of the East; Queen of the heavenly powers; Cypress house of God; Crystal window of heaven; Dawn of perpetual light; Beautiful and comely virgin; Sweet and resounding melody; Server of God's delights; Cupbearer of the heavenly court; Open gate of paradise; Shade of the divine pleasure; Most pure little vessel of heavenly grace. Worthy chamber of Christ; Virgin of virgins, new joy; First blessing of women; Pious comfort of the wretched; True salvation and blessedness; Greatness of charity; Breadth of piety; Holy Mary, pray for us. Mother of orphans, nipple of little children; Noble Queen of heaven; To whom the angels submit and obey; with whom the holy men and women rejoice and congratulate; whom all things praise and venerate. Be merciful, spare us, Lady. Be merciful, deliver us, Lady. From every evil; from every evil temptation; from the wrath and indignation of God; from peril and despair; from pride that casts down; from lust that overthrows; from avarice that lays waste; from the sin of anger and envy that torments; from the sin of gluttony and gastrimargy that defiles; from the onslaught of the malignant enemy; by the sweetness and joy of Christ's incarnation; by the sorrow and anguish of his Passion; by the joy and gladness of his Ascension; by the joy and gladness of your coronation. In the hour of death that lays waste; in the stern examination of the Judge; from the horrible torment of hell: we sinners pray that you would deign most devoutly to preserve holy Church; that you would deign to obtain glory for the just and grace for sinners; that you would deign to obtain a harbour for those sailing, a return for travellers, health for the sick, consolation for the afflicted, and liberation for captives; that you would deign to console your servants, men and women, who serve you devoutly; that you would deign to preserve the whole Christian people, redeemed by the precious blood of your Son; that you would deign to obtain eternal rest for all the faithful departed.

units.la: Ut nos exaudire digneris Mater Dei, Filia Dei, Sponsa Dei, Mater charissima, Domina nostra, miserere, & dona nobis perpetuam pacem.
units.tr: That you would deign to hear us, Mother of God, Daughter of God, Bride of God, dearest Mother, our Lady: have mercy, and grant us lasting peace.

units.la: Kyrie eleyson, Christe eleyson, Kyrie eleyson.
units.tr: Kyrie eleyson [Κύριε ἐλέησον], Christe eleyson [Χριστὲ ἐλέησον], Kyrie eleyson [Κύριε ἐλέησον].

units.la: Pater noster &c. & ne nos inducas &c, sed libera &c.
units.tr: Our Father, etc., and "lead us not into temptation," etc., "but deliver us," etc.

units.la: Perge, si ita lubet, & edissere, quae praeter haec, quae hactenus commemorasti, alia in Papistarum Missalibus & id genus libris pluribus, de Sanctorum Invocatione idololatrica extare constat. Quae igitur illa & qualia sunt?
units.tr: Go on, if you please, and set out what other idolatrous invocations of the saints, besides those you have so far mentioned, are known to exist in the Missals of the Papists and in many books of that kind. What are they, then, and of what sort?

units.la: Si mihi sint linguae centum, sint oraque centum, non potis tamen sim; nec, si maxime sim, recensere ea velim, quae hinc inde in putidis scriptis de crassa & papabili idololatria pontificia leguntur.
units.tr: Even if I had a hundred tongues and a hundred mouths, I still could not do it; nor, even if I could, would I wish to recount those things which are read here and there in filthy writings about the crass and papal idolatry of the Papists.

units.la: Ut vero Babylonicae meretricis turpitudo detegatur, & cuivis appareat, quam laborantis causae patroni Jesuitae sint: en, ex infinitis atque innumeris pauca haec exempla; k quæ sequuntur, & ostendunt, quàm horrenda atq; abominabilis Sanctorum invocatio in Ecclesia Romana pseudocatholica, etiam num hodie retineatur.
units.tr: But so that the shamefulness of the Babylonian harlot may be uncovered, and it may appear to anyone how weak the cause of its defending Jesuits is, here are these few examples out of countless and innumerable ones, which follow and show how horrible and abominable the invocation of saints is, still retained today in the pseudo-Catholic Roman Church.

units.la: LITANIA OMNIVM Sanctorum.
units.tr: LITANY OF ALL SAINTS.

units.la: Kyrie Eleyson. Christe Eleyson, Kyrie Eleyson.
units.tr: Lord, have mercy [Κύριε ἐλέησον]. Christ, have mercy [Χριστὲ ἐλέησον]. Lord, have mercy [Κύριε ἐλέησον].

units.la: Christe, audi nos.
units.tr: Christ, hear us.

units.la: Salvator mundi, adjuva nos.
units.tr: Saviour of the world, help us.

units.la: Pater de cœlis Deus,
units.tr: God the Father of heaven,

units.la: Fili, Redemtor mundi, Deus;
units.tr: Son, Redeemer of the world, God;

units.la: Spiritus sancte Deus
units.tr: Holy Spirit, God;

units.la: Sancta Trinitas, unus Deus
units.tr: Holy Trinity, one God.

units.la: Sancta Maria,
units.tr: Holy Mary,

units.la: Sancta Dei genitrix,
units.tr: Holy Mother of God,

units.la: Sancta virgo virginum.
units.tr: Holy Virgin of virgins.

units.la: Sancte Michael,
units.tr: Saint Michael,

units.la: Sancte Gabriel,
units.tr: Saint Gabriel,

units.la: Sancte Raphael,
units.tr: Saint Raphael,

units.la: Omnes Sancti Angeli & Archangeli, Orate pro nobis.
units.tr: All you holy angels and archangels, pray for us.

units.la: Sancte Johannes Baptista, Ora pro nobis.
units.tr: Saint John the Baptist, pray for us.

units.la: Omnes Sancti Patriarchæ & Prophetæ, Orate pro nobis. Sancte Petre, Sancte Paule, Sancte Andrea, Sancte Jacobe, Sancte Johannes, Sancte Thoma, Sancte Philippe, Sancte Jacobe, Sancte Bartholomæe,Ora pro nobis. Sancte Matthæe, Sancte Simon, Sancte Thaddæe, Sancte Matthia, Sancte Luca, Sancte Marce, Omnes Sancti Apostoli & Evangelistæ, Ora-(te) pro nobis. Sancte Stephane, Sancte Clemens, Sancte Sixte, Sancte Corneli, Sancte Cypriane, Sancte Laurenti, Sancte Vincenti,Ora pro nobis. Sancte Blasi, Sancte Cosme, Sancte Damiane, Sancte Lamperte, S. Dionysi, cum sociis tuis, S. Mauritii, cum sociis tuis, S. Chiliane, cum sociis tuis, Omnes Sancti Martyres, Orate pro nobis. Sancte Sylvester, Sancte Leo, Sancte Hilari, Sancte Gregori, Sancte Ambrosi, Sancte Augustine, Sancte Nicolae,Ora pro nobis Sancte Martine, Sancte Remigi, Sancte Hieronyme, Sancte Benedicte, Sancte Galle, Omnes Sancti Confessores, Orate pro nobis. Sancta Perpetua Sancta Lucia, Sancta Agatha, Sancta Maria Magdalena, Sancta Agnes, Sancta Cecilia, Sancta Anastasia, Sancta Margaretha,Ora pro nobis Sancta Walpurgis, Sancta Gertrudis, Sancta Dorothea, Sancta Anna, Sancta Catharina, Sancta Elisabeth, Sancta Apollonia, Omnes Sanctæ virgines & viduæ, Orate pro nobis.
units.tr: All you holy patriarchs and prophets, pray for us. Saint Peter, Saint Paul, Saint Andrew, Saint James, Saint John, Saint Thomas, Saint Philip, Saint James, Saint Bartholomew, pray for us. Saint Matthew, Saint Simon, Saint Thaddeus, Saint Matthias, Saint Luke, Saint Mark, all you holy apostles and evangelists, pray for us. Saint Stephen, Saint Clement, Saint Sixtus, Saint Cornelius, Saint Cyprian, Saint Lawrence, Saint Vincent, pray for us. Saint Blaise, Saint Cosmas, Saint Damian, Saint Lambert, Saint Dionysius, with your companions, Saint Maurice, with your companions, Saint Kilian, with your companions, all you holy martyrs, pray for us. Saint Sylvester, Saint Leo, Saint Hilary, Saint Gregory, Saint Ambrose, Saint Augustine, Saint Nicholas, pray for us. Saint Martin, Saint Remigius, Saint Jerome, Saint Benedict, Saint Gall, all you holy confessors, pray for us. Saint Perpetua, Saint Lucy, Saint Agatha, Saint Mary Magdalene, Saint Agnes, Saint Cecilia, Saint Anastasia, Saint Margaret, pray for us. Saint Walpurga, Saint Gertrude, Saint Dorothy, Saint Anne, Saint Catherine, Saint Elizabeth, Saint Apollonia, all you holy virgins and widows, pray for us.

units.la: Omnes Sancti, Orate pro nobis.
units.tr: All you saints, pray for us.

units.la: Propitius esto, Parce nobis Domine.
units.tr: Be merciful, spare us, O Lord.

units.la: Propitius esto, A morte perpetua, A peste & clade, Ab ira tua, Ab omni immunditie mentis & corporis,
units.tr: Be merciful: from everlasting death, from plague and pestilence, from thy wrath, from all uncleanness of mind and body,

units.la: PER NATIVITATEM, RESURRECTIONEM & Ascensionem tuam.
units.tr: THROUGH THY NATIVITY, RESURRECTION AND ASCENSION.

units.la: Per adventum Spiritus S. paracleti,
units.tr: Through the coming of the Holy Spirit, the Comforter,

units.la: Per crucem & passionem tuam.
units.tr: Through thy cross and passion.

units.la: In hora mortis,
units.tr: In the hour of death,

units.la: In die judicii,
units.tr: In the day of judgement,

units.la: Peccatores,
units.tr: We sinners,

units.la: Ut pacem & concordiam nobis dones
units.tr: That thou wouldest grant us peace and concord,

units.la: Ut remissionem peccatorum nostrorum nobis dones
units.tr: That thou wouldest grant us remission of our sins,

units.la: Ut Ecclesiam tuam regere & conservare digneris,
units.tr: That thou wouldest deign to rule and preserve thy Church,

units.la: Ut Dominum Apostolicum, & omnes gradus Ecclesiasticos in Sancta religione conservare digneris,
units.tr: That thou wouldest deign to preserve the Apostolic Lord and all ecclesiastical orders in holy religion,

units.la: Ut fructus terræ nobis dare & conservare digneris,
units.tr: That thou wouldest deign to give us and preserve the fruits of the earth,

units.la: Ut nos exaudire digneris,
units.tr: That thou wouldest deign to hear us,

units.la: Fili Dei, Agne Dei, qui tollis peccata mundi, Parce nobis Domine. Agne Dei, qui tollis peccata mundi, Exaudi nos Domine. Agne Dei, qui tollis peccata mundi, Dona nobis pacem. Christe, Audi nos. Kyrie eleyson. Christe eleyson. Kyrie eleyson. Amen.
units.tr: O Son of God, Lamb of God, who takest away the sins of the world, spare us, O Lord. O Lamb of God, who takest away the sins of the world, hear us, O Lord. O Lamb of God, who takest away the sins of the world, grant us peace. Christ, hear us. Lord, have mercy [Κύριε ἐλέησον]. Christ, have mercy [Χριστὲ ἐλέησον]. Lord, have mercy [Κύριε ἐλέησον]. Amen.

units.la: PRECES AD VNIVERSUM Sanctorum coetum triumphantem.
units.tr: PRAYERS TO THE WHOLE TRIUMPHANT COMPANY OF SAINTS.

units.la: O Sancta virgo Maria, & omnes Sancti & electi Dei, nunc & in hora mortis meae, mihi miserofuccurrite, & Dominum Deum nostrum vestris meritis & precibus mihi propitium facite.
units.tr: O holy Virgin Mary, and all you saints and elect of God, help me in my wretchedness, now and in the hour of my death, and by your merits and prayers make our Lord God merciful to me.

units.la: Tu ergo virginea mater, accedens ad illud supercoelefte sacrarium semper venerandae Trinitatis, offer pro me, nunc & in hora mortis meae, quicquid virtutum & gratiarum, ab hora conceptionis tuae, usque ad horam assumptionis, in te Rex gloriae, tanquam consecratissimo thesauro suo, dignatus est conservare.
units.tr: Therefore you, virginal mother, approaching that heavenly sanctuary of the ever-venerable Trinity, offer for me, now and in the hour of my death, whatever virtues and graces, from the hour of your conception until the hour of your assumption, the King of glory deigned to preserve in you as in his most consecrated treasury.

units.la: Tu etiam beatorum Angelorum militia, offer pro me, & in hora mortis meae, constantiam purissimam, qua cum Deo nostro permanseris, & felicem innocentiam, in qua per ipsum confirmati estis. Tu quoq; Patriarcharum & Prophetarum coetus, offer pro me, nunc & in hora mortis meæ, merita fidei & desideriorum, quibus Christum Dei filium repromissum constanter expectastis.
units.tr: You also, the host of blessed angels, offer for me, and in the hour of my death, the most pure constancy by which you have remained with our God, and the happy innocence in which you were confirmed by him. You also, the company of patriarchs and prophets, offer for me, now and in the hour of my death, the merits of faith and of the desires by which you steadfastly awaited Christ, the Son of God, promised to you.

units.la: Tu quoque Senatus Apostolorum & Evangelistarum, offer pro me, nunc & in horâ mortis meæ, merita felicissimæ cum Christo adhærentiæ, familiaris amicitiæ, & fidelis perseverantiæ.
units.tr: You also, the senate of apostles and evangelists, offer for me, now and in the hour of my death, the merits of your most blessed adherence to Christ, of familiar friendship, and of faithful perseverance.

units.la: Tu hinc ô rosea Martyrum turba, offer pro me, nunc & in horâ mortis meæ, merita fidelitatum, constantiæ, & preciosi sanguinis, cum sanguine immaculati agni, pro omnium salute effusi.
units.tr: You next, O rosy host of martyrs, offer for me, now and in the hour of my death, the merits of your fidelity, constancy, and precious blood, which, with the blood of the spotless Lamb, was poured out for the salvation of all.

units.la: Tu deinde splendens Confessorum chorus, offer pro me, nunc & in horâ mortis meæ, merita devotionum, studiorum, exercitationum, & virtutum omnium, in quibus Domino Deo nostro placere meruistis.
units.tr: You then, splendid choir of confessors, offer for me, now and in the hour of my death, the merits of your devotions, studies, exercises, and all the virtues in which you were found worthy to please the Lord our God.

units.la: Tu insuper honesta virginum & mulierum caterva, offer pro me, nunc & in horâ mortis meæ, cordis & corporis munditiem, quâ Deo, spretis mundi deliciis, & corporis voluptatibus, placuistis.
units.tr: You moreover, honourable band of virgins and women, offer for me, now and in the hour of my death, the purity of heart and body by which you pleased God, having spurned the delights of the world and the pleasures of the body.

units.la: IMPLORATIO EORUNDEM patronorum.
units.tr: THE IMPLORING OF THE SAME PATRONS.

units.la: Ut efficax mea deprecatio sit, beatæ Mariæ semper virginis suffragium peto.
units.tr: That my prayer may be effective, I seek the support of the blessed Mary, ever virgin.

units.la: Adsit mihi, quæso, semper & ubiq; beato- rum Angelorum custodia, & præsta, ut a- pud te, pro me misero peccatore, Sanctorum Angelorum agmina intercedant.
units.tr: Let the guardianship of the blessed Angels, I beg, be ever and everywhere at my side, and grant that the companies of the holy Angels may intercede for me, a wretched sinner, before you.

units.la: Intercessiones Apostolorum imploro. Mar- tyrum preces exposco. Confessorum ora- tiones expostulo. Subveniat mihi apud mi- sericordiam tuam chorus Sanctarum virgi- num tuarum, quarum principatum tenet beata virgo Maria. Ibi ipsa cum omni- bus Sanctis intercedat, ut ad vitam perveni- am sempiternam, te miserante & donan- te.
units.tr: I implore the intercessions of the Apostles. I beg for the prayers of the Martyrs. I demand the entreaties of the Confessors. Let the choir of your holy virgins come to my aid before your mercy, over whom the blessed Virgin Mary holds the first place. There may she herself intercede with all the Saints, that through your mercy and gift I may come to eternal life.

units.la: Sancti Patriarchæ, Sancti Prophetæ, ob- secrate pro peccatis meis, & expulsa peni- tus erroris caligine, cordis mei oculos, ve- ræ fidei Catholicæ lumine illustrate, ut in die judicii, non cum impiis & infidelibus, qui credere & pœnitentiam agere noluerunt, secundum meritum meum me deputet, sed per vestram intercessionem mereat inveniri absolutus in illâ die ab omni vinculo peccatorum, vobiscumque ac omnibus fidelibus, introire ad regna cœlorum.
units.tr: Holy Patriarchs, holy Prophets, pray for my sins, and, with the darkness of error utterly driven away, illumine the eyes of my heart with the light of the true Catholic faith, so that on the day of judgment he may not reckon me according to my merit, with the impious and unbelieving who were unwilling to believe and to repent, but through your intercession may deserve to be found absolved on that day from every bond of sins, and, together with you and all the faithful, to enter the kingdoms of heaven.

units.la: EX ALIA ORATIONE.
units.tr: FROM ANOTHER PRAYER.

units.la: Tu virgo, Sanctitatis luce nos irradia, & sic tua prece Deo reconcilia, ut post mortem gloriemur in cœlesti patria. Ad hoc omnes potestates virtutum cœlestium, ad hoc o- Sancti, vestrum petimus auxilium.
units.tr: You, O Virgin, illuminate us with the light of holiness, and so reconcile us to God by your prayer, that after death we may glory in the heavenly fatherland. To this end we seek the help of all the powers of the heavenly hosts, to this end, O saints, your aid.

units.la: Alia
units.tr: Another

units.la: ALLIA.
units.tr: OTHERS.

units.la: Omnes supremi ordinesMille milleni milliesVestros audite supplices.Primum virtutes igneas;Mox repleti scientiae:Ex hinc juvate nos preceSessiones dominicae.Nuc vos coelestes Domini,Et principes praevalidi,Potentiaque praediti,Estote nobis placidi.Hinc ditati virtutibus,Vosq; tremendi nutibus:Fulgorosi vultibusChristi favete plebibus.Omnes, quos Dei gratiaAb hac exemit patria,Bona donans coelestia,Nostra laxate crimina.Tu pater adsis Abraham,Clara gerens prosapiam,Cum ipsis neceffariamNobis precando veniam.Tandem David, hymnidicisHinc inde stipatus choris,Pulcer coronis regiis,Cunctis succurre miseris.Sacer adesto flagitansCoetus futura praedicans,
units.tr: All you highest orders, thousands upon thousands, hear us as your suppliants. First you fiery Virtues, then you full of knowledge; from there, help us with our prayers, you Dominions. Now you heavenly Lords and mighty Princes, endowed with power, be gracious to us. Enriched with virtues and awesome in your nods, radiant of countenance, favour Christ's people. All whom God's grace has taken out of this country, bestowing heavenly goods, loosen our sins. Be present, Father Abraham, bearing an illustrious lineage, and by your prayers win for us the pardon we need. Finally, David, surrounded on every side by hymn-singing choirs, fair with royal crowns, succour all the wretched. Holy band, be present, pleading and foretelling the future, reconciling Christ to us, already exulting in heaven.

units.la: Nobis Christu conciliansIn coelo jam tripudians.Omnes dum carne induit,Quos Christus praesens docuit,Quosq; absentes imbuit,Erigite, qui corruunt.Nostros supreme claviger,Et novae pacis legifer,Omnisq; Christi crucifer,Actus mundate pariter.Nunc posce Dei genitrix,Omnisq; carnis domitrix:Cessetq; culpa perditrix,Et plebs salvetur debitrix.Nunc omne sacerdotiumPrimus ordo Pontificum,Cleru regendo subditum,Fletum tergite supplicu.
units.tr: All who, while they were clothed in flesh, whom Christ taught while present and instructed while absent, raise up those who have fallen. Our supreme keybearer, lawgiver of the new peace, and every cross-bearer of Christ, cleanse our deeds alike. Now plead, Mother of God, tamer of all flesh: let destructive guilt cease, and let the debtor people be saved. Now, all the priesthood, first order of pontiffs, ruling the clergy placed under you, wipe away the tears of the suppliants.

units.la: AD COMPLETO-rium, Hymnus.
units.tr: AT COMPLINE, a hymn.

units.la: Jesu Salvator seculi,Redemtis ope subveni,Et pia Dei genitrix,Salutem posce miseris,Coetus omnes Angelici,Patriarcharum cunei,Et Prophetarum merita,Nobis precentur veniam.
units.tr: Jesus, Saviour of the world, come to our aid with the help of your redemption, and holy Mother of God, seek salvation for the wretched. All angelic hosts, the ranks of the Patriarchs, and the merits of the Prophets, plead for us for pardon.

units.la: K Baptista Christi praevius, Et claviger aethereus, Cum caeteris Apostolis Nos solvant nexu criminis. Chorus sacratus martyrū, Sacerdotum confessio, Et virginalis castitas, Nos a peccatis abluant. Electorum suffragia, Omnesque cives cœlici, Annuant votis supplicū, Et vitae poscant praemium.
units.tr: Baptist, forerunner of Christ and heavenly keybearer, with the other Apostles, may they loosen us from the bond of sin. May the sacred choir of martyrs, the confession of priests, and virginal chastity wash us clean of sins. May the votes of the elect and all the heavenly citizens nod assent to our suppliant prayers, and ask the reward of life.

units.la: BENEDICTIO, MANE ET sere dicenda.
units.tr: BLESSING, TO BE SAID IN THE MORNING AND EVENING.

units.la: Pax Domini nostri Jesu Christi, & virtus passionis ejus, lignū † sanctæ crucis, integritas beatæ Mariæ virginis, Benedictio omnium Sanctorū, Angelorum custodia, & suffragia omnium Dei electorum, sint inter me & omnes inimicos meos, visibiles & invisibiles, nunc & semper, & in hora mortis, &c.
units.tr: May the peace of our Lord Jesus Christ, and the power of his passion, the wood of the holy † cross, the integrity of the blessed Virgin Mary, the blessing of all the Saints, the guardianship of the Angels, and the intercessions of all the elect of God, be between me and all my enemies, visible and invisible, now and always, and in the hour of death, etc.

units.la: AD NOCTURNUM Hymnus.
units.tr: AT NOCTURNS: A Hymn.

units.la: Christe Redemtor omnium, Conserva tuos famulos, Beatæ semper virginis, Placatus sanctis precibus. Beata quoque agmina Coelestium Spirituum, Præsentia, præterita, Futura mala pellite. Vates aterni judicis, Apostolique Domini, Supplicitor exposcimus Salvari vestris precibus. Martyres Dei inclyti, Confessoresque lucidi, Vestris orationibus Nos ferte in coelestibus, Chorus Sanctarū virginū, Monachorumque omnium, Nos simul cum omnibus Christi consortes facite.
units.tr: Christ, Redeemer of all, keep your servants, who are appeased by the holy prayers of the blessed ever-Virgin. You blessed hosts of the heavenly spirits, drive away the evils of the present, the past and the future. Prophets of the eternal Judge and apostles of the Lord, we suppliants beg to be saved by your prayers. Illustrious martyrs of God and bright confessors, by your prayers bear us up to the heavenly places. Choir of holy virgins and of all monks, make us partners with all of them in Christ.

units.la: Divinum auxilium beatissimæ virginis Mariæ, præsidium Angelicum, & omnium Sanctorum suffragium, maneat semper nobiscum.
units.tr: May the divine help of the most blessed Virgin Mary, the angelic protection and the suffrage of all the saints remain with us always.

units.la: Hinc Dei genitrix Maria, totus & nobis chorus Angelorum semper assistat, simul & beata concio tota.
units.tr: Hence may Mary, the Mother of God, and the whole choir of angels always stand by us, and the whole blessed assembly with them.

units.la: ET:
units.tr: AND:

units.la: Omnes Sancti Seraphin, Cherubin, Throni quoq;, dominationesq;, principatus, potestates, virtutes, Archangeli, Angeli, vos decet laus & honores. Ordines novem Spiritum beatorum. Vos quoque, quos Dei gratia vincere terrena, & Angelis socios fecit esse polo. Vos Patriarchæ, Prophetæ, Apostoli, Confessores, Martyres, Monachi, Virgines, & viduarum sanctarum, omniumq; placentium populo supremo Domino, nos adjutorium vestrum foveat & protegat.
units.tr: All you holy Seraphim, Cherubim, Thrones, Dominions, Principalities, Powers, Virtues, Archangels and Angels, to you belong praise and honour. Nine orders of blessed spirits. You also, whom the grace of God has made to overcome earthly things and to be companions of the angels in heaven. You patriarchs, prophets, apostles, confessors, martyrs, monks, virgins and holy widows, and all who please the supreme Lord of the people, may your help cherish and protect us.

units.la: ORATIO. ALIA PRO SUFFRAGIIS Sanctorum.
units.tr: PRAYER. ANOTHER, FOR THE INTERCESSIONS OF THE SAINTS.

units.la: Concede quæsumus omnipotens Deus, ut intercessio nos Sanctæ Dei genitricis Mariæ, sanctorumq; omnium Angelorum, Archangelorum, Patriarcharum, Prophetarum, Apostolorum, Martyrum, Confessorum atque Virginum & omnium electorum tuorum ubiq; lætificet, ut dum eorum merita recolimus, patrociniA sentiamus, per eundem &c.
units.tr: We beseech you, almighty God, that the intercession of the holy Mother of God, Mary, and of all the holy angels, archangels, patriarchs, prophets, apostles, martyrs, confessors and virgins, and of all your elect, may everywhere gladden us, so that while we call to mind their merits, we may feel their patronage; through the same Christ our Lord, etc.

units.la: PRÆ-
units.tr: PRE-

units.la: PRECATIO IN HONOREM Virginis Mariae, & Johannis Evangelistae.
units.tr: PRAYER IN HONOUR OF the Virgin Mary and John the Evangelist.

units.la: Hujus autor est S. Edmundus ArchiEpiscopus Cantuariensis, qui eam quotidie recitavit. Etiam a Johanne Apostolo cum ferula monitus, ne unquam illam recitare negligeret.
units.tr: Its author is St Edmund, Archbishop of Canterbury, who recited it every day. He was also admonished by the Apostle John, with a rod, never to neglect reciting it.

units.la: O intemerata & in aeternum benedicta, singularis & incomparabilis virgo Dei genitrix Maria, inclina aures tuas pietatis indignis supplicationibus meis, & esto mihi peccatori pia in omnibus auxiliatrix.
units.tr: O undefiled and blessed for ever, singular and incomparable Virgin Mary, Mother of God, incline your ears to my supplications, unworthy as they are, and be a gracious helper to me, a sinner, in all things.

units.la: O Johannes beatissime, Christi familiaris amice, te invoco cum matre ejusdem Salvatoris, ut opem mihi tuam, cum illa ferre dignetis.
units.tr: O most blessed John, familiar friend of Christ, I invoke you together with the mother of that same Saviour, that you would deign to bring your help to me along with her.

units.la: O duae gemmae coelestes, Maria & Johannes, O duo luminaria divinitus ante Deum lucentia, vestris radiis effugate scelerum meorum nubila. Vobis duobus ego peccator hodie corpus & animam meam commendo, ut omnibus horis atque momentis, intus & exterius, firmi custodes, & pii apud Deum intercessores existere dignemini. Credo enim firmiter & fateor, & indubitanter scio, quia velle vestrum velle Dei est: unde quicquid ab illo petitis, sine mora obtinebitis. Per hanc igitur tam potentissimam vestrae dignitatis virtutem, poscite mihi corporis & animae salutem. lutem, & à Deo indulgentiam omnium peccatorum meorum, atque in extremâ horâ hujus vitæ, venite mihi in adjutorium, contra omnes laqueos inimic. Et in die judicii, quando redditurus sum rationem de peccatis meis, succurrite mihi ante tribunal Christi, ut non deputer cum impiis ad pœnam, sed cum justis ad gaudium & gloriam.
units.tr: O two heavenly jewels, Mary and John, O two lights shining divinely before God, by your rays drive away the clouds of my sins. To you two I, a sinner, commit today my body and my soul, so that at all hours and moments, within and without, you would deign to be firm guardians and devout intercessors before God. For I firmly believe and confess, and I know without doubt, that your will is the will of God, so whatever you ask of him you will obtain without delay. Therefore, by this most mighty power of your dignity, seek for me the salvation of body and soul, and from God the forgiveness of all my sins. And in the last hour of this life, come to my aid against all the snares of the enemy. And on the day of judgement, when I am to render account of my sins, come to my help before the judgement seat of Christ, so that I may not be counted with the wicked for punishment, but with the just for joy and glory.

units.la: SEQVVNTVR PRECES AD S. Mariam, virginem.
units.tr: FOLLOWING ARE PRAYERS TO St Mary, the Virgin.

units.la: Maria ipsi Deo sceleratissime præfertur. Tristis eram, longò tenuit me Gallia bello, Nulla erat in medico, spes neq; multa Deo. Corripuit custos audacter me meus: Heus tu Consule te, & mente volve nefandte tuum. Virgo tuis poterit succurrere maxima votis. Cur dubitas teneras solvere dure preces? Filia, sponsa patris, mater, spes unica nostra, Oranti priscam restituet faciem. Tunc ego singultu & lachrymis pia vota re-solvi: Suscepit voces diva virago meas. Lætus ago ingentes pro tanto munere grates Virgo tibi, vitæ sola medela meæ.
units.tr: Mary is preferred most wickedly to God himself. I was sad; for a long time Gaul held me in war, there was no hope in the physician, and not much hope in God. My guardian boldly rebuked me: "Hey you, consult yourself, and turn over your wicked mind. The greatest Virgin can answer your prayers. Why do you hesitate to offer tender prayers to the harsh one? Daughter, bride of the Father, mother, our one hope, she will restore the ancient face to the one who prays." Then I, with sobs and tears, released my pious vows; the divine heroine received my words. Glad, I give immense thanks for so great a gift to you, O Virgin, the sole remedy of my life.

units.la: Extat Mortertona, non procul à thermis Aponensibus.
units.tr: Mortertona stands, not far from the Aponensian baths.

units.la: In eodem agro Patavino, ad Eremitanorum, exiat ex latere uno Crucifixi; Maria virgi-nis nis imago ex altero. Medicum procumbit, qui precatur, dubium, ad Christum, an ad Mariam potius se vertere in precibus debeat.
units.tr: In the same field of Padua, at the Hermits' church, there comes forth from one side of the Crucifix, and from the other side an image of the Virgin Mary. A physician who prays falls down, doubting whether in his prayers he ought to turn to Christ or rather to Mary.

units.la: Heu pascor à latere, (scilicet Crucifixi.) Heu lactor ab ubere (Mariæ.) Positus in medio, Quo me verram, nescio.
units.tr: Alas, I am fed from the side (namely of the Crucified). Alas, I am suckled at the breast (of Mary). Placed in the middle, I do not know where I should turn.

units.la: PRECES ALIÆ.
units.tr: OTHER PRAYERS.

units.la: Ego dixi, Domina miserere mei. Salva animam meam, quia peccavi coram facie tua. Converte misericordiam tuam super nos, & deprecabilis esto super servos tuos. Ostende nobis potentiam tuam contra inimicos nostros, ut sanctificeris in nationibus procul. Miserere servorum tuorum, super quos invocatum est nomen tuum, & ne sinas angustiari eos in tentationibus suis. Ne projicias nos in tempore mortis nostræ, & succurre animæ meæ, cum deseruerit corpus suum. Educ de carcere animam meam, ut confitear tibi, & psallat Domino meo forti in perpetuum. Esto nobis Domina turris fortitudinis, & petra durissima, conterens inimicum. Adjuva me Domina, ne corruam coram eo; fac, ut conteratur sub pedibus meis. Exaudi orationem meam Domina, & deprecationem meam, ut contabescant adversarii mei. Domina exaudi orationem meam & clamorem, &c.
units.tr: I said, Lady, have mercy on me. Save my soul, for I have sinned before your face. Turn your mercy upon us, and be entreated over your servants. Show us your power against our enemies, that you may be sanctified among the nations afar off. Have mercy on your servants, over whom your name has been invoked, and do not allow them to be distressed in their temptations. Do not cast us off in the time of our death, and succour my soul when it leaves its body. Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to you, and sing to my Lord, the strong one, for ever. Be to us, Lady, a tower of strength and a hardest rock, crushing the enemy. Help me, Lady, that I may not fall before him; bring it about that he is crushed beneath my feet. Hear my prayer, Lady, and my supplication, that my adversaries may waste away. Lady, hear my prayer and my cry, etc.

units.la: COLLECTA.
units.tr: COLLECT.

units.la: Omnipotens, sempiterne Deus, qui pro nobis de castissima virgine nasci dignatus es, fac nos, quæsumus, tibi casto corpore servire, & humili mente placere. Oramus etiam te piissima virgo Maria mundi regina, & Angelorum domina, ut eis, quos purgatorius ignis examinat, impetres refrigerium, peccatoritus indulgentiam, justis in bono perseverantiam, & nos fragiles ab instantibus defende periculis, per eandem Christum Dominum nostrum. Amen.
units.tr: Almighty, eternal God, who deigned to be born for us of a most chaste virgin, grant us, we beseech you, to serve you with a chaste body and to please you with a humble mind. We also pray to you, most pious Virgin Mary, queen of the world and lady of the Angels, that you would obtain for those whom the purging fire examines a refreshment, for sinners forgiveness, for the just perseverance in good, and defend us, frail as we are, from the dangers that threaten, through the same Christ our Lord. Amen.

units.la: HORÆ, DE COMPASSIONE gloriosissimæ virginis Mariæ, quas composuit Johannes Papa XXII. & eas devotè legentibus annos 40. Indulgentiarum in honore gloriosæ virginis Mariæ contulit.
units.tr: THE HOURS OF THE COMPASSION OF THE MOST GLORIOUS VIRGIN MARY, which Pope John XXII composed, and granted forty years of indulgences to those who devoutly read them in honour of the glorious Virgin Mary.

units.la: Maria Dei genitrix dulcis & decora, Regem morti traditum pro nobis exora. Ave Maria, &c.
units.tr: Mary, Mother of God, sweet and fair, plead for us with the King who was delivered to death. Hail Mary, etc.

units.la: HYMNUS.
units.tr: HYMN.

units.la: Imperatrix clementiæ, Rorem infunde gratiæ, In cor meum tam aridum, Ut fiat tibi placitum. Largire, quòd concipiam Tecum cordis angustiam Flens mortem, quam Rex pătitur. Per quam mundus construitur, &c.
units.tr: Empress of mercy, pour down the dew of grace into my heart, so dry, that it may be pleasing to you. Grant that I may conceive with you the anguish of the heart, weeping at the death which the King suffers, through which the world is built, etc.

units.la: Item: Gloriosa lamentatio Mariæ virginis, Matris domini nostri Iesu Christi, impetret nobis gaudia Paradisi, Amen.
units.tr: Likewise: may the glorious lamentation of the Virgin Mary, Mother of our Lord Jesus Christ, obtain for us the joys of Paradise. Amen.

units.la: Pro nobis exora crucifixum virgo decora, Amen.
units.tr: Plead for us with the crucified One, fair virgin. Amen.

units.la: Nobis mors atris sit vita precepiæ Matris, Amen.
units.tr: May death, though bitter to us, become life through the Mother's received instruction. Amen.

units.la: HYMNUS.
units.tr: HYMN.

units.la: Per Mariæ lachrymas, Pater pietatis, Nobis confer veram gratiam, cum beatis Pater pietatis.
units.tr: Through the tears of Mary, Father of mercy, grant us true grace, with the blessed, Father of mercy.

units.la: ET: Virgo, tuum filium in cruce clavatum, Redde tuis precibus miseris placatum.
units.tr: And: O Virgin, your Son, nailed to the cross, by your prayers make him gracious to us wretched ones.

units.la: ET: Nos Matris compassio Iesu Rex insignis Servet à voragine Gehennalis ignis.
units.tr: And: Jesus, distinguished King, may the compassion of your Mother keep us from the whirlpool of the fire of Gehenna.

units.la: ET: Quæso mihi misero virginum Regina, Tecum flendo, lachrymas uberes propina;
units.tr: And: I beseech you, who am wretched, Queen of virgins; weeping with you, pour out abundant tears for me.

units.la: ET: Maria te rogamus per tui Nati pœnas & vulnera, Ut orando delcas peccata & facinora.
units.tr: And: Mary, we beseech you through the punishments and wounds of your Son, that by praying you may blot out our sins and crimes.

units.la: ET: Me tibi virgo pia genitrix commendo Maria, Tu mihi salvatrix sis semper & auxiliatrix, Amen.
units.tr: And: I commend myself to you, holy Virgin and Mother Mary; be my saviour and helper always. Amen.

units.la: EX CURSU DE PASSIONE Domini.
units.tr: FROM THE OFFICE OF THE PASSION OF THE LORD.

units.la: Interveniat pro nobis, quæsumus, Domine Jesu Christe, nunc & in horâ mortis nostræ, apud tuam clementiam, gloriosa semper genitrix tua virgo Maria, cujus sacratissimam animam in horâ passionis tuæ doloris & compassionis gladius pertransivit: Qui vivis & regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitate Spiritus Sancti, Deus per omnia secula seculorum, Amen.
units.tr: May your glorious Mother, the Virgin Mary, always intercede for us, we pray, Lord Jesus Christ, now and at the hour of our death, with your mercy, whose most sacred soul the sword of sorrow and compassion pierced at the hour of your passion: You who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, for ever and ever, Amen.

units.la: EX CURSU GLORIOSISSIMÆ virginis Mariæ, genitricis Dei.
units.tr: FROM THE COURSE OF THE MOST GLORIOUS VIRGIN MARY, MOTHER OF GOD.

units.la: Suscipe verbum, virgo Maria, quod tibi à Domino per Angelum transmissum est: Ave Maria &c.
units.tr: Receive the word, Virgin Mary, which was sent to you from the Lord by the Angel: Hail Mary, etc.

units.la: Nos, cum prole pia benedicat virgo Maria, Amen.
units.tr: May the Virgin Mary bless us with her pious offspring. Amen.

units.la: Alma virgo virginum intercede pro nobis ad tuum Filium.
units.tr: Nourishing virgin of virgins, intercede for us with your Son.

units.la: Sancta Dei genitrix sit nobis auxiliatrix, Amen.
units.tr: May the holy Mother of God be our helper. Amen.

units.la: Felix ex sacra virgo Maria, & omni laude dignissima. Quia ex te ortus est Sol justitiæ Christus Deus noster. Ora pro populo, interveni pro clero, intercede pro fœmineo sexu. Sentiant omnes tuum levamen, quicunque celebrant tuam commemorationem.
units.tr: Blessed Virgin Mary, holy and most worthy of all praise, for from you has risen the Sun of righteousness, Christ our God. Pray for the people, intervene for the clergy, intercede for the female sex. May all who celebrate your remembrance feel your relief.

units.la: Ora pro nobis Sancta Dei genitrix.
units.tr: Pray for us, holy Mother of God.

units.la: O gloriosa Domina, Excelsa super sidera, Qui te creavit providè, Lactâsti sacro ubere. Quod Eva tristis abstulit, Tu reddis almo germine, Intrent ut astra flebiles, Cœli fenestra facta es. Tu Regis alti janua, Et porta lucis fulgida, Vitam datam per virginem Gentes redemtæ plaudite. Maria mater gratiæ, Mater misericordiæ, Tu nos ab hostE protege, In hora mortis suscipe.
units.tr: O glorious Lady, exalted above the stars, you who were providently chosen by him who created you, you suckled the holy breast. What sad Eve took away, you restore by your nourishing offspring, so that weeping souls may enter the heavens; you were made the window of heaven. You are the gate of the high King and the shining door of light. Nations redeemed, rejoice that life was given through a virgin. Mary, mother of grace, mother of mercy, protect us from the enemy, and receive us in the hour of death.

units.la: Alma virgo virginum, quæ genuisti Christum, intercede pro nobis. Maria virgo virginum Depoșce nobis omnium Remissionem criminum Tuum placando filium.
units.tr: Nourishing virgin of virgins, who bore Christ, intercede for us. Virgin Mary, virgin of virgins, beg for us the forgiveness of all our sins, by appeasing your Son.

units.la: Christi virgo dilectissima, virtutum operatrix, opē fer miseris. Subveni Domina clamantibus ad te jugiter: Quoniam peccatorum mole premimur, sanctissima, te precamur, subveni. Ave decus virginale, Templum Dei speciale, Per te sit veniale Omne, quod committimus. Tu nos ducas stella maris, Tu templum templo praesenTu nos semper tuearis,(tabis, En ad te confugimus. Ad te gementes suspiramus, Si non ducis, deviamus: Ergo doce, quid agamus, Posthunc fine ut vivamus Tecum perenniter.
units.tr: Most beloved virgin of Christ, worker of virtues, bring aid to the wretched. Lady, help those who cry to you continually. Since we are weighed down by the burden of our sins, most holy one, we beseech you, help us. Hail, glory of virginity, special temple of God; through you may every sin we commit be pardoned. Lead us, star of the sea; you, a temple, present us to the temple. Keep us always under your protection; behold, we flee to you. Groaning, we sigh to you; if you do not lead us, we go astray. Therefore teach us what to do, so that after this we may live with you forever.

units.la: Sancta Maria succurre miseris, juva pusil-lanimes, refove flebiles. Ora p populo, interveni pro clero, intercede p devoto foemineo sexu.
units.tr: Holy Mary, come to the aid of the wretched, help the fainthearted, revive the weeping. Pray for the people, intervene for the clergy, intercede for the devout female sex.

units.la: ET:
units.tr: AND:

units.la: Has horas Canonicas, Maria Mater pia, Tuae laudi refero, Cordis symphonia: Ut sicut tu compassa es Nato in agone; Sic huic conregnando Me socium fac coronae.
units.tr: These canonical hours, loving Mother Mary, I offer to your praise, a harmony of the heart: so that, as you suffered with your Son in agony, so you may make me a companion of his crown, reigning together with him.

units.la: ET:
units.tr: AND:

units.la: Ave gloriosa mater Maria, Mater Christi, virgo pia, pone misericordiam et compassionem tuam inter judicium dilecti Filii tui et meam miseram animam.
units.tr: Hail, glorious Mother Mary, Mother of Christ, pious virgin, place your mercy and your compassion between the judgment of your beloved Son and my wretched soul.

units.la: ET:
units.tr: AND:

units.la: Stabat mater dolorosa, Juxta crucem lachrymosa, Dum pendebat Filius; Cujus animam gementem Contristante et dolente Pertransivit gladius. O quam tristis et afflicta Fuit illa benedicta Mater unigeniti, Quae maerebat et dolebat, Mater pia, cum videbat Poenas Nati inclyti. Quis est homo, q nō flẽret Matrē Christi, si videret In tanto supplicio? Quis nō posset cōtristari, Piam matrē contemplari, Dolentem cum Filio. Pro peccatis suæ gentis Vidit Iesum in tormētis, Et flagellis subditum, Videns suum dulcē Natū Morientem desolatum Cūm emisit Spiritum. Eja mater fons amoris, Me sentire vim doloris Fac ut tecum lugeam, Fac ut ardeat cor meum, In amādo Christum Deū, Ut sibi complaceam. Sancta mater istud agas, Crucifixi fige plagas, Cordi meo valide Tui Nati vulnerati Iām dignāri pro me pati, Pœnās mecum divide. Fac me vere te cum flere, Crucifixo condolere, Donec ego vixero, Iuxta crucem tecum stare, Et me tibi sociare In planctu desidero. Virgo virginum præclara, Mihi iam non fis amara Fac me tecum plangere, Fac ut portē Christi mortem Passionis ejus fortem (te Et plagas recolere. Fac me plagis vulnerari Utiq; fac me beari Cum cruore filii; Inflammatus ac incensus Per te, virgo, sim defensus In die judicii. Fac me custodiri; Morte Christi præmuniri Confoveri gratia, Quādo corpus morietur, Fac ut animæ donetur Paradisi gloria. Amen. ALIA. Ave mundi spes Maria, Ave mitis, ave pia, Ave plena gratia. Ave virgo Mater Christi, Tu quæ sola meruisti Esse mater sine viro, Et lactare more miro. Angelorum imperatrix Peccatorum consolatrix, Consolare me lugentem In peccatis iam fœtentem. Consolare peccatorem, Et ne des tuum honorem Alieno & crudeli: Precor te regina cœli, Me habeto excusatum Apud Christum tuum Natū, Cujus iram expavesco Et à furore centremisco. Nam peccavi sibi soli O Maria virgo, noli Esse mihi aliena Gratiâ cœlesti plena, Esto custos cordis mei, Signa me timore Dei, Confer vitæ sanitatem, Et da morum honestatem, Da peccata me vitare, Et quod justum est, amare. O dulcedo virginalis, Nunquam fuit nec est talis Inter natas mulierum, Omnium creator rerum Te elegit genitricem, Qui Mariam peccatricem Emundavit à reatu, Ipse me tuo precatu A peccatis cunctis tergat, Ne infernus me demergat. Eja rosa sine spina, Peccatorum medicina,
units.tr: The sorrowful mother stood, weeping beside the cross, while her Son hung there; her groaning soul, saddened and grieving, was pierced by a sword. O how sad and afflicted was that blessed mother of the Only-begotten, who mourned and grieved, the pious mother, as she saw the punishments of her illustrious Son. What man would not weep to see the Mother of Christ in such great torment? Who could not be saddened to behold the pious mother grieving with her Son? She saw Jesus in torments, subjected to scourges for the sins of his nation; she saw her sweet Son dying, forsaken, when he gave up his spirit. Ah, mother, fountain of love, make me feel the force of your sorrow, so that I may mourn with you; make my heart burn to love Christ God, so that I may please him. Holy mother, do this: fix the wounds of the Crucified deeply in my heart, and share with me the punishments of your wounded Son, who deigned to suffer for me. Make me truly weep with you, and grieve with the Crucified, as long as I live. I desire to stand beside the cross with you and to join myself to you in lamentation. Bright virgin of virgins, be no longer bitter to me; make me weep with you, make me bear the death of Christ, and recall his strong passion and wounds. Make me wounded by his blows, and surely make me blessed with the blood of your Son. Inflamed and kindled, may I be defended by you, virgin, on the day of judgment. Make me be guarded, fortified by the death of Christ, cherished by grace; when my body dies, grant that the glory of paradise be given to my soul. Amen. ANOTHER. Hail, Mary, hope of the world, hail, gentle one, hail, pious one, hail, full of grace. Hail, virgin Mother of Christ, you who alone deserved to be a mother without a husband, and to nurse in a wondrous manner. Empress of the angels, consoler of sinners, console me, mourning now and already foul with sins. Console the sinner, and do not give your honor to an alien and cruel one. I beseech you, Queen of heaven, hold me excused before Christ your Son, whose wrath I dread and tremble at his fury. For I have sinned against him alone. O Mary, virgin, do not be to me an alien, full of heavenly grace. Be the guardian of my heart, mark me with the fear of God, grant the health of life, and give the honesty of conduct. Grant that I may avoid sins, and love what is just. O virginal sweetness, never was there, nor is there, one such as you among the daughters of women. He who created all things chose you as his mother, he who cleansed Mary the sinner of her guilt; may he, at your prayer, wipe away all my sins, lest hell plunge me down. Ah, rose without thorn, medicine for sinners,

units.la: Pro me Christum interpella,Ut me salvet a procella,Hujus mundi tam immundi,Cujus fluctus furibundiOmni parte me impingunt,Et peccati zona stringunt.Christe fili summi Patris,Per amorem tuae Matris.
units.tr: Plead for me with Christ, that he may save me from the storm of this world, so unclean, whose furious waves strike me on every side and bind me with the belt of sin. Christ, Son of the highest Father, through the love of your Mother.

units.la: Ora pro nobis Sancta Dei genitrix, ut digni efficiamur promissione Christi.
units.tr: Pray for us, holy Mother of God, that we may be made worthy of the promise of Christ.

units.la: O piissima virgo, sancta Maria, fac nobiscum misericordiam tuam in illa tremenda hora, qua dum movens lingua te invocare non potest, nec oculi lucem capiunt, nec aures ulla voce patescunt. Memor esto tunc, quas fundimus preces nunc ad aures tuae pietatis, & subveni nobis in ultima hora necessitatis, ut collocemur cum filiis lucis, qui Deo Patri semper assistunt, & Filio & Spiritui Sancto, gaudio fine fine laetentur.
units.tr: O most pious virgin, holy Mary, show us your mercy in that dreadful hour, when the tongue, moving, cannot invoke you, nor the eyes receive light, nor the ears open to any voice. Remember then the prayers we now pour out to the ears of your goodness, and help us in the last hour of need, so that we may be placed with the sons of light, who always stand before God the Father, and the Son and the Holy Spirit, and rejoice in joy without end.

units.la: ORATIO ECCLESIAE.
units.tr: PRAYER OF THE CHURCH.

units.la: Sancta Maria, mater Domini nostri Jesu Christi, pia & perpetua virgo, cum omnibus Sanctis & electis Dei, intercedere dignare pro nobis miseris peccatoribus, ad Dominum Deum Patrem omnipotentem, ut mereamur ab eo adjuvari, salvari, protegi, & defendi. Qui in Trinitate perfecta vivit & regnat Deus in secula, Amen.
units.tr: Holy Mary, mother of our Lord Jesus Christ, pious and perpetual virgin, together with all the saints and elect of God, deign to intercede for us wretched sinners with the Lord God the Father almighty, that we may deserve to be helped, saved, protected and defended by him. Who lives and reigns in the perfect Trinity, God, for ever and ever. Amen.

units.la: SUPPLEX CANTICUM.
units.tr: THE SUPPLIANT CANTICLE.

units.la: Salve Regina misericordiæ, Vita, dulcedo, & spes nostra salve. Ad te clamamus exules filii Evæ.
units.tr: Hail, Queen of mercy, our life, sweetness and hope, hail. To you we cry, exiled children of Eve.

units.la: Ad te suspiramus gementes & flentes in hac lachrymarum valle.
units.tr: To you we sigh, groaning and weeping in this vale of tears.

units.la: Eja ergò Advocata nostra, illos tuos misericordes oculos ad nos converte,
units.tr: Come then, our Advocate, turn those merciful eyes of yours upon us.

units.la: Et Iesum, benedictum fructum ventris tui, nobis post hoc exilium ostende.
units.tr: And after this exile, show us Jesus, the blessed fruit of your womb.

units.la: O clemens Maria.
units.tr: O merciful Mary.

units.la: O pia Maria.
units.tr: O kind Mary.

units.la: O dulcis Maria.
units.tr: O sweet Mary.

units.la: ALIUD SIMILE.
units.tr: ANOTHER SIMILAR PIECE.

units.la: Hæc est præclarum vas paracleti Spiritus Sancti.
units.tr: She is the excellent vessel of the Paraclete, the Holy Spirit.

units.la: Hæc est gloriosa civitas Dei.
units.tr: She is the glorious city of God.

units.la: Hæc est mulier virtutis, quæ contrivit caput serpentis.
units.tr: She is the woman of strength who crushed the serpent's head.

units.la: Hæc est sole speciosior, Luna pulchrior, Aurora rutilantior, stellis præclarior.
units.tr: She is fairer than the sun, more beautiful than the moon, more radiant than the dawn, more splendid than the stars.

units.la: Hanc peccatores devotè adeamus.
units.tr: Let us sinners approach her devoutly.

units.la: Rea pectora tendamus, dicentes:
units.tr: Let us stretch out our guilty hearts, saying:

units.la: Sancta, Sancta, Sancta Maria.
units.tr: Holy, holy, holy Mary.

units.la: Clemens & pia Domina nostra.
units.tr: Merciful and kind Lady, our Lady.

units.la: Fac nos, tuis precibus, consortes cœlestis gloriæ, Amen.
units.tr: By your prayers, make us partakers of heavenly glory, Amen.

units.la: SEQVENTIA, IN CONCILIO Constantiensi decantata.
units.tr: SEQUENCE, sung at the Council of Constance.

units.la: Veni mater gratiæ, Fons misericordiæ, Miseris remedium. Veni lux Ecclesiæ, Tristibus lætitiæ Nunc infunde radium. Te Reginam colimus, Tibi laudes canimus, Exaffectu cordium. Quæ es inanguftiis, Et in rebus dubiis, Salus & solatium. O stella præfulgida, Tu dira certamina Maris hujus reprime.
units.tr: Come, mother of grace, fountain of mercy, remedy for the wretched. Come, light of the Church, and now pour a ray of joy upon the sorrowful. We worship you as Queen and sing your praises from the affection of our hearts. You who are in distress and in doubtful matters are our safety and comfort. O shining star, restrain the dire conflicts of this sea.

units.la: Simonis navicula, Filii tunicula, Nescindantur, prohibe. Portus navigantium Preces supplicantium Filiorum suscipe. Consolare flebiles, Juva pusillanimes, Et errantes corrige. Quæ Deum hominibus Ex ima cœlestibus Jungis o puerpera, Hæreses interime Schismataque reprime, Firma pacis federa. Amen.
units.tr: Little boat of Simon, little tunic of the Son, forbid that they be torn. Harbour of those who sail, receive the prayers of your supplicating sons. Console the weeping, help the faint-hearted, and correct the wandering. O mother who bore a child, you who join God to men from the depths to the heavens, destroy heresies, restrain schisms, and make firm the covenants of peace. Amen.

units.la: Concede, misericors Deus, fragilitati nostræ præsidium, ut, qui sanctæ Dei genitricis memoriam agimus, intercessionis ejus auxilio a nostris iniquitatibus resurgamus.
units.tr: Merciful God, grant to our frailty a defence, so that we who celebrate the memory of the holy Mother of God may by the help of her intercession rise again from our iniquities.

units.la: Famulorum tuorum, quæsumus Domine, delictis ignosce, ut, qui tibi placere de actibus nostris non valemus, genitricis Filii tui intercessione salvemur.
units.tr: We beseech you, Lord, to pardon the offences of your servants, so that we, who cannot please you by our actions, may be saved through the intercession of the Mother of your Son.

units.la: Concede nos famulos tuos, quæsumus Domine Deus, perpetua mentis & corporis sanitate gaudere, & gloriosæ beatæ Mariæ semper virginis intercessione, à præsenti liberari tristitiâ, & æternâ perfrui lætitiâ. Beatæ & gloriosæ semper virginis Mariæ, quæsumus Domine, intercessio gloriosa nos protegat, & ad vitam perducat æternam.
units.tr: We beseech you, Lord God, to grant that we your servants may rejoice in perpetual health of mind and body, and by the intercession of the glorious blessed Mary, ever a virgin, be delivered from present sadness and enjoy eternal gladness. May the glorious intercession of the blessed and glorious ever-virgin Mary, we beseech you, Lord, protect us and bring us to eternal life.

units.la: EX CURSU HORARUM BEATÆ Mariæ Virginis, secundum ordinarium Ecclesiæ Hildesheimensis.
units.tr: FROM THE COURSE OF THE HOURS OF THE BLESSED VIRGIN MARY, according to the ordinary of the Church of Hildesheim.

units.la: Gaude Maria virgo, cunctas hæreses sola interemisti in universo mundo.
units.tr: Rejoice, Virgin Mary, you alone have destroyed all heresies in the whole world.

units.la: Dignare me, laudare te, virgo sacrata. Da mihi virtutem contra hostes tuos.
units.tr: Grant that I may praise you, holy virgin. Give me strength against your enemies.

units.la: Precibus & meritis Sanctissimæ Dei genitricis virginis Mariæ & omnium Sanctorum salvet & protegat nos Omnipotens & misericors Dominus, Amen.
