units.tr: By the prayers and merits of the most holy Mother of God, the Virgin Mary, and of all the saints, may the almighty and merciful Lord save and protect us. Amen.

units.la: O Maria, admitte preces nostras, intra sacrarium tuæ exauditionis, & reporta nobis antidotum reconciliationis: sit per te excusabile, quod per te ingerimus: sit impetrabile, quod fide & mente poscimus: accipe, quod offerimus, redona, quod rogamus, excusa, quod timemus.
units.tr: O Mary, admit our prayers into the sanctuary of your hearing, and bring back to us the antidote of reconciliation. Let what we bring to you be excusable through you; let what we ask with faith and mind be obtainable; accept what we offer, give back what we ask, and excuse what we fear.

units.la: Sancta Maria succurre miseris, juva pusillanimes, refove debiles, ora pro populo, interveni pro clero, intercede pro devoto fœmineo sexu. Sentiant omnes tuum levamen, quicunque celebrant tuum nomen. Assiste parata vocibus poscentium, & reporta nobis omnibus optatum effectum.
units.tr: Holy Mary, help the wretched, aid the faint-hearted, refresh the weak, pray for the people, intervene for the clergy, and intercede for the devout female sex. May all feel your relief who celebrate your name. Be present, ready for the voices of those who ask, and bring back to us all the desired effect.

units.la: Tu nunc supplicitèr Sancta Theotocgis Regis perpetui sponsa, poscimus,ut nos sem- per ubiq; miti munere protegas.
units.tr: Now we humbly ask you, holy Mother of God, bride of the eternal King, that you protect us always and everywhere with your gentle favour.

units.la: VERSUS.
units.tr: VERSES.

units.la: In omni tribulatione & angustia nostra, succurre nobis piissima virgo Maria.
units.tr: In all our tribulation and distress, help us, most pious Virgin Mary.

units.la: COLLECTA.
units.tr: COLLECT.

units.la: Protege, quæsumus, Domine, famulos tuos, subsidiis pacis, & Beatæ Mariæ patrociniis confidentes, à cunctis hostibus redde securos.
units.tr: Protect, we beseech you, Lord, your servants, who trust in the help of peace and the patronage of the Blessed Mary, and make them safe from all enemies.

units.la: ANTIPHONA, DE DOMINA NOSTRA.
units.tr: ANTIPHON, CONCERNING OUR LADY.

units.la: Inviolata, intacta & casta es Maria. Quæ es effecta fulgida cœli porta. O Mater alma Christi charissima, suscipe pia laudum præconia. Nostra ut pura pectora sint & ora, (nia. Tua per precata dulcisona, Nobis concede veniam per secula. Stella maris succurre cadenti, surgere qui curat, populo.
units.tr: Inviolate, untouched and chaste are you, Mary, who have been made the bright gate of heaven. O kindly Mother, most dear to Christ, receive the devout praises of your people. That our hearts and lips may be pure, through your sweet-sounding prayers grant us pardon for all ages. Star of the sea, help the one who falls, the people who strive to rise.

units.la: Precamur te, piissima Dei genitrix, virgo Maria, per amorem unigeniti filii tui, Domini nostri Iesu Christi, ut non derelinquas nos miseros peccatores sine tuo adjutorio: sed semper adjuva & conforta nos in tuo sancto servitio, ut securi perveniamus ad portas Paradisi, ante conspectu tuum, & ut ibi mereamur dilectissimum tuum filium videre, & cum eo in sempiterna laetitia gaudere.
units.tr: We pray you, most pious Mother of God, Virgin Mary, through the love of your only-begotten Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, that you do not leave us miserable sinners without your help, but always aid and strengthen us in your holy service, so that we may come safely to the gates of Paradise, into your sight, and there merit to see your most beloved Son and rejoice with him in everlasting gladness.

units.la: Recordare virgo Maria, dum steteris in conspectu Dei, ut loquaris pro nobis bona, & ut avertat indignationem suam a nobis. Ave tu rosa, Virgo Maria generosa, Clemens & pia, Vera da nobis uti sophia, Et cum electis frui gratia, Ut te laudemus cum melodia, Et tu repelle nostra vitia, Virgo Maria da nobis gaudia.
units.tr: Remember, Virgin Mary, while you stand in the sight of God, to speak good things for us, and to turn his indignation away from us. Hail, rose, noble Virgin Mary, kind and pious; grant us true wisdom, and that with the elect we may enjoy grace, so that we may praise you with melody. And may you drive out our vices; Virgin Mary, give us joys.

units.la: Obsecramus, sanctissima virgo, libera nos ab omni malo, & ora pro peccatis nostris. O Maria generosa, Super omnes speciosa, Impetra nobis veniam. O Maria gratiosa, Dulcis, mitis, & formosa, Applica nobis gratiam. O Maria gloriosa, In deliciis deliciosa, Præpara nobis gloriam.
units.tr: We beseech you, most holy Virgin, free us from every evil, and pray for our sins. O noble Mary, beautiful above all others, obtain pardon for us. O gracious Mary, sweet, gentle and fair, apply grace to us. O glorious Mary, delightful in your delights, prepare glory for us.

units.la: Tua pia intercessione ab instantibus malis, & a morte perpetua liberemur.
units.tr: By your pious intercession, may we be freed from the evils that threaten us and from everlasting death.

units.la: EX PRÆPARATORIIS ANTE Missam dicendis.
units.tr: FROM THE PREPARATORY PRAYERS TO BE SAID BEFORE MASS.

units.la: Propter totius iniquitatis culpam, indignus sum, ut vivam, quia peccavi ab infantia mea usq; nunc coram te, & coram omnibus Sanctis tuis: sed per merita & intercessiones eorum mihi tribue, propter tuam clemen-tiam, omnium delictorum meorum veniam.
units.tr: Because of the guilt of all my iniquity, I am unworthy to live, for I have sinned from my infancy until now before you and before all your Saints. But grant me, through their merits and intercessions, and in your mercy, forgiveness of all my offences.

units.la: PRECATIONES DE QUINQUE doloribus beatæ Mariæ.
units.tr: Prayers on the Five Sorrows of the Blessed Mary.

units.la: Has S. Anshelmus composuit, singulas à singulis literis nominis Mariæ incipientes. Eas devotè recitanti maximæ gratiæ promittuntur. Revelatum est hoc omne beato Johanni Evangelistæ, qui post diuturna vota videndi Mariam virginem, postquam in cœlos assumta fuerat, tandem aliquando in cœlum raptus, in visione vidit & audivit, Mariam cum Filio de quinque; in hoc mundo suis doloribus colloquentem, & Filium in matris honorem, hos dolores devotè recolentibus plurimas gratias & prærogativas promittentem.
units.tr: St. Anselm composed these, each beginning with one of the letters of the name Mary. Great grace is promised to those who recite them devoutly. All of this was revealed to the blessed John the Evangelist, who, after long longing to see the Virgin Mary (after she had been taken up into heaven), was at last caught up into heaven. In a vision he saw and heard Mary speaking with her Son about her five sorrows in this world, and the Son promising very many graces and privileges to those who devoutly recall these sorrows, in honour of his mother.

units.la: ORATIO PRIMA.
units.tr: FIRST PRAYER.

units.la: Mediatrix Dei & hominum, & fons misericordiæ, indesinenter effundens rivos copiosæ gratiæ Maria. Te rogo dulcissima mater Domini nostri Jesu Christi, per illam perturbationem, quam habuisti in corde tuo piissimo, tunc & deinceps, cùm Simeon Sanctus & senex prophetando diceret: Tuam ipsius animam pertransibit gladius: ut petas, quatenus idem benedictus Filius tuus de largissima clementia sua, mihi donet per eandem dem perturbationem tuam, indulgentiam omnium peccatorum meorum. Et ut me liberet ab omnibus malis, præteritis, præsentibus, & futuris.
units.tr: O Mediatrix between God and men, and fountain of mercy, Mary, who ceaselessly pours out streams of abundant grace: I beg you, most sweet mother of our Lord Jesus Christ, by that distress which you felt in your most pious heart, both then and afterwards, when holy Simeon, an old man, prophesying, said: "A sword shall pierce your own soul," that you would ask that the same blessed Son of yours, out of his most generous mercy, grant me, through that same distress of yours, forgiveness of all my sins; and that he would deliver me from all evils, past, present, and future.

units.la: ORATIO SECUNDA.
units.tr: THE SECOND PRAYER.

units.la: AUxiliatrix Dei & hominū, & pacis æternæ condimentum Maria, te interpello speciosissima regina cœli, per illam dolorosam perturbationem, quam habuisti in corde tuo benignissimo, pro eo, quòd filium tuum amantissimum per triduum amiseras: ut roges eum, quatenus ipse propter eandem turbationem tuam mihi dignetur dare plenam cognitionem, perfectam contritionem, puram confessionem, spem firmam, certam securitatem, à Deo nunquam separandum, & ita perfectum & verum amorem, ut cum illo amore tantam merear mercedem in cœlo accipere, ac fi ei multis annis cum perfectione sanctissimæ vitæ diligentius servivisse.
units.tr: Mary, helper of God and men, and the seasoning of eternal peace, I entreat you, most beautiful queen of heaven, by that sorrowful distress which you bore in your most kindly heart when you had lost your most beloved son for three days. Ask him that, on account of that same distress of yours, he would deign to grant me full knowledge, perfect contrition, pure confession, firm hope, and sure assurance that I shall never be separated from God, and such perfect and true love that, with that love, I may deserve to receive such great reward in heaven as if I had served him for many years, more diligently, in the perfection of a most holy life.

units.la: ORATIO TERTIA.
units.tr: THIRD PRAYER.

units.la: REparatrix debilium, & vulneratæ animæ efficacissima medicina; Maria, te peto gloriosa Domina, per illam perturbationem, quam habuisti in corde tuo clementissimo, pro eo, quòd perfidi Judæi captivaverunt desidera-bilem unigenitū uteri tui filium, quatenus deprecaris eundem filium tuum, propitiato-rem rem seculi, ut ipse propter eandem turbationem tuam, me de omni captivitate, & ab omni tribulatione corporis & animæ, angustiarum & periculorum meorum, una cum amicis meis, consanguineis, familiaribus, & benefactoribus, & recommendatis, clementer eripiat; & ab omnibus malis in perpetuum tueatur.
units.tr: O healer of the weak and most effective medicine of the wounded soul, Mary, I beseech you, glorious Lady, by that anguish which you had in your most merciful heart, because the faithless Jews took captive the desirable only-begotten son of your womb: that you would entreat that same Son of yours, the propitiator of the world, that he, for the sake of that same distress of yours, would mercifully deliver me from all captivity and from every tribulation of body and soul, from my distresses and dangers, together with my friends, kinsfolk, family, benefactors and those commended to me, and would keep us safe from all evils for ever.

units.la: ORATIO QUARTA.
units.tr: FOURTH PRAYER.

units.la: Illuminatrix cœcorum, & lucerna salutiferæ gratiæ Maria. Te flagito, dulcissima bona Mater Dei, per illam turbationem, quam habuisti in corde tuo propitiatissimo, pro eo quod amantissimus filius tuus à Judæis crudelissimis, in conspectu tuo, cum clavis acutissimis, sine omni miseratione, vivificæ crucis patibulo fuit affixus, ut postules ab eodem filio tuo, quatenus per eandem turbationem tuam, ignem veri amoris & passionis suæ in corde meo accendat.
units.tr: Illuminator of the blind and lamp of saving grace, Mary. I entreat you, sweetest good Mother of God, by that anguish which you had in your most compassionate heart, because your most beloved son was fixed to the life-giving cross by the most cruel Jews, in your sight, with the sharpest nails and without any pity: that you would ask of the same Son of yours that, through that same anguish of yours, he would kindle in my heart the fire of true love and of his passion.

units.la: ORATIO QUINTA.
units.tr: FIFTH PRAYER.

units.la: Advocatrix omnium peccatorum, quos damnabiliter moles vitiorum deprimit, finisque nostræ miseriæ, Maria: Te deprecor, venerabilissima mundi Domina, per illam intolerabilem turbationem, quam habuisti in corde tuo benignissimo, in illa hora, cum Filius tuus de cruce depositus, cum retentibus vulneribus, & proprio sanguine rubricatus, datus fuit à Joseph in sinum tuum, ut propter eandem perturbationem tuam, ipse me prævenire dignetur abundantiâ gratiarum suarum, ut det corpus & animam meam in potestatem tuam, & in sinum misericordiæ tuæ, quem cunctis devote postulantibus clementer aperis in æternum.
units.tr: Advocate of all sinners whom the mass of their vices damnably weighs down, and end of our misery, Mary: I beseech you, most venerable Lady of the world, by that intolerable anguish which you had in your most kind heart, at that hour when your Son, taken down from the cross, with his wounds still open and reddened with his own blood, was given by Joseph into your bosom: that, for the sake of that same distress of yours, he would deign to come before me with the abundance of his graces, so that I may place my body and soul in your power and in the bosom of your mercy, which you open mercifully for ever to all who devoutly ask.

units.la: EX COMPASSIONIBUS Mariæ.
units.tr: FROM THE COMPASSIONS OF MARY.

units.la: Recordare septem horum Tormentorum, ac dolorum, Perenni memoriâ: Ut qui nos te invocamus, Per hæc sisti valeamus In perenni gloria.
units.tr: Remember these seven torments and sorrows with everlasting memory, that we who invoke you may, through them, be presented in everlasting glory.

units.la: Ad te igitur hodie, o unica spes miserorum, confugio, & plena fiducia tibi meipsum in omnibus necessitatibus devote commendo. Te hodie & semper in Matrem & Patronam, præcunctis eligo & præopto.
units.tr: To you, therefore, today, O only hope of the wretched, I flee, and with full trust I devoutly commend myself to you in all my needs. You I choose and prefer above all others, today and always, as my Mother and Patroness.

units.la: Libera me ab omni malo, & ora pro peccatis meis. Ave Maria, salus & consolatrix vivorum & mortuorum, mecum sis in omnibus tribulationibus, tentationibus, necessitatibus & angustiis meis, & maximè in hora mortis meæ, & impetra mihi omnium peccatorum meorum veniam, & cœlestis patriæ gloriam.
units.tr: Free me from every evil, and pray for my sins. Hail Mary, health and consoler of the living and the dead, be with me in all my tribulations, temptations, needs and distresses, and especially in the hour of my death, and obtain for me forgiveness of all my sins and the glory of the heavenly fatherland.

units.la: AD MISSAM, DE PIETATE
units.tr: ON THE MASS, CONCERNING DEVOTION

units.la: Domina nostra. COLLECTA.
units.tr: Our Lady. COLLECT.

units.la: Interveniat pro nobis, quæsumus Domine Jesu Christe, apud tuam sanctam clementiam nunc & in horâ mortis nostræ, piissima virgo Maria, mater tua, cujus sacratissimam animam in horâ benedictæ passionis tuæ doloris gladius pertransivit, & in gloriosissima Resurrectione tuâ ingens gaudiû lætificavit:
units.tr: Intercede for us, we beseech you, Lord Jesus Christ, with your most holy mercy, now and at the hour of our death, O most loving Virgin Mary, your mother, whose most sacred soul the sword of sorrow pierced at the hour of your blessed passion, and whom your most glorious Resurrection filled with great joy.

units.la: EX SEPTEM GAUDIIS corporalibus beatæ virginis Mariæ.
units.tr: ON THE SEVEN BODILY JOYS of the blessed Virgin Mary.

units.la: Gaude virgo, stella matris, Nos emunda à peccatis; Fac nos semper salutari Partu fœcundari; Atque corde steriles Fac clementer fertiles. Fac, à nostro scelere Piè nos resurgere. Sursum tolle variis Cor oppressum vitiis. Præsta nobis miseris Sublevamen sceleris; Et post hanc miseriam Duc ad vitæ patriam.
units.tr: Rejoice, Virgin, star of the mother; cleanse us from sins. Make us always fruitful with a saving birth, and mercifully make fruitful those who are barren in heart. Make us rise up piously from our wickedness. Lift up the heart weighed down by various vices. Grant us wretched ones relief from our crimes, and after this misery lead us to the homeland of life.

units.la: EXORATIONIBUS, DE SEptem gaudiis corporalibus beatæ Mariæ virginis.
units.tr: ON THE PRAYERS, CONCERNING THE SEVEN BODILY JOYS OF THE BLESSED VIRGIN MARY.

units.la: O Maria mater pia, Esto nobis recta via Ad tuum Filium.
units.tr: O Mary, loving mother, be for us the straight way to your Son.

units.la: Ac pro tua gratia, Depelle nostra vitia Per hoc sanctum gaudium.
units.tr: And by your grace, drive out our vices through this holy joy.

units.la: Dulcis amica Dei, rosa vernans, stella decora, Tu memor esto mei, mortis dum venerit hora.
units.tr: Sweet friend of God, flourishing rose, lovely star, remember me when the hour of death comes.

units.la: Venerandorum gaudiorum Domine gloriosæ genitricis tuæ sacrosanctæ semper virginis Mariæ memoriam recolentes, te supplices exoramus, ut ejus intervenientibus meritis, cœlestis consolationis participes, & gaudii, quo tecum modo lætatur, in futuro tribuas esse consortes.
units.tr: Calling to mind the venerable joys of the Lord, and the memory of his glorious mother, the holy and ever-virgin Mary, we humbly beseech you that, by her intercessions, you would make us sharers in heavenly consolation and in that joy with which she rejoices with you, and grant that we may be partners in it in the future.

units.la: DE SEPTEM GAUDIIS MARIÆ.
units.tr: CONCERNING THE SEVEN JOYS OF MARY.

units.la: GRADUALE.
units.tr: GRADUAL.

units.la: Omnes cum lætitia, Nunc Deo jubilate, Mariæ sanctæ gaudia, Devote celebrate, Ut cœli pandat limina, In hymnis hanc laudate.
units.tr: All of you with gladness, now shout with joy to God; devoutly celebrate the holy joys of Mary, that she may open the gates of heaven; praise her in hymns.

units.la: SEQUENTIA.
units.tr: SEQUENCE.

units.la: Gaude virgo gloriosa, Ex stirpe Davidica, Scripturarum vera glossa, Peccatorum spes Maria: M Præbe laudes personare, Gaudia tua decantare, Nulla vox nec lingua quarę Plenè te sufficit laudare. Gaude, cum Angelo saris, A pneumate fœcundaris, Lucidior es stella maris, Et verus splendor solaris. Ave cum gratiâ plena, Recepisti mente serenâ, Et concepisti filium, O quantum tibi gaudium! Gaude Engaddina vitis, Culta pulchris margaritis, Botrum dulcem paris mitis, Fugantem malum aspidis. Porta nunc Ezechielis Clausa fuisti fidelis, Quando creator de cœlis Exivit claustris non læsis. Gaude quòd tres Magi sagi Tribus donis bonis quærunt, Aurum, thus, myrrham ferentes, Deum verum natum, Gnatum tuum, suum Regem, Legem viæ à stella rimantes. Gaude, quòd ad templum isti, Natum tuum obtulisti, A vidua didicisti, Et à Propheta audisti Benedictionem dictam: Suspendamus Prophetiam De laesione gladii Jam tempore gaudii. Gaude Christi victoria Figitur in memoria Cum Leo de tribu Juda Surgit a mundi scoria. Contra Gabaon Sol stetit, Cum Christus victor extitit, Phlegethontis antra trivit, Dum a morte resurrexit. Gaudent supernorum cives, Quando natus tuus dives Mox aethera transfilivit, Arcemq; coeli transcendit. Tibi o virgo Maria Ingentia tunc gaudia Per filium sunt impressa, Qui transvolavit aethera. Gaude virgo, quatuor seni Tibi psallunt laude pleni In ascensu tuo leni, Ad coelos, dic mihi, veni. Ad tam dulcia gaudia Atque sancta cantica, Sic nos barathri squalida Non trucident per secula. Amen.
units.tr: Rejoice, glorious virgin, of the stock of David, the true gloss of the Scriptures, Mary, the hope of sinners. Grant that we may sound forth praises, and sing your joys; no voice or tongue is sufficient to praise you fully. Rejoice, for you were greeted by the angel, and were made fruitful by the Spirit; you are the brighter star of the sea and the true splendour of the sun. Hail, full of grace; with a serene mind you received, and you conceived a son. O how great your joy! Rejoice, vine of Engedi, cultivated with beautiful pearls, you gently bear a sweet cluster, driving away the poison of the asp. Now you are the gate of Ezekiel, faithfully kept shut, when the Creator came forth from the heavens through the unharmed cloisters. Rejoice that the three wise Magi sought with three good gifts, bearing gold, frankincense and myrrh, the true God born, your Son, their King, tracing by the star the law of the way. Rejoice that you offered your son in the temple; you learned from the widow, and from the prophet you heard the blessing spoken: let us set aside the prophecy of the wound of the sword, now in a time of joy. Rejoice, the victory of Christ is fixed in memory, when the Lion of the tribe of Judah rises from the dross of the world. Against Gibeon the sun stood still, when Christ was victorious; he trod the caves of Phlegethon, when he rose from death. The citizens of heaven rejoice, when your rich Son soon leapt through the heavens and passed beyond the citadel of heaven. For you, O virgin Mary, then great joys were impressed through the Son, who flew through the heavens. Rejoice, virgin: the four and twenty elders, full of praise, sing to you at your gentle ascent to the heavens. Tell me, come! To such sweet joys and holy canticles, so may the foul pit of hell not slay us for ages. Amen.

units.la: EX SEPTEM GAUDIIS cœlestibus beatæ Mariæ virginis.
units.tr: THE SEVEN HEAVENLY JOYS OF THE BLESSED VIRGIN MARY.

units.la: Gaude mater miserorum,Quia pater præmiorumDabit te colentibusCongruentem hic mercedem,Et felicem poli sedem,Sursum in cœlestibus.
units.tr: Rejoice, mother of the wretched, because the Father of rewards will give you, to those who honour you, a fitting reward here, and a happy seat of heaven on high among the heavenly things.

units.la: In Feriis Paschalibus.
units.tr: On the Days of Easter.

units.la: Regina cœli lætare, Halleluja,Quia quam meruisti portare, Halleluja,Resurrexit, sicut dixit, Halleluja.Ora pro nobis Deum, Halleluja,Versus: Gaude Dei genitrix, Halleluja,Quia surrexit filius tuus, Halleluja.
units.tr: Queen of heaven, rejoice, Alleluia, because He whom you were worthy to bear, Alleluia, has risen as He said, Alleluia. Pray for us to God, Alleluia. Verse: Rejoice, Mother of God, Alleluia, because your Son has risen, Alleluia.

units.la: ORATIO.
units.tr: PRAYER.

units.la: Proficit nobis, quæsumus, Omnipotens pater, & præcipuè inter hæc Paschalia Filii tui solennia continuata intemeratæ Dei genitricis & virginis Mariæ memoria, quæ & adstitit, vulnerata charitate, in cruce pendenti, & nunc astat à dextris, regina, in cœlo regnanti.
units.tr: We ask, almighty Father, that the continued remembrance of the immaculate Mother of God and Virgin Mary may benefit us, especially among these Paschal solemnities of your Son. She both stood by, wounded with love, at the cross where He hung, and now stands at the right hand of Him who reigns in heaven as queen.

units.la: Dulcissime Domine Jesu Christe, qui beatissimam genitricem tuam, gloriosissimam virginem Mariam, perpetuis & felicibus gaudiis in cœlo lætificasti, concede propitius, ut ejus meritis & precibus continuis salute & prosperitatem animæ & corporis consequamur, & ad gaudia beatitudinis, ac ejusdem virginis gloriosæ feliciter perveniamus.
units.tr: Most sweet Lord Jesus Christ, who gladdened your most blessed mother, the most glorious Virgin Mary, with perpetual and happy joys in heaven, graciously grant, through her merits and continual prayers, that we may obtain health and prosperity of soul and body, and may happily come to the joys of blessedness and to the same glorious Virgin.

units.la: EX ROSARIO BEATÆ MARIA virginis.
units.tr: FROM THE ROSARY OF THE BLESSED VIRGIN MARY.

units.la: O virtutum vasculum, Regina cælorum, Christi receptaculum, Salus anxiorum. Tutum propugnaculum, Salvatrix languidorum Audi conquerentium, Preces famulorum, Et pro nobis miseris, Deum deprecare. Nam quicquid petieris, Vales impetrare. Summa nos necessitas, Te cogit rogare, Quos in fluctu positos, Saevum pulsat mare. Reparatrix & Salvatrix Desperantis animæ, Irroratrix & largitrix Spiritualis gratiæ. Quod requiro, ꝑ suspiro, Mea fana vulnera. Et da menti, te poscêti, Gratiarum munera, Ut sim castus & modestus, Dulcis, fortis, sobrius, Pius, rectus, circumspect, Simultatis nescius, Eruditus & munitus Divinis eloquiis, Constans, gravis & suavis, Benignus, amabilis, Corde prudens, oratudens Veritatem dicere: Malu nolés, Deu volens Pio semper opere, Peccatorum consolatrix, infirmorum curatrix, errantium revocatrix, justorum confirmatrix, desolatorum spes & auxiliatrix, atque mea promptissima adjutrix, & singularissima invocatrix, tibi Domina gloriosa,
units.tr: O vessel of virtues, Queen of heaven, receptacle of Christ, health of the troubled, sure bulwark, saviour of the weak: hear the complaints of your servants, their prayers, and pray to God for us wretched ones. For whatever you ask, you can obtain. Our great need compels us to beseech you, we whom the savage sea beats, placed in the waves. Restorer and saviour of the despairing soul, dispenser and giver of spiritual grace: what I seek, I sigh for, heal my wounds, and give to my mind, which asks you, the gifts of grace, so that I may be chaste and modest, gentle, brave, sober, devout, upright, circumspect, ignorant of pretence, learned and armed with the divine oracles, steadfast, dignified and kind, benign, lovable, prudent of heart, discreet of speech, to speak the truth, unwilling to do evil, willing toward God, always in pious work. Consoler of sinners, healer of the sick, recaller of the wandering, confirmer of the just, hope and helper of the forsaken, and my most ready helper and most singular advocate, to you, glorious Lady,

units.la: M 3 ... comcommendo hodie & quotidie animam meam, ut me in tuam custodiam commendatum, ab omnibus malis & fraudibus diaboli custodias, atque in hora mortis constanter mihi assistas, ac animam ad aeterna gaudia feliciter perducas.
units.tr: I commend my soul today and every day, that, commended to your keeping, you would guard me from all evils and the frauds of the devil, and that at the hour of death you would stand constantly by me and lead my soul happily to eternal joys.

units.la: O Domina mea sancta Maria, me in tuam benedictam fidem & singularem custodiam, ac in sinum misericordiae tuae, hodie & quotidie, atque in hora exitus mei, animam meam, & corpus meum, tibi commendo: omnem spem meam, consolationes, angustias, miserias, & finem vitae meae committo: rogans, ut per tuam sanctissimam intercessionem & gloriosa merita, omnia mea dirigantur & disponantur opera, secundum tuam, mique filii voluntatem, ad meam utilitatem.
units.tr: O my holy Lady Mary, into your blessed faithfulness and singular keeping, and into the bosom of your mercy, today and every day, and at the hour of my departure, I commend to you my soul and my body. I commit to you all my hope, my consolations, my distresses, my miseries, and the end of my life, asking that through your most holy intercession and glorious merits, all my works may be directed and ordered according to your will and that of your Son, for my good.

units.la: Precor, ut serves me a peccatis, a scandalis, ab omni confusione humana, ab iraju-dicii tremenda, ab impuris cogitationibus, ab omni mortali peccato, a subitanea & improvisa morte, ab omnibus periculis animae & corporis, honoris & rerum mearum, nec unquam tale me perinittas facere peccatum, quo tuam gratiam amittam. Dona mihi de praeteritis emendationem, de praesentibus custodiam, de futuris cautelam. Da mihi in hac vita promptum adjutorium, & esto prolocutrix in tremendo judicio, ad tuum Filium, Dominum Deum nostrum Jesum Christum.
units.tr: I pray that you keep me from sins, from scandals, from every human disgrace, from the dread of the terrible judgment, from impure thoughts, from every mortal sin, from sudden and unforeseen death, and from all dangers to soul and body, to my honour and my goods; and never permit me to commit such a sin that I lose your grace. Grant me amendment for the past, watchfulness for the present, caution for the future. Give me ready help in this life, and be my advocate at the terrible judgment before your Son, our Lord God Jesus Christ.

units.la: O Domina dulcissima, misericordiæ visceribus plenissima, succurre mihi misero peccatori, antequam mors subitanea & impensa visa superveniat, ne subitò & imparatus hinc discedam. Ora pro me Maria, virgo benedicta, ob unigeniti Filii tui amantissimam mortem, ut peccatorum detestatione, Diaboli & operum ejus abrenuntiatione, verâ contritione, purâ humilique confessione, perfectâ pœnitentiâ & satisfactione, proximi dilectione, filio tuo reconciliatus, de hoc mundo transeam: & fac mecum misericordiam tuam, ô beata mater virgo Maria, in illâ tremendâ horâ, quando mortua lingua se nequiverit movere ad invocandum te, neque oculi lucem capere poterunt, auresque meæ nulli voci patescent. Memor esto tunc precum mearum, quas nunc fundo. O Maria, ad aures tuæ pietatis, & subveni mihi in illa ultimâ necessitatis meæ horâ, ut liberatus à ministris diaboli, collocer cum fidelibus & amicis filii tui.
units.tr: O most sweet Lady, most full of the bowels of mercy, help me, a wretched sinner, before sudden and unforeseen death comes upon me, lest I depart hence unprepared and unready. Pray for me, Mary, blessed Virgin, by the most loving death of your only-begotten Son, that, reconciled to your Son through detestation of sins, renunciation of the devil and his works, true contrition, pure and humble confession, perfect repentance and satisfaction, and love of neighbour, I may pass from this world. And show me your mercy, O blessed Mother Virgin Mary, in that dreadful hour, when my dead tongue will be unable to move to invoke you, nor my eyes be able to take light, and my ears be closed to every voice. Be mindful then of my prayers, which I now pour out. O Mary, turn to the ears of your piety, and help me in that last hour of my need, so that, freed from the ministers of the devil, I may be placed with the faithful and friends of your Son.

units.la: Ave plena gratiâ, virgo fœcunda, mundi spes & gloria, mater illibata, peccatorum venia, sponsa consecrata, consolatrix hominum, vinculum amoris, purgatrix peccaminum, medela vitiorum. Ave vas clemen- tiae, gratiae piscina, portus indulgentiae, vi- tae medicina, veniae pincerna. Nardus odorifera, gratiae lucerna, surge, veni, propera regina superna, me Christo confoedera, me semper guberna, cor meum illumina, fulgens stella maris, & ab hostis machina sper tueatis.
units.tr: Hail, full of grace, fruitful virgin, hope and glory of the world, unblemished mother, forgiveness of sinners, consecrated bride, comforter of men, bond of love, cleanser of sins, remedy of vices. Hail, vessel of mercy, pool of grace, harbour of indulgence, medicine of life, cupbearer of pardon. Fragrant spikenard, lamp of grace: rise, come, hasten, queen on high; join me in covenant with Christ, always guide me, enlighten my heart, shining star of the sea, and protect me from the enemy's snares.

units.la: O gloriosa virgo Maria, mater Regis aeterni, libera nos ab omni malo, & a poenis inferni.
units.tr: O glorious Virgin Mary, mother of the eternal King, deliver us from every evil and from the pains of hell.

units.la: PROSA, IN LAUDEM virginis Mariae.
units.tr: A PROSE, IN PRAISE OF the Virgin Mary.

units.la: Gaude Maria, templum summae majestatis. Salva nos & omnes conserva, per omnia saecula saeculorum. Amen.
units.tr: Rejoice, Mary, temple of supreme majesty. Save us and keep us all, for all ages of ages. Amen.

units.la: DE DOMINA nostra.
units.tr: CONCERNING OUR LADY.

units.la: Te collaudat coelestis curia, Quae mater es regis & filia, Per te Regis donatur venia, Per te justis confertur gratia. Ergo maris stella Natum tuum ora, Ut nos solvat a peccatis, Et in regno claritatis, Quo lux lucet sedula, Collocet per secula. Amen.
units.tr: The heavenly court praises you, who are both mother and daughter of the King. Through you the King grants pardon, and through you grace is bestowed on the just. Therefore, star of the sea, pray to your Son for us, that he may free us from our sins and set us in the kingdom of brightness, where the light shines without ceasing, for ever and ever. Amen.

units.la: SEQVENS IN LAVDEM virginis.
units.tr: A SEQUENCE IN PRAISE OF THE VIRGIN.

units.la: Pulchrior sideribus,Et præ mulieribusCunctis benedicta,Placa tuum filium,Et purga fideliumOmnium delicta.In te pluit,In te fluitDeus suam gratiam:
units.tr: More beautiful than the stars, and blessed above all women, appease your Son and purge the sins of all the faithful. In you God rains down, in you he flows, pouring out his grace.

units.la: Ergo tuæNobis plueGratię clementiam.Ad beatiTui natiTransferas præsetiā.Et cunctorumDelictorumCófer indulgentiā.
units.tr: Therefore, for us rain down the mercy of your grace. Bring us into the presence of your blessed Son, and grant pardon for all our offences.

units.la: ET: Tu spes certa miserorum, Veré mater orphanorum, Medicamen infirmorum, Omnibus es omnia.
units.tr: And: You are the sure hope of the wretched, truly the mother of orphans, the medicine of the sick; to all you are all things.

units.la: ET EX MISSALI PARISIENSI.
units.tr: AND FROM THE PARISIAN MISSAL.

units.la: O felix puerpera Nostra pians selera, Jure matris impera Redemtori.
units.tr: O happy mother, who atones for our crimes, by a mother's right command the Redeemer.

units.la: EX ORATIONE, QVÆ DICENDA sit die Sabbathi, in honorem Mariæ.
units.tr: FROM A PRAYER TO BE SAID ON THE SABBATH DAY, IN HONOUR OF MARY.

units.la: Imperatrix reginarum, Dominus tecum.
units.tr: Empress of queens, the Lord is with thee.

units.la: Laus Sanctarum animarum, Dominus tecum.
units.tr: Praise of holy souls, the Lord is with thee.

units.la: Vera salvatrix earum, Dominus tecum.
units.tr: True saviour of them, the Lord is with thee.

units.la: Mediatrix Dei & hominum, Dominus tecum. Indeficiens gaudium, Dominus tecum.Via errantium, Dominus tecum.Salus omnium in te sperantium, Dominus tecum.
units.tr: Mediatrix between God and men, the Lord is with thee. Unfailing joy, the Lord is with thee. Way of those who wander, the Lord is with thee. Salvation of all who hope in thee, the Lord is with thee.

units.la: EX ANTIDOTARIO.
units.tr: FROM THE ANTIDOTARY.

units.la: Salve Imperatrix gloriosissima, peccatricis animæ meæ spes tutissima, Dei genitrix virgo Maria. Tu post Deum, præcipuum & maximum meum es refugium & gaudium.
units.tr: Hail, most glorious Empress, the most secure hope of my sinful soul, Mary, Virgin Mother of God. After God, you are my chief and greatest refuge and joy.

units.la: ORATIONEM SEQUENTEM diebus triginta dicturus, in honorem Mariæ virginis, quæcunque licita petierit, misericorditer obtinebit.
units.tr: THE FOLLOWING PRAYER, to be said for thirty days in honour of the Virgin Mary, will mercifully obtain whatever lawful thing one asks for.

units.la: Sancta Maria, perpetua virgo virginum, mater misericordiæ, mater gratiæ, spes omnium desolatorum, consolatrix omnium desperantium. O miseratrix miserorum, dulcis consolatio afflictorum, ac mater misericordiarum, desolatorum piissima consolatrix, & in omni necessitate pupillorum promta adjutrix: Exaudi preces meas. Et quia in divertis malis & angustiis, propter peccata mea, positus sum, ignoro ad quem fugiam, nisi ad te Dominam meam, dulcissimam virginem Mariam, genitricem Domini nostri Jesu Christi, informatricem humanitatis nostræ. Ergo aures tuæ pietatis precib' meis benignè accomaccommoda, per viscera mifericordissimi Filii tui, &c.
units.tr: Holy Mary, perpetual virgin of virgins, mother of mercy, mother of grace, hope of all the forsaken, comforter of all who despair. O merciful one of the wretched, sweet consolation of the afflicted, and mother of mercies, most devoted comforter of the desolate, and ready helper in every need of orphans: hear my prayers. And since, on account of my sins, I am placed in various evils and distresses, I know not where to flee but to you, my Lady, most sweet Virgin Mary, mother of our Lord Jesus Christ, shaper of our humanity. Therefore incline the ears of your loving-kindness to my prayers, through the tender mercies of your most merciful Son, etc.

units.la: ORATIO, PRÆSCRIPTA AB INnocentio Papa. Quam qui in honorem Mariæ quotidie dixerit, ad dies trecentos indulgentias habebit.
units.tr: A PRAYER PRESCRIBED BY POPE INNOCENT. Whoever says it daily in honour of Mary will have indulgences for three hundred days.

units.la: O clementissima Domina, & dulcissima virgo Sancta Maria, mater Dei, mater orphanorum, consolatio desolatorum, via errantium, salus & spes in te sperantium, fons vitæ & veniæ, fons salutis & gratiæ, fons pietatis & indulgentiæ, fons consolationis & lætitiæ, da mihi pro peccatis meis veras plangendi lachrymas & condignas, & da mihi, quicquid filius tuus requisivit a me veraciter agnoscere, tuo juvamine frequenter incipere, perseveranter exequi, feliciter adimplere. O slos virginum Maria, regina cœli, deprecor humiliter & devote, ut cum omnibus Sanctis electis Dei venias & festines in consilium & & auxilium meum, in omnibus orationibus, & angustiis, & necessitatibus meis, & in omnibus rebus. O Maria, maris stella, portus salutis, naufragantium dux pia, miserorum patrona dulcissima, reorum advocata doctissima, desperatorum spes unica, peccatorum salvatrix magnifica, die meâ novissimâ, me facie splendidissimâ tuâ, pre-cor, irradia, nutrix sacratissima, meæ mortis piissima diem & horam nuntia. Tu portum|praebe naufrago, reo fer patroci-nia, dans misero solatia, si ipes, ne desperatione succumbam mortis in agone, cum tunc non sit ipes altera, Nisi tu virgo puerpera, Partis parens & filia, Cui me reconcilia.
units.tr: O most merciful Lady, and sweetest Virgin Saint Mary, Mother of God, mother of orphans, comfort of the desolate, way of the wandering, salvation and hope of those who trust in you, fount of life and pardon, fount of salvation and grace, fount of loving-kindness and indulgence, fount of consolation and joy: give me, for my sins, true and fitting tears of lament, and grant that whatever your Son has required of me I may truly acknowledge, begin frequently with your help, carry on perseveringly, and bring to happy completion. O rose of virgins Mary, queen of heaven, I humbly and devoutly beseech you that, with all the elect Saints of God, you would come quickly to my counsel and aid, in all my prayers, distresses and needs, and in all things. O Mary, star of the sea, harbour of salvation, devoted leader of the shipwrecked, sweetest patroness of the wretched, most learned advocate of the guilty, sole hope of the despairing, magnificent saviour of sinners, on my last day I pray that you shine upon me with your most radiant face, most holy nurse, and most loving announcer of the day and hour of my death. Offer a harbour to the shipwrecked, give patronage to the guilty, bring comfort to the wretched, lest I, in the agony of death, succumb to despair, since then there will be no other hope, except you, Virgin who bore a child, parent and daughter of your Son, to whom reconcile me.

units.la: O misericordiarum & veniae fos inevacuabilis, imo ipsa misericordia & venia, nulli dans repulsam. Exauditrix benignissima, hanc orationem supplicem clementer fusci-pias & exaudias, & vitam aeternam mihi tribuas. Audi & exaudi me benignissima virgo Maria, mater Dei & misericordiae, Amen.
units.tr: O inexhaustible fount of mercies and pardon, indeed mercy and pardon itself, refusing none. Most kind hearer, mercifully receive and hear this humble prayer, and grant me eternal life. Hear me and listen to me, most kind Virgin Mary, Mother of God and of mercy. Amen.

units.la: ORATIUNCULA AD MARIAM virginem. Hanc qui quotidie devote dixerit, sine poenitentia & mysterio corporis Christi non decedet.
units.tr: A SHORT PRAYER TO THE VIRGIN MARY. Whoever says it devoutly every day will not depart without repentance and the mystery of the body of Christ.

units.la: Ave Maria, ancilla Sanctae Trinitatis, Ave Maria, salus & consolatrix vivorum & mortuorum, mecum sis in omnibus tentationibus, tribulationibus, necessitatibus, & angustiis, & infirmitatibus meis, & impetra mihi veniam omnium delictorum meorum, & maxime in hora exitus mei, non defis mihi o piissima virgo Maria.
units.tr: Hail Mary, handmaid of the Holy Trinity. Hail Mary, salvation and comforter of the living and the dead. Be with me in all temptations, tribulations, needs and distresses, and in my infirmities, and obtain for me forgiveness of all my offences, and especially in the hour of my departure, O most loving Virgin Mary, do not fail me.

units.la: Alia oratio ad B. Virginem Mariam.
units.tr: Another prayer to the Blessed Virgin Mary.

units.la: Te, mater illuminationis cordis mei, te, nutrix salutis, mentis meae te obsecrant, quan-tum tum possunt, cuncta, praecordia mea. Exaudi Domina, adesto propitia, adjuva potentissima, ut mundentur sordes mentis meæ, ut illuminentur tenebræ meæ. Certus enim sum, quia sicut per filii gratiam ea potui accipere, sic eadem per Matris merita possum recipere. Ergo Domina, porta vitæ, janua salutis, via reconciliationis, aditus recuperationis, obsecro te per salvatricem tuam fecunditatem, fac, ut peccatorum meorum mihi venia, & bene vivendi gratia concedatur, & usque finem hic servus tuus sub tua protectione custodiatur.
units.tr: You, mother of the illumination of my heart, you, nurse of my salvation, my mind and all my inmost heart beseech with all their power. Hear me, Lady, be present in mercy, help me, most powerful one, that the stains of my mind may be cleansed and my darkness enlightened. For I am certain that, just as through the grace of your Son I was able to receive these things, so through the merits of the Mother I can receive them again. Therefore, Lady, gate of life, door of salvation, way of reconciliation, entrance to recovery, I beg you, by your saving fruitfulness, that forgiveness of my sins be granted to me, and the grace of living well, and that your servant be kept under your protection here until the end.

units.la: AD EANDEM MARIAM.
units.tr: TO THE SAME MARY.

units.la: Ave præclara stella maris, in lucem gentium Maria divinitus orta. Euge Dei porta, quæ non aperta, veritatis lumen, ipsum solem justitiæ indutum carne, ducis in orbem. Virgo decus mundi, regina cœli præelecta, ut sol pulchra, luminas ut fulgor, agnosce omnes te diligentes. Te plenam fide virgam almæ stirpis Jesse nascituram priores desiderant Patres & Prophetæ. Te lignum vitæ sancto rorante pneumate, pariturum divini floris amygdalum signavit Gabriel. Tu Agnum, regem terræ, dominatorem Moabitici de petra deserti, ad montem filiæ Sion traduxisti. Tuq; furentem Leviathan, serpentem tortuosum q; & vectem collidens, damnoso crimine mundum dum exemisti. Hinc gentium nos reliquiæ, quæ sub cultu memoriæ, mirum in modum, quem es enixa propitiationis agnum regnantem coelo æternaliter, devocamus ad aram maclandum mysterialiter. Hinc manna verum, Israelitis veris veri Abrahæ filiis admirantibus, quondam Moysi typus figurabat. Jam nunc abducto velo datur percipi. Ora virgo nos illo pane cœlo dignos effici. Fac fontem dulcem, quem in deserto petra demonstravit, degustare cum sincerâ fide, renesque constringi lotos in mari anguem æneum in cruce speculari. Fac igni Sancto, patrisque Verbo, quod rubus ut flammam, tu portasti virgo mater facta, pecuali pelle distinctos pedes, mundis labiis cordeq; propinquare. Audi nos. Nam te Filius nihil negans honorat, Salva nos Jesu, pro quibus virmater te orat. Da fontem boni visere: Da puros mentis oculos in te defigere. Quo hausto sapientiæ saporem vitæ valeat mens intelligere, Christianismi fidem operibus redimere, beatoque fine ex hujus incolatu seculi ad te transire. Amen.
units.tr: Hail, bright star of the sea, Mary, divinely risen into the light of the nations. Hail, gate of God, which was not opened, bringing the light of truth into the world, the very sun of righteousness clothed in flesh. Virgin, glory of the world, queen of heaven chosen beforehand, beautiful as the sun, shining as the splendour of light, acknowledge all who love you. The Fathers and Prophets long for you, full of faith, the rod who was to be born from the root of the nourishing stock of Jesse. Gabriel marked you, the tree of life, who was to bear the almond of the divine flower, with the holy Spirit dewing you. You led the Lamb, King of the earth, the ruler of the Moabite, from the rock of the desert to the mount of the daughter of Zion. And you, by crushing the raging Leviathan, the twisted serpent, and the bar, have freed the world from its ruinous crime. Hence we, remnant of the nations, who under the worship of memory, wondrously, call to the altar the Lamb of propitiation whom you bore, reigning in heaven for ever, to be sacrificed in a mystical manner. Hence the true manna, which once Moses prefigured as a type, marvelled at by the true Israelites, the true sons of Abraham. Now the veil is lifted and it is given to be perceived. Virgin, pray that we may be made worthy of that heavenly bread. Grant that we may taste with sincere faith the sweet fountain which the rock showed in the desert, and that our loins, washed in the sea, may be girded, and that we may gaze upon the brazen serpent on the cross. Grant that, with pure lips and heart, we may draw near to the holy fire and the Word of the Father, which as a flame the bush bore, you, having become a mother, bearing feet distinguished by a sheepskin. Hear us. For the Son, refusing you nothing, honours you; save us, Jesus, for whom the Virgin Mother prays to you. Grant us to behold the fountain of goodness; grant us to fix the pure eyes of the mind on you. Once we have drunk of it, may the mind be able to understand the savour of wisdom of life, to redeem the faith of Christianity by works, and, at a blessed end, to pass from the sojourn of this age to you. Amen.

units.la: ALIA:
units.tr: ANOTHER:

units.la: Verbum bonum & suave Personemus, illud Ave, Per quod Christi fit conclave Virgo, mater, filia.
units.tr: Let us sound forth the good and sweet word, that Ave, through which the Virgin, mother and daughter, becomes the chamber of Christ.

units.la: Per quod Ave salutata,Mox concepit fœcundata,Virgo, David stirpe nata,Inter spinas lilium.
units.tr: Through which Ave, greeted, she straightway conceived and was made fruitful: the Virgin, born of the stock of David, a lily among thorns.

units.la: Ave veri SalomonisMadens vellus Gedeonis,Cujus Magi tribus donisLaudant puerperium.
units.tr: Hail, true Solomon's bride, moistened fleece of Gideon, whose birth the Magi praise with three gifts.

units.la: Ave sponsa verbi summi,Maris partus, signum dumi,Aromatum virga fumi,Angelorum domina.
units.tr: Hail, bride of the highest Word, offspring of the sea, sign of the bush, branch of fragrant smoke, lady of the angels.

units.la: Ave, solem genuisti,Ave, prolem protulisti,Mundo lapso contulistiVitam & imperium.
units.tr: Hail, you bore the sun; hail, you brought forth the offspring. To the fallen world you gave life and dominion.

units.la: Supplicamus, nos emenda,Emendatos nos commendaTuo nato, ad habendaSempiterna gaudia, Amen.
units.tr: We pray: amend us, and commend us, amended, to your Son, to possess the everlasting joys. Amen.

units.la: ET:
units.tr: AND:

units.la: Omnis homo, omni horā,Hanc adora, ac imploraEjus patrocinia.
units.tr: Every man, at every hour, adore her and implore her patronage.

units.la: Psalle, psalle nisu totoCordis, oris, voce, voto.Ave, plena gratiā.
units.tr: Sing, sing with all the effort of heart, mouth, voice and vow: Hail, full of grace.

units.la: Salve decus firmamenti,Tu caliginosæ mentiDesuper irradia, Placa mare maris stella,Ne involvat nos procella,Et tempestas valida.Virgo mater Maria, mater misericor-diæ, nos adjuva.
units.tr: Hail, glory of the firmament; shine from above upon the mind darkened by mist. Star of the sea, calm the sea, lest the storm engulf us and the violent tempest. Virgin Mother Mary, mother of mercy, help us.

units.la: ORATIO, CORAM IMAGINE B. Mariæ virginis in folio dicenda, à Sixto compositâ, cum indulgentiis undecim millium annorum.
units.tr: PRAYER, TO BE SAID BEFORE AN IMAGE OF THE BLESSED VIRGIN MARY ON A LEAF, composed by Sixtus, with indulgences of eleven thousand years.

units.la: Ave Sanctissima mater Dei, Regina cœli, porta Paradisi, Domina mundi, libera me ab omni malo. Ora pro peccato meo. Amen.
units.tr: Hail, most holy Mother of God, Queen of heaven, gate of Paradise, Lady of the world, deliver me from every evil. Pray for my sin. Amen.

units.la: O Regina poli, Mater gratissima proli, Spernere me noli, me commendo tibi foli. Per virginem Matrem concedat nobis Dominus salutem & pacem.
units.tr: O Queen of heaven, most pleasing mother of the child, do not spurn me; I commend myself to you alone. Through the Virgin Mother may the Lord grant us salvation and peace.

units.la: Ora pro nobis Sancta Dei genitrix, ut digni efficiamur promissionibus Christi.
units.tr: Holy Mother of God, pray for us, that we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.

units.la: Deus, qui virginalem aulam beatæ Mariæ, in quâ habitares, eligere dignatus es, da quæ-sumus, ut suâ nos defensione munitos, jucundos suæ faciat interesse commemorationi.
units.tr: O God, who were pleased to choose the virginal hall of the blessed Mary, in which you dwelt, grant, we beseech you, that, fortified by her defence, we may be made glad to share in her commemoration.

units.la: Adesto supplicationibus nostris, piissima Dei genitrix, virgo virginum Maria.
units.tr: Be present to our supplications, most pious Mother of God, Mary, Virgin of virgins.

units.la: Ad te, pia mater, confugimus, ut præsto nobis sit tua defensio, & qui districti judicis iram timemus, dum graviter deliquisse sumus, conscii, ipsum videre non audemus, ad te ejus Matrem confugimus, ut pro nobis apud Deum intervenias, & excusa scelera nostra, omnipotentis filii tui gratiam nobis impetrans, referas cunctorum, quae committimus, indulgentiam.
units.tr: To you, loving mother, we flee, so that your protection may stand ready for us. We who fear the anger of the strict judge, since we know we have sinned grievously and dare not look upon him, flee to you, his Mother, that you may intercede for us with God, excuse our crimes, obtain for us the grace of your almighty Son, and secure for us the pardon of all the sins we commit.

units.la: EX OFFICIO BEATÆ MARIÆ virginis, anno 1598. edito.
units.tr: FROM THE OFFICE OF THE BLESSED VIRGIN MARY, published in 1598.

units.la: O Regina mundi, scala caeli, thronus Dei, janua Paradisi, dele peccata, relaxa facinora, erige lapsos, solve compeditos, perre succidantur vepres & germina vitiorum, praebeantur flores & ornamenta virtutum, placa precibus judicem.
units.tr: O Queen of the world, ladder of heaven, throne of God, gate of Paradise: blot out sins, remit crimes, raise up the fallen, loose the bound; let the thorns and shoots of vices be cut down, and let the flowers and ornaments of virtues be given; appease the judge with prayers.

units.la: ORATIO, DE OMNIBUS MEMBRIS beatissimæ virginis Mariæ, quam qui devote dixerit, specialem ab ea gratiam consequetur.
units.tr: PRAYER ON ALL THE MEMBERS OF THE MOST BLESSED VIRGIN MARY, which whoever says devoutly will obtain a special grace from her.

units.la: Adoro & benedico beatissimos pedes tuos, quibus antiqui serpentis, cum omnibus pompis ejus, caput calcasti, &c.
units.tr: I adore and bless your most blessed feet, with which you crushed the head of the ancient serpent together with all his pomp, etc.

units.la: Adoro & benedico castissimum uterum tuum, acervo tritici liliis candidissimis vallato comparatum, &c.
units.tr: I adore and bless your most chaste womb, likened to a heap of wheat walled about with most white lilies, etc.

units.la: Adoro & benedico nobilissimum cor tuum, &c.
units.tr: I adore and bless your most noble heart, etc.

units.la: Adoro & benedico fœcundissima ubera tua botris assimilata, &c.
units.tr: I adore and bless your most fruitful breasts, likened to clusters of grapes, etc.

units.la: Adoro & benedico manus tuas tornatiles, plenas hyacinthis, &c.
units.tr: I adore and bless your shapely hands, full of hyacinths, etc.

units.la: FESTA
units.tr: FEASTS

units.la: HORRENDA EXEMPLA FESTA IN HONOREM ET cultum S. Mariæ.
units.tr: HORRIBLE EXAMPLES: THE FESTIVALS IN HONOUR AND WORSHIP OF THE HOLY MARY.

units.la: I. FESTO CONCEPTIONIS Mariæ. 8. Decembris.
units.tr: I. THE FEAST OF THE CONCEPTION OF MARY. 8 December.

units.la: Tu spes certa miserorum, Plaga nobis, qui te fecit
units.tr: You, the sure hope of the wretched, a scourge to us who made you

units.la: Vera Mater orphanorum, Matrem sibi, quam elegit,
units.tr: True mother of orphans, the mother whom he chose for himself,

units.la: Tu levamen oppressorum, Ade sto jam supplicibus
units.tr: You, the relief of the oppressed, stand now by the suppliants,

units.la: Medicamen infirmorum, Tuis, faveto precibus,
units.tr: Remedy of the sick, be gracious to your people's prayers.

units.la: Omnibus es Domina. Manum benigne porrige,
units.tr: You are Lady of all. Stretch out your hand graciously,

units.la: Te laudamus voce pari, Utramque nostram dirige.
units.tr: We praise you with one voice; direct us both.

units.la: Laude digna singulari, Maria mater gratiæ,
units.tr: Worthy of singular praise, Mary, mother of grace,

units.la: Ut errantes in hoc mari, Mater misericordiæ,
units.tr: That we who wander on this sea, mother of mercy,

units.la: Nos in portu salutari, Tu nos ab hoste protege,
units.tr: Into the harbour of salvation, protect us from the enemy.

units.la: Sistat tua gratia. Amen. In hora mortis suscipe.
units.tr: May your grace bring us there. Amen. Receive us at the hour of death.

units.la: ET: Maria virgo virginum,
units.tr: AND: Mary, virgin of virgins,

units.la: O Maria clausus hortus, Deposce nobis omnium
units.tr: O Mary, enclosed garden, obtain for us from all

units.la: Naufragantis mundi por- Remissionem criminum,
units.tr: The harbour of the shipwrecked world, the forgiveness of sins,

units.la: tus, Tuum placando filium.
units.tr: By appeasing your Son.

units.la: DE EADEM
units.tr: CONCERNING THE SAME

units.la: Festum Mariæ venerantes, hac die jugiter psallite. Salva virgo gregem tibi laude canentem. Dirige genteconceptum tuum amanti Validum tuum præclarum in unione sanctu. Probant roborant id scripta dictaq; doctorum. Quorum de grege Anshelmus primus conceptum tuum ponit mundissimum. Per dæmones jam submersum reduxisti tuum clericulum, Et clericum subauratum revocasti actu impollutum. Abbatemque Helsimum in mari anxium ad portum salutis trahiturtulisti
units.tr: Venerating the feast of Mary, sing on this day without ceasing. Holy virgin, the flock sings your praise. Direct your conception, beloved, your mighty and renowned strength in the union of the saints. The writings and sayings of the teachers prove and confirm it. Of their flock, Anselm first affirms your most pure conception. You have brought back your little clerk, already sunk by demons, and recalled the gilded clerk, unpolluted in deed. You drew Abbot Helsimus, anxious in the sea, to the harbour of salvation with a most joyful countenance.

units.la: • tulisti vultu lætissimo. Ob hanc causam Anglia repletur gaudio, Conceptum Mariæ solennizat, in dulci jubilo. Ecclesia Romana approbat, confirmat hoc festum celebrandum Basiliensis synodus. Ordo Carmeli assistant reginæ cœli. Regina læta nos freta colloca ubi nunc es cum filio tuo in cœlesti solio. Amen.
units.tr: Because of this cause, England is filled with joy and celebrates the Conception of Mary in sweet jubilation. The Roman Church approves and confirms that this feast is to be celebrated, as does the Council of Basel. The Order of Carmel attends the Queen of heaven. Joyful queen, set us in the straits where you now are with your Son on the heavenly throne. Amen.

units.la: AD EANDEM MARIAM, in festo conceptionis ipsius.
units.tr: To the same Mary, on the feast of her conception.

units.la: O norma innocentiæ, Maria, plena gratia, Tu stella matutina, Tu à Deo fabricata, In conceptu præservata, Nulla trahis scelera. Tu in cœlis coronata, Ab Angelis venerata, Micans supra sidera, Nos famulos rege tuos. Atque tibi fac devotos, Pro tua clementia. Ab inferno liberatos, Nos postremo fac beatos, In cœli militia. Amen.
units.tr: O standard of innocence, Mary, full of grace, you morning star, you formed by God, preserved from sin in your conception, you draw in no wickedness. You, crowned in heaven, venerated by the angels, shining above the stars, rule us your servants. Make us devoted to you, by your mercy. Free us from hell, and at the last make us blessed in the host of heaven. Amen.

units.la: II. FESTO NATIVITATIS Mariæ, 8. Septembris.
units.tr: II. On the feast of the Nativity of Mary, 8 September.

units.la: Benedicta & venerabilis es virgo Maria, quæ sine tactu pudoris inventa es Mater Salvatoris. Felix es, sacra virgo Maria, & omni laude dignissima, quia ex te ortus est sol justitiæ.
units.tr: Blessed and venerable are you, Virgin Mary, who were found to be the Mother of the Saviour without any touch of impurity. You are happy, holy Virgin Mary, and most worthy of all praise, because from you has risen the sun of righteousness.

units.la: Post partum virgo inviolata permansisti, Dei genitrix, intercede pro nobis.
units.tr: After childbirth you remained an inviolate virgin. Mother of God, intercede for us.

units.la: ITEM:Maria mater DominiÆterni patris Filii,Fer opem nobis omnibusAd te confugientibus.
units.tr: Likewise: Mary, mother of the Lord, of the eternal Father's Son, bring help to all of us who flee to you.

units.la: ITEM:Te nunc supplicitèr Sanćta Theotocos, regis perpetui sponsaq; poscimus, ut nos semper ubiq; miti munere protegas.
units.tr: Likewise: We humbly beseech you now, holy Theotokos, bride of the everlasting King, that you may always protect us everywhere with your gentle gift.

units.la: Sanctis obtineas virgo precantibus pacis præsidium, nobis atq; beati regni dona perennia.
units.tr: Virgin, may you obtain for those who pray to you the protection of peace, and for us the everlasting gifts of the blessed kingdom.

units.la: ITEM:Nativitas Mariæ virginisQuæ nos lavit à crimineCelebratur hodie,Dies est lætitiæ.
units.tr: Likewise: The nativity of the Virgin Mary, which washes us from sin, is celebrated today; it is a day of joy.

units.la: Stella nova noviter oritur,Cujus ortu mors nostra moritur;Evæ lapsus jam restituiturIn Maria.
units.tr: A new star newly rises, by whose rising our death dies; the fall of Eve is now restored in Mary.

units.la: O Maria dulce commercium,Intra tuum cœleste gremium,Quo salutis reis & remediumIndulgetur.
units.tr: O Mary, sweet exchange, within your heavenly bosom, by which a remedy of salvation is granted to the guilty.

units.la: O vera spes & verum gaudiumFac post vitæ præsentis stadium,Ut optatum in cœlis braviumNobis detur.
units.tr: O true hope and true joy, after the course of this present life make it so that the longed-for prize in heaven is given to us.

units.la: III. FESTO PRÆSENTATIONISMariæ, 21. Novembris.
units.tr: III. THE FEAST OF THE PRESENTATION OF MARY, 21 November.

units.la: Hoc die pœnitentibus & confessis, si conte[?]ntis, ... ventibus Ecclesiasticis, in quibus officium Beatæ virginis Mariæ celebretur, interfuerint, vel in vigilia ejus festi jejunarint, annuatim centum dies, de injunctis eis poenitentiis, Paulus Papa relaxavit. Ecce virgo singularis, | Nos ergò sic tueaaris, Quàrâ laude sublimaris! | Ut fructu, quo gloriaris Quantâ fulges gloriâ! | Fruamur in patriâ.
units.tr: On this day Pope Paul granted an annual indulgence of one hundred days from the penances imposed on penitents and confessed persons who, if they are contrite, attend the ecclesiastical gatherings in which the office of the Blessed Virgin Mary is celebrated, or who fast on the vigil of this feast. Behold, singular virgin, so guard us, how sublimely you are praised! That we may enjoy in the homeland the fruit in which you glory, how brightly you shine with glory!

units.la: IV. FESTO ANNUNCIATIONIS Mariæ. 25. Martii.
units.tr: IV. FEAST OF THE ANNUNCIATION OF MARY. 25 March.

units.la: Ave maris stella, Dei mater alma, atque semper virgo, felix cœli porta.
units.tr: Hail, star of the sea, nourishing Mother of God, ever-virgin, happy gate of heaven.

units.la: Sumens illud Ave Gabrielis ore, funda nos in pace, mutans nomen Evæ.
units.tr: Receiving that "Ave" from the mouth of Gabriel, establish us in peace, changing the name of Eve.

units.la: Solve vincla Regis, profer lumen cæcis, mala nostra pelle, bona cuncta posce.
units.tr: Loose the chains of the King, bring light to the blind, drive out our evils, ask for all good things.

units.la: Monstra te esse Matrem, sumat per te preces, quæ pro nobis natus tulit esse tuus.
units.tr: Show yourself to be a Mother; through you may he receive our prayers, he who, born for us, became yours.

units.la: Virgo singularis, inter omnes mitis, nos culpis solutos mites fac & castos.
units.tr: Singular virgin, gentlest of all, make us, freed from our sins, gentle and chaste.

units.la: Vitam præsta puram, iter para tutum, ut videntes Jesum semper collætemur, &c.
units.tr: Grant us a pure life, prepare a safe way, so that, seeing Jesus, we may always rejoice together, etc.

units.la: Specie tua & pulchritudine tua; intende prospere, procede & regina.
units.tr: In your beauty and your loveliness, press on prosperously, proceed and reign.

units.la: ET: Salve decus virginum, Medicatrix hominum, Salutis puerpera,
units.tr: And: Hail, glory of virgins, healer of men, bearer of salvation,

units.la: Sequentia: Mittit ad Virginem &c.
units.tr: Sequence: He sends to the Virgin, etc.

units.la: Foras ejiciat mundanum principem, secum faciat matrem participem patris imperii. Et: Sed dator veniæ concessâ veniâ Permanentem gratiæ obtentâ gratiâ In nobis habitet, &c.
units.tr: Let him cast out the worldly prince, and make the mother a sharer with the Father in his kingdom. And: But the giver of pardon, pardon having been granted, grace having been obtained, may he dwell in us, etc.

units.la: V. FESTO VISITATIONIS Mariæ. 2. Jul.
units.tr: V. FEAST OF THE VISITATION OF MARY. 2 July.

units.la: Institutum est in Concilio Basiliensi anno Domini 1432. ad supplicandum litandumq; Mariæ, ut Turcos Christianis infestos perdurat, quemadmodum ipsa montes Judææ cavisset in isto ad cognatam suam itinere. Veni præcelsa Domina, Maria tu nos visita, Ægras mentes illumina, Per sacra vitæ munera. Veni salvatrix seculi, Sordes aufer piaculi, In visitando populum, Pœnæ tollas periculum. Veni Regina gentium, Dele flammas reatuum, Dele quodcunq; devium, Da vitam innocentium. Veni, ut quoque visites, Maria vires robores, Virtute sacri impetus, Ne fluctuetur animus. Veni lux, stella marium, Infunde pacis radium, Exultet cor in gaudium, Johannis ante Dominum. Veni virgo regalium, Reduc fluctus errantium Ad unitatem fidei, In quâ salvantur cœlici. Veni deposce Spiritus Sancta dona propensius, Ut dirigantur rectius, In hujus vitæactibus.
units.tr: It was instituted at the Council of Basel in the year of the Lord 1432, to beseech and propitiate Mary, that she would subdue the Turks, hostile to Christians, just as she herself took care of the hill country of Judea on her journey to her kinswoman. Come, most exalted Lady, Mary, visit us; enlighten our sick minds through the holy gifts of life. Come, Saviour of the world, wipe away the filth of sin; in visiting your people, remove the danger of punishment. Come, Queen of the nations, quench the flames of guilt, blot out whatever is wayward, and grant life to the innocent. Come, that you may also visit us, Mary, and strengthen and fortify our powers by the virtue of holy impulse, so that the mind may not be tossed about. Come, light and star of the seas, pour in a ray of peace; let the heart exult in joy, as John did before the Lord. Come, virgin of kings, lead the wandering waves back to the unity of faith, in which the heavenly ones are saved. Come, and ask more eagerly for the holy gifts of the Spirit, that they may more rightly direct the actions of this life.

units.la: ITEM:
units.tr: ALSO:

units.la: Leva gregem, | Ut salvetur, Duc ad Regem | Et latetur, Maria cunctos visitans, | Cùtu fis mater medicans.
units.tr: Lift up the flock, that it may be saved; lead it to the King, that it may rejoice. Mary, visiting all, become a mother healing all things.

units.la: EX MISSALI ROMANO.
units.tr: FROM THE ROMAN MISSAL.

units.la: Spes datur omni populo, Mariam mox invocare; Videnti, hanc Elisabeth humiliter visitare.
units.tr: Hope is given to every people to invoke Mary at once, and to visit Elisabeth humbly, as one who has seen her.

units.la: VI. FESTO PURIFICATIONIS
units.tr: VI. THE FEAST OF THE PURIFICATION

units.la: Mariae. 2. Februar.
units.tr: Of Mary. 2 February.

units.la: De hoc Jacobus de Voragine sermone 82. de Sanctis sic scribit: Festum istud in honore matris luminis transtulerunt: ut in ejus honorem deferamus lumina, quæ nobis genuit verum lumen. Ut jam non fiat in honore Proserpinæ, Sponsæ Dei infernalis, sed ad honorem sponsæ Dei cœlestis. Nec etiam fiat ad honorem Februæ matris Dei belli, sed ad honorem matris Dei pacis. Jam non fiat ad honorem curiæ infernalis, sed ad reginæ omnium angelorum. Et merito translatio facta est. Honorabat Romani Proserpinâ, ut sic à suo sponso acquireret gratiam: honorabat Februam, ut sic à filio suo impe-
units.tr: On this, Jacobus de Voragine writes as follows in sermon 82 on the Saints: "They transferred this feast in honour of the mother of light, so that in her honour we might carry lights, since she bore for us the true light. It is no longer made in honour of Proserpina, the infernal god's bride, but in honour of the bride of the heavenly God. Nor is it made in honour of Februa, the mother of the god of war, but in honour of the mother of the God of peace. It is no longer made in honour of the infernal court, but of the queen of all angels. And the transfer was rightly made. The Romans honoured Proserpina so that they might win favour from her husband; they honoured Februa so that they might obtain from her son

units.la: impetrarent victoriam: honorabant dæmo- nes animas punientes, ut inclinarent eos ad misericordiam. Sed ista tria a matre Dei recepimus, scilicet gratiam, misericordiam, & victoriam. Et ideo cantat Ecclesia: Maria Mater gratiæ, Mater misericordiæ, Tu nos ab hoste protege. Ipsa enim vivis dat gratiam: ideo dicitur; Maria mater gratia.
units.tr: victory. They honoured the demons who punish souls so that they might move them to mercy. But we have received these three things from the Mother of God: grace, mercy and victory. And therefore the Church sings: Mary, Mother of grace, Mother of mercy, protect us from the enemy. For she gives grace to the living; therefore it is said: Mary, mother of grace.

units.la: Defunctis impetrat misericordiam: ideo subditur; Mater misericordia. Et universali Ecclesiæ de hostibus obtinet victoriam: ideo additur; Tu nos ab hoste protege.
units.tr: She obtains mercy for the dead; therefore it is added: Mother of mercy. And she obtains victory for the whole Church over its enemies; therefore it is added: Protect us from the enemy."

units.la: Tractus:
units.tr: Tract:

units.la: Gaude Maria virgo, cunctas hæreses sola interemisti.
units.tr: Rejoice, Virgin Mary, you alone have destroyed all heresies.

units.la: ORATIO DIE PURIFICATIONIS Mariæ, pro cereorum luminarium consecratione.
units.tr: PRAYER FOR THE DAY OF THE PURIFICATION OF MARY, for the consecration of the wax lights.

units.la: Rogamus te, per invocationem Sancti tui nominis, & per intercessionem Mariæ B. virginis, matris filii tui, (cujus festum summa devotione hodie celebramus) & per omnium sanctorum tuorum intercessiones, ut consecrare velis has candelas, ad utilitatem & commodum hominis, & ad salutem animæ & corporis, sive in terra, sive in mari sit.
units.tr: We beg you, through the invocation of your holy name, through the intercession of the blessed Virgin Mary, mother of your Son (whose feast we celebrate today with the greatest devotion), and through the intercessions of all your saints, that you would be pleased to consecrate these candles for the use and benefit of mankind, and for the salvation of soul and body, whether on land or at sea.

units.la: Domine Jesu, benedicas, obsecro, hanc creaturam tuam, ceraм, & concede illi coelestem tuam benedictionem, per potentiam Sanctæ tuæ crucis: ut sicut data est humano generi ad effugandas tenebras, ita nunc eam quoq; vim percipiat, per signum sanctæ crucis +, ut ubicunque accendatur & ponatur, malignus Spiritus contremiscat, & ita territus aufugiat cum omnibus servis suis ex habitatione illâ, nec deinceps vexet eos, qui tibi adhærent.
units.tr: Lord Jesus, I beseech you to bless this creature of yours, wax, and grant it your heavenly blessing through the power of your holy cross, so that, just as it was given to the human race to drive away darkness, it may now also receive this power, through the sign of the holy cross +, so that wherever it is lit and placed, the evil spirit may tremble, and so terrified flee with all his servants from that dwelling, and never again harass those who cling to you.

units.la: ADJURATIO CEREÆ
units.tr: EXORCISM OF THE WAX

units.la: candela.
units.tr: candle.

units.la: Adjuro te creaturam ceram, in nomine Domini nostri & Sanctæ Trinitatis, ut sis exstirpatio & depulsio diaboli, & spectrorum ejus, &c.
units.tr: I exorcise you, creature of wax, in the name of our Lord and of the Holy Trinity, that you may be the uprooting and driving away of the devil and of his phantoms, etc.

units.la: ADDIT ECCLUS TOM. III.
units.tr: ADDITION FROM ECCLESIA, VOL. III.

units.la: Hom. 3. de purific. Mariæ.
units.tr: Homily 3, on the Purification of Mary.

units.la: Omnes itaque Christiani luminaribus illis pio affectu uti debent, spe bona firmiter confidentes, fore, ut sic ab omnibus insidiis & fraudibus diabolicis, virtute verbi & orationis hujus liberentur.
units.tr: Therefore all Christians ought to use those lights with devout affection, firmly confident in the good hope that they will thus be freed from all diabolical snares and deceits, by the power of this word and prayer.

units.la: EX MISSALI ROMANO.
units.tr: FROM THE ROMAN MISSAL.

units.la: ORATIO.
units.tr: PRAYER.

units.la: Domine sancte, Pater omnipotens, æterne Deus, qui omnia ex nihilo creasti, & jussu tuo, per opera apum, hunc liquorem, ad perfectionem sectionem cerei venire fecisti, & qui hodiernâ die petitionem justi Simeonis implesti, te humiliter deprecamur, ut has cædelas ad usus hominum & sanitatem corporum & animarum, sive in terrâ sive in aquis, per invocationem tui sanctissimi nominis, & per intercessionem beatæ Mariæ semper virginis, cujus hodie festa devotè celebrantur, & per preces omnium Sanctorum tuorum, bene ✠ dicere, & sancti ✠ ficare digneris, & hujus plebis tuæ, quæ illas honorificè in manibus portare desiderat, teque cantando laudare, exaudias voces de cœlo sancto tuo, & de sede majestatis tuæ, & propitius sis omnibus clamantibus ad te, quos redemisti pretioso sanguine filii tui, qui tecum &c.
units.tr: Holy Lord, Father almighty, eternal God, who created all things out of nothing, and who by your command caused this liquid, through the work of bees, to be made into the perfect wax candle, and who today fulfilled the petition of the righteous Simeon: we humbly pray you that you would deign to bless ✠ and sanctify ✠ these candles for the use of men and the health of bodies and souls, whether on land or in the waters, through the invocation of your most holy name, through the intercession of the blessed Mary, ever virgin, whose feast is devoutly celebrated today, and through the prayers of all your saints; and that you would hear the voices of this your people, who desire to carry them honourably in their hands and to praise you in song, from your holy heaven and from the throne of your majesty, and be merciful to all who cry out to you, whom you redeemed with the precious blood of your Son, who with you etc.

units.la: Omnipotens sempiterna Deus, qui hodierna die unigenitum tuum in ulnis sancti Simeonis in templo sancto tuo suscipiendum præsentasti, tuam supplices deprecamur clementiam, ut has candelas, quas nos famuli tui, in tui nominis magnificentia suscipientes gestare cupimus, luce accensas benedicere & sanctificare, atq; lumine supernæ benedictionis accendere digneris, quatenus eas tibi Domino Deo nostro offerendo digni, & S. ignes tuæ dulcissimæ charitatis succensi, in templo S. gloriæ repræsentari mereamur, per eundem.
units.tr: Almighty and everlasting God, who on this day presented your only-begotten Son in the arms of holy Simeon to be received in your holy temple, we suppliant beseech your mercy, that you would deign to bless and sanctify these candles, which we your servants, receiving them for the glory of your name, desire to carry, and to kindle them with the light of heavenly blessing, so that, offering them worthily to you, the Lord our God, and kindled with the holy fires of your most sweet charity, we may deserve to be presented in the temple of holy glory, through the same Lord.

units.la: Domine Jesu Christe, lux vera, quæ illumi-nas omnes hominem venientem in hunc mundum, dum, affunde benedictionem tuam super hos cereos, & sanctifica eos lumine gratiæ tuæ, & concede propitius, ut, sicut hæc luminaria igne visibili accensa, noctis tenebras depellunt, ita corda nostra invisibili igne, id est, Spiritus S. splendore illustrata, omnium viriorum cæcitate careant, ut purgato mentis oculo, ea cernere possimus, quæ tibi sunt placita, & nostræ saluti utilia, quatenus post hujus sæculi caliginosi discrimina, ad lucem indeficientem pervenire mereamur. Per te Jesu Christe, Salvator mundi. &c.
units.tr: Lord Jesus Christ, true light, who enlightens every man coming into this world, pour your blessing upon these wax candles, sanctify them with the light of your grace, and graciously grant that, just as these lights, kindled with visible fire, drive away the darkness of night, so our hearts, illumined by the invisible fire, that is, by the brightness of the Holy Spirit, may be free from the blindness of all vices, so that, with the eye of the mind cleansed, we may discern those things which are pleasing to you and useful for our salvation, and so that, after the dangers of this misty age, we may deserve to come to the unfailing light. Through you, Jesus Christ, Saviour of the world, etc.

units.la: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus, qui per Moysen famulum tuum purissimum olei liquorem ad luminaria ante conspectum tuum jugiter concremanda præparari jussisti, benedictionis tuæ gratiam super hos cereos benignus infunde, quatenus sic administrent lumen exterius, ut te donante, lumen Spiritus tui, nostris non deficit mentibus interius, per &c.
units.tr: Almighty and everlasting God, who through Moses your most pure servant commanded the purest oil to be prepared for lamps to be burned continually before your face, graciously pour the grace of your blessing upon these candles, so that they may give outward light in such a way that, by your gift, the light of your Spirit may never fail our minds inwardly, through etc.

units.la: CANTVS IN PROCESSIONE.
units.tr: CHANT IN PROCESSION.

units.la: Ave gratia plena Dei genitrix virgo, ex te enim ortus est sol justitiæ, illuminans, quæ in tenebris sunt.
units.tr: Hail, full of grace, Virgin Mother of God, for from you has risen the sun of justice, illuminating those who are in darkness.

units.la: Adorna thalamum tuum Sion, & suscipe regem Christū, amplectere Mariam, quæ est cœlestis porta. Ipsa enim portat regem gloriæ. Novo lumine sufistit virgo, adducens in manibus filium ante luciferum, &c.
units.tr: Adorn your bridal chamber, Sion, and receive Christ the King; embrace Mary, who is the heavenly gate. For she herself bears the King of glory. The Virgin stands in a new light, bringing in her arms the Son before the morning star, etc.

units.la: VII. FESTO ASSUMTIONIS Mariæ. 15. Aug.
units.tr: VII. THE FEAST OF THE ASSUMPTION OF MARY. 15 August.

units.la: Ecclesia cuncta te cordibus atq; carminibus venerans, tibi suam manifestat devotionem, precatu te supplici implorans, Maria.
units.tr: The whole Church, venerating you with its hearts and its songs, shows you its devotion, imploring you with suppliant prayer, Mary.

units.la: Ut sibi auxilium, circa Christum Dominum esse digneris per ævum.
units.tr: That you would deign to be its help with Christ the Lord for ever.

units.la: IN OCTAVA ASSUMTIONIS Mariæ.
units.tr: ON THE OCTAVE OF THE ASSUMPTION OF MARY.

units.la: Maria, audi nos. Nam te Filius, nihil negans, honorat.
units.tr: Mary, hear us. For the Son, denying you nothing, honours you.

units.la: Salva nos Jesu, quibus virgo mater te orat.
units.tr: Save us, Jesus, for whom the Virgin Mother entreats you.

units.la: ITEM:
units.tr: ALSO:

units.la: Te cœli Regina, hæc plebecula piis concelebrat mentibus. Te cantu melodo super æthera una cum Angelis elevat. Te libri virginem concinunt Prophetarum, chorus jubilat Sacerdotum, Apostoli Christique martyres prædicant. Te plebis sexus sequitur utriusque, vitam diligens virginalem, cœlicolas in castimonia æmulans. Ecclesia ergo cuncta te cordibus teque carminibus celebrat. Tibi Sancta manifestat devotionem, precatu te supplici implorans, Maria, ut sibi auxilium circa Christum Dominum esse digneris, per eundem.&c.
units.tr: Queen of heaven, this little people celebrates you with pious minds. With a melodious song it raises you above the heavens, together with the Angels. The books of the Prophets sing of you as the Virgin, the choir of priests rejoices, and the Apostles and martyrs of Christ proclaim you. The people of both sexes follows you, loving virginal life and imitating the dwellers of heaven in chastity. Therefore the whole Church celebrates you with its hearts and with its songs. Holy Church shows you its devotion, imploring you with suppliant prayer, Mary, that you would deign to be its help with Christ the Lord, through the same Christ, etc.

units.la: AD EANDEM MARIAM:
units.tr: TO THE SAME MARY:

units.la: Imperatrix Reginarum, | Rosa gelu non attrita, Et Salvatrix animarum, | Mater Dei, virgo pia, Preciosa margarita, | Ora pro nobis, Maria.
units.tr: Empress of queens, / Rose not chilled by frost, / Saviour of souls, / Mother of God, pious virgin, / Precious pearl, / Pray for us, Mary.

units.la: IDIOTA DE MARIA VIRGINE. cap. 5.
units.tr: IDIOTA DE MARIA VIRGINE. cap. 5.

units.la: Ad invocationem nominis Mariæ, cœlum ridet, terra lætatur, Angeli congaudent, dæmones contremiscunt, & infernus conturbatur.
units.tr: At the invocation of the name of Mary, heaven smiles, the earth rejoices, the angels rejoice together, the demons tremble, and hell is thrown into confusion.

units.la: ANGELORUM.
units.tr: ANGELORUM.

units.la: Ad novem choros Angelicos.
units.tr: To the nine choirs of angels.

units.la: Ordines noveni Spirituum beatorū, quos in Dei laudibus firmavit charitas, Nos fragiles homines firmate precibus, ut spirituales pravitates vestro juvamine vincentes fortiter, nunc & in ævum vestris simus digni solennibus interesse sacris. Nos adjutorium ut nunc & perenniter foveat protegatque vestrum, in die poscimus gaudiorum vestrorum.
