units.tr: You nine orders of the blessed spirits, whom charity has established in the praises of God, strengthen us frail men with your prayers, so that we, overcoming spiritual wickedness by your help bravely, may now and for ever be worthy to take part in your solemn rites. We ask that your help now and for ever cherish us and protect us on the day of your joys.

units.la: Hostias tibi, Domine, laudis offerimus, supplicite deprecantes, ut easdem, angelico pro nobis interveniente suffragio, placatus accipias, & ad salutem nostram provenire concedas.
units.tr: We offer to you, Lord, sacrifices of praise, humbly praying that you would graciously accept them, with the angelic intercession on our behalf, and grant that they may turn to our salvation.

units.la: Repleti, Domine, benedictione cœlesti supplicite imploramus, ut, quod fragili celebramus officio, sanctorum Angelorum atq; Archangelorum nobis prodesse sentiamus auxilio.
units.tr: Filled, O Lord, with heavenly blessing, we humbly beseech you that we may feel the help of the holy angels and archangels profiting us in what we celebrate with our frail service.

units.la: AD ARCHANGELUM Michaelem.
units.tr: TO THE ARCHANGEL MICHAEL.

units.la: Summe Regis Archangele Michael, intende tendé tende quaesumus nostris precibus. Te namque profitemur esse supernorum civium principem. Tu Deum obsecra pro nobis, ut mittat auxilium miseris. Principalis est potestas a Domino tibi data, peccantes salvificare animas. Idem tenes perpetuam potentiam Paradisi, omnes cives te adorant superi.
units.tr: Michael, archangel, prince of the King on high, we beg you, give heed, give heed, give heed to our prayers. For we confess that you are the chief of the heavenly citizens. Plead with God for us, that he may send help to the wretched. The power of saving sinful souls has been given to you by the Lord. You hold the everlasting power of Paradise; all the citizens above worship you.

units.la: Audi nos Michael Angelcsumme, Tu pastor, jam descende de poli sede nobis ferendo opem Domini atque levamen indulgentiae.
units.tr: Hear us, Michael, highest of the angels; you, our shepherd, now come down from the seat of heaven, bringing us the help and relief of the Lord's indulgence.

units.la: EX MISSALI ROMANO.
units.tr: FROM THE ROMAN MISSAL.

units.la: Sancte Michael archangele defende nos in praelio, ut non pereamus in tremendo judicio.
units.tr: Holy Michael the archangel, defend us in battle, so that we do not perish in the dreadful judgment.

units.la: De festo Michaelis, Pantaleon diaconus et Chartophylax magna Ecclesia, apud Surium tom. 7. de vitis Sanctorum, blasphemè dicit, Archangelum Michaelem, festum ejus fide & desiderio alacriter celebrantes, ex omni difficultate & noxio occursu liberare, dare etiam eis salutarem gratiam, deducere quoque ad petitionem semper utilem, & ad viam poenitentiae, eisque peccatorum procurare remissionem, & in justorum stationem connumerare in regno coelorum.
units.tr: Concerning the feast of Michael, Pantaleon, deacon and chartophylax of the great Church, in Surius, vol. 7, On the Lives of the Saints, says blasphemously that the Archangel Michael, when his feast is celebrated eagerly in faith and desire, frees them from every difficulty and harmful encounter, gives them saving grace, leads them to what is always profitable when they ask, and to the way of repentance; that he procures for them remission of sins and numbers them among the company of the righteous in the kingdom of heaven.

units.la: AD GABRIELEM ARCHANGELUM. Graduale.
units.tr: TO THE ARCHANGEL GABRIEL. Gradual.

units.la: Præco fulgens splendore nimio, Gemma lucens cœlesti radio, Desolatis sis consolatio, Et tentatis firma protectio. Tu Gabriel, qui frangis carceres, Captivorum respice pauperes Et fac eos ad vitam celeres. Per te, præco, opus mirabile Altum nimis fit & spectabile, Per te nobis fiat possibile, Quod rogamus, & impetrabile.
units.tr: Herald shining with excessive brightness, gem gleaming with heavenly ray, be a consolation to the desolate and a firm protection to the tempted. You, Gabriel, who break open the prisons, look upon the poor captives and make them swift to life. Through you, herald, the work is wonderful, exceedingly lofty and admirable; through you may what we ask and beseech become possible for us.

units.la: TRACTUS.
units.tr: TRACT.

units.la: A te, præco, virgo amabilis Præter morem effecta fertilis, Veneratur, ut sit placabilis, Deus noster scit terribilis. Virginisque jucunda facies Te Gabriel, & mira species, Lætificat, sit nobis requies, Quasi placeat, nos tecum facies. Nunc igitur præco accelera, Piæ matris precare viscera, Nato monstret pectus & ubera, Tu ab hoste tecum libera.
units.tr: From you, herald, the lovable virgin, made fruitful beyond the custom of nature, our God, who is terrible, is entreated to be merciful. And the joyful face of the virgin and your wondrous appearance, Gabriel, gladden us; may it be our rest, as if it pleased him, that we should be with you. Now therefore, herald, hasten; plead with the tender heart of the pious mother, and let her show her breast and udders to her Son; deliver us, with you, from the enemy.

units.la: EX PROSA.
units.tr: FROM THE SEQUENCE.

units.la: Imperatrix, cujus imperioTota gaudet cœlestis concio,Tanta laus est tibi in filio,Quod humana non capit ratio.Te beatam laudare cupiuntOmnes sancti, sed non sufficiunt.Nam tot laudes tibi conveniunt,Quod laudantes omnes deficiunt.Quia tamen caput es virginum,Et laus summa non habens terminum,Angelorum laus & hominumPrômereris, prima post Dominum.Cùm consisteret humani generis,Loqui præco dignior cæteris,Valedicit regina ætheris,Cujus sedes manet in superis:Vale sancta sanctorum omniumLaus, & honor, decus fidelium,Aula Christi, domus palatium,Deitatis reclinatorium.
units.tr: Empress, at whose command the whole assembly of heaven rejoices, such praise is yours in your Son that human reason cannot grasp it. All the saints desire to praise you as blessed, but they are not sufficient. For so many praises belong to you that all who praise you fall short. Yet because you are the head of virgins, and a praise without highest limit, you deserve the praise of angels and of men, first after the Lord. When the herald, more worthy than the rest, stood by the human race to speak, the Queen of heaven bids farewell, whose seat remains among the heights. Farewell, holy one of all the saints, praise and honour, the glory of the faithful, the court of Christ, the house, the palace, the couch of the Godhead.

units.la: OFFERTORIVM.
units.tr: OFFERTORY.

units.la: Fortis præco, omnes communiterImpugnamur ab hoste fortiter,Et interdum vincimur turpiter,Sed juva nos misericorditer.
units.tr: Strong herald, we are all together attacked bravely by the enemy, and at times we are shamefully conquered; but help us in your mercy.

units.la: COMMVNIO.
units.tr: COMMUNION.

units.la: O Gabriel refove flebiles, ægros fama, confortta debiles, fac nos mites semper & humiles, & in fide fortes & stabiles.
units.tr: O Gabriel, refresh the tearful, strengthen the sick, support the weak; make us always gentle and humble, and strong and steadfast in faith.

units.la: Ad Eundem:
units.tr: To the same:

units.la: Tu nostros Gabriel hostes prosterne.
units.tr: Gabriel, strike down our enemies.

units.la: Ad Raphaelem Archangelum.
units.tr: To the Archangel Raphael.

units.la: Tu Raphael ægris affer medelam, morbos abstergę, noxas dilue, nosque fac interesse gaudiis beatorum.
units.tr: Raphael, bring healing to the sick, wipe away diseases, wash away harms, and make us to share in the joys of the blessed.

units.la: Et:
units.tr: And:

units.la: Jubilus summæ laudis resonet in ore omnium ad laudem beati Raphaelis Archangeli, ut ipse, cujus memoria agitur in terris, ad Deum pro nobis intercedat in cœlis.
units.tr: Let a shout of highest praise resound from the mouth of all to the praise of the blessed Archangel Raphael, so that he, whose memory is kept on earth, may intercede with God in heaven for us.

units.la: Oratio.
units.tr: Prayer.

units.la: Mitte, Deus, Archangelum tuum Raphaelem cum medicamine opificem, qui sanitate mentis reportet & corporis, misericordiæque cœlestis donum infundat, & quæ in nobis sunt adversa, deponat, ut qui nostra iniquitate tabescimus, de tua quam non mereamur, pietate lætari concedas.
units.tr: Send, O God, your Archangel Raphael, skilled in healing with his remedy, who may restore health of mind and body, pour out the gift of heavenly mercy, and remove what is adverse in us, so that we, who waste away through our iniquity, may be granted to rejoice in your goodness, which we do not deserve.

units.la: Ad Angelum, Peculiariter singulis adhibitum custodem.
units.tr: To the angel, specially assigned to each as guardian.

units.la: Angele, qui meus es custos, pietate superna
units.tr: Angel, who are my guardian, by your heavenly devotion,

units.la: Me tibi commissum salva, defende, guberna.
units.tr: keep, defend and guide me, committed to you.

units.la: Terge mea mente vitiis & labe fluentem,
units.tr: Cleanse my mind, flowing with vices and stain,

units.la: Assiduusq; precor mihi sis, relevesque cadentem.
units.tr: and I pray that you be always with me, and raise me when I fall.

units.la: DES. IOHANNE BAPTISTA, In illius Nativitate.
units.tr: Of St. John the Baptist, at His Nativity.

units.la: Sancti Baptistæ, Christi præconis solennia celebrantes, moribus ipsum sequamur, ut ad vitam, quampræ dixit, asseclas suos perducat.
units.tr: Let us who celebrate the festival of the holy Baptist, herald of Christ, follow him in our conduct, so that he may lead his followers to the life he has spoken of.

units.la: Devotè te sanctissime hominum, amice Jesu Christi, flagitamus, ut gaudia percipiamus.
units.tr: We beseech you devoutly, most holy friend of Jesus Christ among men, that we may receive joys.

units.la: Apparens, quæ Zachariæ Gabriel repromisit: qui tuam celebrarent obsequiis nativitatem.
units.tr: You who appeared as Gabriel promised Zechariah, that they might celebrate your nativity with their service.

units.la: Ut per hæc festa æterna gaudia adipiscamur. Quæ Sancti Dei sacris deliciis læti gaudent.
units.tr: So that through these festivals we may attain eternal joys, in which the holy servants of God rejoice gladly in their sacred delights.

units.la: Tu, qui præparas fidelium corda, ne quid devium vel lubricum Deus in eis inveniat:
units.tr: You, who prepare the hearts of the faithful, so that God may find nothing deviant or slippery in them:

units.la: Te deposcimus, ut crimina nostra & facinora continuâ prece studeas absolvere.
units.tr: We beg you to be zealous, by continual prayer, to absolve our sins and crimes.

units.la: Placatus ut ipse suos semper invisere fideles, & mansionem in eis facere dignetur.
units.tr: May he, being appeased, deign to visit his faithful ones always and to make his dwelling in them.

units.la: E T:
units.tr: And:

units.la: Solve polluti labii reatum sancte Johannes.
units.tr: Absolve, holy John, the guilt of the defiled lip.

units.la: ALIA PRECATIO.
units.tr: ANOTHER PRAYER.

units.la: Devoti te, sanctissime omnium amice Jesu Christi, flagitamus, ut gaudia percipiamus. mus. Apparens quæ Zachariæ Gabriel repromisit, qui tuam celebrarent obsequiis nativitatem, & per hæc festa æterna gaudia adipiscamur, quâ Sancti Dei sacris deliciis læti congaudent. Tu, qui præparas fidelium corda, ne quid devium vel lubricum Deus in eis inveniat, te deposcimus, ut crimina nostra & facinora continuâ prece studeas absolvere, placatus ut ipse suos semper inviseré fideles, & mansionem in eis facere dignetur, & agni vellere, quem tuo digito Mundi monstraveras tollere crimina, nos velit induere, & ipsum mereamur, Angelis associi, in albâ veste sequi per portam clarissimam, amice Christi Johannes.
units.tr: We devoutly beseech you, most holy friend of Jesus Christ above all, that we may receive joys: you who appeared as Gabriel promised Zechariah, that they might celebrate your nativity with their service, and that through these festivals we may attain eternal joys, in which the holy servants of God rejoice together in their sacred delights. You, who prepare the hearts of the faithful, so that God may find nothing deviant or slippery in them, we beg you to be zealous, by continual prayer, to absolve our sins and crimes, so that, being appeased, you may deign always to visit your faithful ones and make your dwelling in them; and may he will to clothe us in the fleece of the lamb which with your finger you pointed out as the one who takes away the sins of the world, and may we merit, joined with the angels, to follow him in white robes through the most glorious gate, O John, friend of Christ.

units.la: DE S. JOACHIMO, PATRE, & S. Annâ, matre Mariæ virginis.
units.tr: ON ST JOACHIM THE FATHER, AND ST ANNE THE MOTHER OF THE VIRGIN MARY.

units.la: COLLECTA:
units.tr: COLLECT:

units.la: Infinitæ bonitatis Deus, à quo cuncta bona procedunt, qui tuâ inscrutabili providentiâ, unigenitum tuum per beatorum Joachim & Annæ filiam virginem Mariam incarnari præordinasti, ut Adæ posteritatem de æternæ mortis vinculis liberaret: Da quæsumus, ut, qui eosdem parentes Reginæ cœli venerantur, eorum meritis & precibus à gehennæ incendiis liberemur, per eundem &c.
units.tr: O God of infinite goodness, from whom all good things proceed, who by your inscrutable providence foreordained that your only-begotten Son should be incarnate through the Virgin Mary, daughter of the blessed Joachim and Anne, so that he might free the posterity of Adam from the bonds of eternal death: grant, we beseech you, that we who venerate these same parents of the Queen of heaven may, by their merits and prayers, be freed from the fires of hell, through the same Christ our Lord, etc.

units.la: Completa Deus, qui beatos Joachim & Annam diu steriles, tandem prole voluisti gloriosa & humano generi salutifera, etiam sine peccati macula foecundari; da quaesumus, ut omnes, qui parentes illos, amore piae Filiae, Deiparae matris, venerantur, ipsorum meritis & precibus aeternae gaudia vitae capiamus, per Dominum &c.
units.tr: O God, who willed that the blessed Joachim and Anne, long barren, should at last have a glorious offspring, salutary to the human race, and conceived even without the stain of sin: grant, we pray, that all who venerate those parents for the love of their pious daughter, the Mother of God, may by their merits and prayers obtain the joys of eternal life, through the Lord, etc.

units.la: DE S. JOACHIMO, SEORSIM.
units.tr: ON ST JOACHIM, SEPARATELY.

units.la: Graduale. O Maria, Dei genitrix, benedictus sit pater tuus sanctus Joachim, a quo sine peccati macula processit caro tua virginea. Halleluja.
units.tr: Gradual. O Mary, Mother of God, blessed be your father, holy Joachim, from whom your virginal flesh came forth without stain of sin. Alleluia.

units.la: SEQUENTIA.
units.tr: SEQUENCE.

units.la: Coeli Regem attollamus Et in voces erumpamus Laudum per cantica. Qui per Joachim radiare Sidus fecit salutare, In matre deifica. Cum sponsa tua conversatus Proles pene ipse frustratus Consternatus flebilis. Ambo sic infructuosi Vivunt tanquam odiosi Suis contribuibus. Ipsi quoque redarguti Sunt ab ipsis, & persecuti Templi sacerdotibus. Impudenter rubrica ti Templum petunt adunati Culpas flentes scelerum. Votum illic emiserunt, Dare Deo promiserunt Nasciturum puerum. Mox in fletu consolantur, Quia lata nunciantur Affatu Angelico. Anna tandem gravidatur, Et Maria generatur, Ordine mirifico. Ergo tu, cum patre, Nata Dulci nexu foederata, Culpis nos absolvite. Tu nepoti, tuo nato Carnis hoste propulsato Interventu mergitæ. Salve pater matris Christi, Qui jam felix ascendisti jubilans ad athera.
units.tr: Let us extol the King of heaven and burst into voices of praise in song, who through Joachim made a saving star to shine forth in the deified Mother. Living with your spouse, the son was nearly frustrated, dismayed and weeping. Thus both, being barren, lived as if hateful to their own kin. They were also rebuked by their own people and persecuted by the priests of the Temple. Shamelessly they went up together to the Temple, weeping over their sins. There they made a vow, and promised to give to God the child to be born. Soon they were comforted in their weeping, because glad tidings were announced by the angelic message. At last Anne conceived, and Mary was born, in a wondrous order. Therefore you, daughter, together with your father, bound by a sweet tie, absolve us from our sins. To your grandson, your son, with the enemy of the flesh driven off, by your intercession, O you who are sunk in... Hail, father of the mother of Christ, who now, rejoicing, have ascended blessed into the heavens.

units.la: Gaude Maria pater, gaude Joachim omnium digne laudPAter tantæ filiæ. Iter para nobis tutum, Ut in Domini virtutum Collo cemur dextera. Amen.
units.tr: Rejoice, Mary's father; rejoice, Joachim, worthy of praise from all, father of so great a daughter. Prepare for us a safe way, that we may be gathered at the right hand of the virtues of the Lord. Amen.

units.la: (de)
units.tr: (de)

units.la: Secreta. Ineffabilem clementiam tuam Omnipotens & misericors Deus humiliter exoramus, ut, sicut beatissimum Joachim patriarcham singularis gratiæ privilegio dilectissimi unigeniti tui Domini nostri Jesu Christi avü, & gloriosissimæ virginis Mariæ, genitricis ejus, Patrem esse voluisti: Ita nos famulos tuos, amore filiæ Patri fore devotos cupientes, tam filiæ, quam Patris sacris meritis & precibus à peccatis & malis omnibus expeditos, velis singulari dignos facere gratiâ tuâ in præsenti, & gloriâ perpetuâ in futuro, per eundem &c.
units.tr: Secret. We humbly beseech your ineffable mercy, almighty and merciful God, that, as you willed the most blessed patriarch Joachim, by the singular privilege of grace, to be the father of the Virgin Mary, the most glorious mother of your most beloved only-begotten Lord Jesus Christ, and grandfather of him: so, since we your servants desire to be devoted to the love of the daughter and of the father, you would make us, freed from sins and all evils by the holy merits and prayers of both daughter and father, worthy of your special grace in the present life and of perpetual glory in the future, through the same Christ our Lord, etc.

units.la: DE S. ANNA, SEORSIM, infrà. DE S. JOSEPHO, SPONSO Mariæ virginis.
units.tr: ON ST ANNE, SEPARATELY, BELOW. ON ST JOSEPH, SPOUSE OF THE VIRGIN MARY.

units.la: Gaude Joseph, fili David, Ora virginis sponsæ tuæ natum, Ut se nobis det placatum, Collocans ad dexteram.
units.tr: Rejoice, Joseph, son of David; pray that the Son of your virgin spouse may be gracious to us, and set him at his right hand.

units.la: Deus, qui sanctum Joseph virginem, virginiMariæ, ut ex virginali conjugio JesusChristus stus filius tuus virgo nasceretur, sociari matrimonialiter voluisti, libera tuos ab omni malo, & præsta, ut ipsius sponsi meritis venire ad convivium tuæ cœlestis dulcedinis mereamur.
units.tr: O God, who willed that the holy Joseph be joined in marriage to the virgin Mary, so that Jesus Christ your Son might be born of a virgin, free your people from every evil, and grant that through the merits of this same spouse we may deserve to come to the banquet of your heavenly sweetness.

units.la: DE SS. APOSTOLIS.
units.tr: DE SS. APOSTOLIS.

units.la: DE APOSTOLIS CONJUNCTIM.
units.tr: DE APOSTOLIS CONJUNCTIM.

units.la: Vos secli justi judices, Et vera mundi lumina, Votis precamur cordium, Audite preces supplicum. Qui cœlum verbo clauditis, Seraque ejus solvitis, Nos a peccatis omnibus Solvite jussu quæsumus. Quorum præcepto subditur Salus & languor omnium, Sanare ægros moribus, Nos reddentes virtutibus. Ut, cum Judex advenerit Christus in fine seculi, Nos sempiternis gaudiis Faciat esse compotes.
units.tr: You holy judges of the age and true lights of the world, hear the supplications of those who pray with the desires of their hearts. You who shut heaven with the word and loose its bolts, loose us from all our sins at your command, we beg. To your precept are subject the health and the sickness of all; heal the sick in their behaviour, making us over to virtue. So that when Christ comes as Judge at the end of the age, may he make us partakers of everlasting joys.

units.la: ET:
units.tr: AND:

units.la: Protege Domine populum tuum, & Apostolorum tuorum Petri & Pauli, & aliorum Apostolorum patrocinio confidentem, perpetuâ defensione conserva.
units.tr: Lord, protect your people and keep them in perpetual defence, trusting in the patronage of your Apostles Peter and Paul and the other Apostles.

units.la: ET:
units.tr: AND:

units.la: Exaudi nos Deus salutaris noster, & Apostolorum tuorum Petri & Pauli, & aliorum Apostolorum nos tuere præsidio, quorum donasti fideles esse doctrinis.
units.tr: Hear us, O God our Saviour, and guard us with the protection of your Apostles Peter and Paul and the other Apostles, whose teachings you have granted us to be faithful to.

units.la: ET:
units.tr: AND:

units.la: His patronis, scilicet Petri, Pauli, Andreæ, Jacobi utriusque, Matthiæ, Barnabæ, Johannis, mis, Matthæi, Bartholomęi, Philippi, Thomæ, Simonis Judæ, Marci & Lucæ: His igitur patronis, vitæ donis Christe nos accumula, ut queamus, quod speramus, tenere per secula. AMEN.
units.tr: With these patrons, namely Peter, Paul, Andrew, both James, Matthias, Barnabas, John, Matthew, Bartholomew, Philip, Thomas, Simon and Jude, Mark and Luke: therefore, Christ, with the gifts of life through these patrons, load us up, so that what we hope for we may hold for ever. Amen.

units.la: DE APOSTOLO UNO.
units.tr: DE APOSTOLO UNO.

units.la: Ave Sancte N. Apostole Domini nostri Jesu Christi. Per illius amorem qui te de mundo elegit, te deprecor, ut me indignum famulum tuum ab omnibus adversitatibus liberes, ab omni impedimento corporis & animæ, & in horâ mortis animam meam suscipiens, perducas in vitam æternam.
units.tr: Hail, holy N., Apostle of our Lord Jesus Christ. By the love of him who chose you out of the world, I beseech you that you free me, your unworthy servant, from all adversities, from every hindrance of body and soul, and, receiving my soul at the hour of death, lead it into eternal life.

units.la: Ora pro nobis N. Apostole beate, ut per te gaudere mereamur in æternitate.
units.tr: Pray for us, N., blessed Apostle, that through you we may deserve to rejoice in eternity.

units.la: ET:
units.tr: AND:

units.la: Quæsumus omnipotens Deus, ut Beatus Apostolus N. tuum pro nobis imploret auxilium, ut à nostris reatibus absoluti, à cunctis etiam periculis eruamur.
units.tr: We beseech you, almighty God, that the blessed Apostle N. may implore your help for us, so that, absolved from our guilt, we may be rescued from all dangers as well.

units.la: DE PETRO ET PAVLO.
units.tr: DE PETRO ET PAVLO.

units.la: Hac sacra die, quæ dat reis veniam: Jam bonae pastor, pater clemens, accipe vota precantium, & peccati vincula resolve tibi potestate tradita, qui cunctis cœlum verbo claudis & aperis. -
units.tr: On this holy day, which grants pardon to the guilty, now, good shepherd, merciful father, receive the prayers of those who pray, and loose the bonds of sin, you who have been given the power, who shut and open heaven by the word. -

units.la: Doctor egregie Paule, mores instrue, & mente poli nos transferre satage. Et: Deus, cujus dextera beatum Petrum ambulantem in fluctibus, ne mergeretur, erexit, & Coapostolum ejus Paulum tertio naufragantem de profundo pelagi liberavit, exaudi nos propitius, & concede, utrambo- rum meritis æternitatis gloriam consequa- mur.
units.tr: Distinguished teacher Paul, instruct our manners, and take pains to lift us in mind to the heavens. And: God, whose right hand raised up the blessed Peter when he walked on the waves, lest he sink, and freed his fellow Apostle Paul, shipwrecked three times on the deep sea, graciously hear us, and grant that by the merits of both of them we may attain the glory of eternity.

units.la: Item: Petre, summe Christi pastor, & Pau- le gentium doctor, Ecclesiam vestris doctri- nis illuminatam, per circulum terræ, preca- tus adjuvet vester.
units.tr: Likewise: Peter, highest shepherd of Christ, and Paul, teacher of the Gentiles, may your help, by your prayers, aid the Church, illuminated by your teachings, throughout the circle of the earth.

units.la: DE S. PETRO.
units.tr: ON ST PETER.

units.la: Petri vincula.
units.tr: The Chains of Peter.

units.la: De hujus festi institutione Imperatoris li- teræ mandatoriæ effectæ sunt, ad hunc mo- dum:
units.tr: The imperial letters of mandate for the institution of this feast were drawn up in the following manner:

units.la: Notū esse volumus omnibus Christum pie colentibus, Beatum Petrum Apostolum, à Deo nobis datum pastorem & principem, summo studio venerari velle assiduè, & ma- xime in hac die Cal. Aug. in quo, ut Deus à vobis soliti eramus adorari, ut ipse pius pa- stor, precibus Deo fusis, nos & imperium no- strum adjuvare dignetur.
units.tr: We wish it to be known to all who piously worship Christ that we are willing to venerate assiduously, with the greatest zeal, the blessed Apostle Peter, given to us by God as shepherd and prince, and especially on this day, the first of August, on which, as we have been wont to be adored by you as God, he, as a devout shepherd, may by prayers poured out to God deign to help us and our empire.

units.la: APUD SURIUM TO. 4. DE vitis Sanctorum, extat hac oratio.
units.tr: In Surius, vol. 4, On the Lives of the Saints, this prayer is found.

units.la: Has catenas (Petri Apostoli) reveren- ter veneramur, & colimus, & pro animarum emendatione habemus. His omnem sensu membrum admoventes, illarum Sanctitate implemur, & per mentis intelligentiam fan- ̅cti Spiritus gratiam in animos ipsos admir- timus. Deceret certè, deceret non solùm ca- tenas, quę manus illas adstrinxerunt, magno-perè venerari: sed etiam indicia omnia, ad quæ Apostoli membra accesserunt, singula- tim ampléctiac revereri, & in illis singulis di- em festum ac panegyrim celebrare.
units.tr: We reverently venerate and honour these chains of Peter the Apostle, and we hold them for the amendment of souls. By bringing every sense to bear upon them, we are filled with their holiness, and through the understanding of the mind we admit the grace of the Holy Spirit into our souls. It would surely be fitting, indeed very fitting, to venerate greatly not only the chains that bound those hands, but also to embrace and revere individually all the places which the Apostle's body touched, and to celebrate a feast day and festival on each of them.

units.la: Ex Missali Rom.
units.tr: From the Roman Missal.

units.la: Solve, jubente Deo, terrarum Petre catenas, Qui facis, ut pateant cœlestia regna beatis.
units.tr: Loose, at God's command, the chains of Peter, lord of the lands, you who make the heavenly kingdoms open to the blessed.

units.la: DE S. PAULO.
units.tr: CONCERNING ST PAUL.

units.la: Sancte Paule, Apostole, prædicator veri- tatis, & doctor gentium, intercede pro no- bis.
units.tr: Holy Paul, Apostle, preacher of the truth and teacher of the Gentiles, intercede for us.

units.la: Alia: O beate Paule, Apostole, te depre- cor, ut me ab angelo Satanæ eripias, & à ven- turâ irâ liberes, & in cœlum introducas.
units.tr: Another: O blessed Paul, Apostle, I beseech you to snatch me from the angel of Satan, to free me from the coming wrath, and to lead me into heaven.

units.la: Item: Illuc supplices tuos, post hujus car- nis terminum perducere dignare, quos feci- sti veritatis lumen agnoscere.
units.tr: Likewise: Deign to bring your suppliants, after the end of this flesh, to that place, you who have caused us to recognise the light of truth.

units.la: DE PAULI CONVERSIONE.
units.tr: CONCERNING THE CONVERSION OF PAUL.

units.la: Tractatus, ex Missali Romano.
units.tr: A tract, from the Roman Missal.

units.la: Tu es vas electionis, Sancte Paule Apo- stole. Verè dignè es glorificandus. Prædicator veritatis & doctor gentium in fide & verita- te, per te omnes gentes cognoverunt gratiam Dei. Intercede pro nobis.
units.tr: You are the chosen vessel, holy Paul the Apostle. Truly you are worthy to be glorified. Preacher of the truth and teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth, through you all nations have come to know the grace of God. Intercede for us.

units.la: DE S. ANDREA APOSTOLO.
units.tr: ON ST. ANDREW THE APOSTLE.

units.la: SEQUENTIA.
units.tr: SEQUENCE.

units.la: Andream perfelicia Per crucem manent gaudia, Jam Regem tuum spectas, Jam adoras, Jam in ejus aspectu Andrea stas. Odorem suavitatis aspiras, Qui divini amoris aromata dat. Sic ergo nobis &c.
units.tr: Andrew, most happy, through the cross your joys endure. Now you behold your King, now you adore him; now you stand, Andrew, in his presence. You breathe the sweet fragrance that gives the spices of divine love. So therefore for us, etc.

units.la: Sancte Andrea Apostole Dei, deprecor te, ut tuis meritis ab omni phantasia Satanae me eripias, & a futura ira defendas, & virtutem tuam mihi ante tribunal CHRISTI ostendas.
units.tr: Holy Andrew, Apostle of God, I beseech you that, by your merits, you would rescue me from every phantasm of Satan, defend me from the coming wrath, and show me your power before the judgment seat of Christ.

units.la: Et: Jam nos foveto languidos, Curamque nostri suscipe, Quo per crucis victoriam Coeli petamus patriam, Amen.
units.tr: And: Now cherish us who are weak, and take up our care, so that through the victory of the cross we may seek the homeland of heaven. Amen.

units.la: Item: Nos igitur peccatis nostris gravati, te Deus poscimus, ut illius (Andreae) qui tua semper sectatus praecepta, tibi placet, nos intercessione tueaaris in aeternum.
units.tr: Likewise: Therefore, weighed down by our sins, we ask you, O God, that through the intercession of him (Andrew), who always followed your precepts and pleases you, you would keep us safe forever.

units.la: DE S. JACOBO MAJORE.
units.tr: ON ST. JAMES THE GREATER.

units.la: Ave singulare praesidium peregrinorum. Lux & decus Hispaniae, O Jacobe sanctissime, Sublevator oppressorum, Suffragium viatorum. Tutorum benignus exaudi vota fervorum, Te colentes adjuva, Pacem ad coelestia.
units.tr: Hail, unique protection of pilgrims. Light and glory of Spain, most holy James, reliever of the oppressed, help of travellers. Gracious guardian, hear the prayers of your fervent devotees; aid those who honour you and lead them to the peace of heaven.

units.la: ITEM M:
units.tr: Likewise, M:

units.la: DE S. IOHANNE APOSTO-lo & Evangelista.
units.tr: On Saint John the Apostle and Evangelist.

units.la: Johannes, Jesu Christo multum dilecte, virgo, tu ejus amore carnalem in navi parentem liquisti, & lene conjugis pectus respuisti, Messiam secuta, ut ejus pectoris sacra meruisses fluenta potare. Tuq; in terra positus gloriam conspexisti filii Dei, quae solum sanctis in vita creditur contuenda esse perenni. Te Christus in cruce triumphans matri dedit custodem, ut virgo virginem servares, atq; curam suppeditares. Tu de carcere flagrisq; fractus testimonio pro Christo es gavisus. Idem mortuos suscitas, inq; Jesu nomine venenum forte vincis. Tibi summus, tacitus caeteris, verbum suum pater revelat. Tu nos omnes precibus apud Deum semper commenda, Johannes Christo chare. Amen.
units.tr: John, most dear to Jesus Christ, virgin, you left your earthly mother in the ship for love of him, and you rejected a gentle wife's bosom, following the Messiah, so that you might deserve to drink the sacred streams of his breast. And while you were placed on earth you gazed upon the glory of the Son of God, which alone is believed to be seen by the saints in life, everlastingly. Christ, triumphing on the cross, gave you to his mother as a guardian, so that you, a virgin, might keep the virgin and supply her care. You, broken by prison and scourges, rejoiced in testimony for Christ. You likewise raise the dead, and in the name of Jesus you overcome poison, should it happen. The Highest revealed his word to you, silent before the others. John, dear to Christ, always commend us all to God with your prayers. Amen.

units.la: Et: Cujus prece assidua Ut nostra solvas crimina, E coelo donans praemia, Voce precamur cernua.
units.tr: And: By whose constant prayer may he loosen our sins, bestowing rewards from heaven, we pray with bowed voice.

units.la: DE S. THOMA APOSTOLO.
units.tr: ON ST THOMAS THE APOSTLE.

units.la: Deus, pro cujus Ecclesia gloriosus Pontifex Thomas gladiis impiorum occubuit, praesta quaesumus, ut omnes, qui ejus implorant auxilium, petitionis suae salutarem consequantur effectum. ¶ Et: Tu nos supplices tuos in ejus fide stabiles efficere dignare, quem palpando meruisti Deum agnoscere.
units.tr: God, for whose Church the glorious Bishop Thomas fell by the swords of the wicked, grant, we beseech you, that all who implore his help may obtain the saving effect of their petition. ¶ And: Deign to make us, your suppliants, steadfast in his faith, he who merited to recognise God by touching him.

units.la: Spe mercedis & coronæStetit Thomas in agone,Ad mortem obædiens.
units.tr: In hope of reward and crown, Thomas stood firm in the contest, obedient unto death.

units.la: Morte Christum imitatus,Fide firmans & firmatus,Firmo gressu gradiens.
units.tr: Imitating Christ in death, strengthening his faith and strengthened by it, he walked with a firm step.

units.la: Furit furor militaris,Ut vir sacer sacris arisImmoletur hostia.
units.tr: Military rage raged, so that the holy man was sacrificed as a victim on the sacred altars.

units.la: Quem occidunt, & scientesIntroducunt, nescientes,Ad aeterna gaudia.
units.tr: Those whom they killed, they led, though they knew it not, to eternal joys.

units.la: Christi felix hic athletaQui subire mente lætâMortem non abhorruit.
units.tr: Here is the happy athlete of Christ, who did not shrink from death, undergoing it with a joyful mind.

units.la: Vt sit salus infirmorum,Et medela peccatorum,Gratiam promeruit.
units.tr: So that he might be the health of the weak and the cure of sinners, he merited grace.

units.la: Cæci, claudi, surdi, mutiSunt ad usum restituti,Divinâ clementiâ.
units.tr: The blind, the lame, the deaf and the dumb were restored to use by divine clemency.

units.la: Non est morbus, quem noncuret,Si morbosum no obdureoTandem diffidentia.
units.tr: There is no disease he does not cure, unless distrust at last hardens the sick man against him.

units.la: Hostes Christi Christo cedunt,Signa signis du succeduntArgumento fidei.
units.tr: Christ's enemies yield to Christ; sign follows sign, as the proof of faith.

units.la: Ergo Martyr invocetur,Ut per eum nobis deturAd superna provehi.
units.tr: Therefore let the martyr be invoked, that through him we may be carried up to heavenly things.

units.la: DE S. PHILIPPO APOSTOLO.
units.tr: ON ST PHILIP THE APOSTLE.

units.la: Sancte Philippe, Apostole Domini, te miser ego peccator, omnium criminum sordibus obvolutus, deprecor, ut ab omni me districto flagello, quod juste mereor, & ab omni damnatione, & à ventura ira liberes, & lampadibus ornatum, & lætum ad Regem gloriæ perducas.
units.tr: Holy Philip, Apostle of the Lord, I, a wretched sinner wrapped in the filth of every crime, beseech you: free me from every strict scourge which I justly deserve, and from every damnation and from the coming wrath, and lead me, adorned with lamps and joyful, to the King of glory.

units.la: DE S. JACOBO MINORE.
units.tr: DE S. JACOBO MINORE.

units.la: Felix Apostole,Magne martyr Jacobe,Te colentes adjuva.
units.tr: Happy Apostle, great martyr James, help those who honour you.

units.la: Peregrinos undiq;Tuos clemens protege,Ducens ad cælestia.
units.tr: Protect your pilgrims everywhere, mercifully leading them to heaven.

units.la: Sancte. S. Jacobe, Apostole Domini, te deprecor ego peccator, omni spurcitiâ plenus, ut me tuis gloriosis meritis, omni ab districto judicio, quod justè mereor, & ab irâ venturâ miseri-corditer eripias, & atro agmine fugato, sancto agmine appropinquante, in consortium An-gelorum, & sinum Abrahæ me tradas.
units.tr: Holy. Saint James, Apostle of the Lord, I, a sinner full of all filth, beg you that by your glorious merits you would mercifully snatch me from the strict judgement, which I justly deserve, and from the coming wrath, and, with the dark host put to flight and the holy host drawing near, that you would hand me over to the company of the Angels and the bosom of Abraham.

units.la: DE S. BARTHOLOMÆO Apostolo.
units.tr: DE S. BARTHOLOMÆO Apostolo.

units.la: Voto presamur supplici, | Quæsumus, ut ejus patrocinio Ut precibus Apostoli | Deseramus noxia, A reatu liberi, | Et consequamur bona æPossimus Deo perfrui. | terna.
units.tr: Let us humbly pray with a vow: we seek that by his patronage we may forsake our harmful ways, that by the prayers of the Apostle we may be freed from guilt, and may attain to enjoying God in eternal goods.

units.la: Sancte Bartholomæe, te precor, ut me tuis pretiosis meritis liberes ab omnibus versutiis diaboli, & insidiis, & terroribus, & impugnationibus, & damnatione, & illusione hostis, in die furoris Domini, & in fine vitæ meæ, contra adversarios meos in adjutorium meum venias, & binis luminibus suffulto, vestigia agni ostendas.
units.tr: Holy Bartholomew, I pray you that by your precious merits you would free me from all the wiles, snares, terrors and assaults of the devil, and from damnation and the deceit of the enemy, in the day of the wrath of the Lord and at the end of my life; come to my aid against my adversaries, and, supported by two lights, show me the footsteps of the Lamb.

units.la: Alia: Quæsumus te Bartholomæe, exorantes, ut detergas nostra hic facinora, quatenus utamur præmio, quod credentum repromisit Christus gregi pusillo, Amen.
units.tr: Another: We beseech you, Bartholomew, and pray that you would wipe away our crimes here, so that we may enjoy the reward which Christ promised to the little flock of believers. Amen.

units.la: DE S. MATTHÆO APOSTOLO & Evangelista.
units.tr: DE S. MATTHÆO APOSTOLO & Evangelista.

units.la: Sancte Matthæe Apostole, ego peccator te deprecor, ut me ab angustia, quam digne mereor, tuo interventu misericorditer defendere digneris.
units.tr: Holy Apostle Matthew, I, a sinner, beg you that by your intercession you would deign mercifully to defend me from the distress which I rightly deserve.

units.la: DE S. SIMONE APOSTOLO.
units.tr: DE S. SIMONE APOSTOLO.

units.la: Sancte Simon Zelotes, per gratiam illi- us, qui te elegit de mundo, te deprecor, ut me miserum ab omnibus adversitatibus & poenis, quas pro peccatis meis horribilibus mereor, eruas: & a cogitationibus immundis, tuis meritis emundes, & monita mihi tribuas, unde Angelica celsitudo admirabilem me videat & justum.
units.tr: Holy Simon the Zealot, through the grace of him who chose you out of the world, I beg you to snatch me, a wretch, from all the adversities and punishments which I deserve for my dreadful sins; cleanse me of unclean thoughts by your merits, and grant me admonitions, whereby the angelic height may see me as wonderful and just.

units.la: DE S. IUDA THADDÆO Apostolo.
units.tr: DE S. IUDA THADDÆO Apostolo.

units.la: Sancte Juda Apostole, per illum qui, te sibi in amicum ascivit, deprecor te, ut me a consuetudine peccatorum meorum, tuis meritis abstrahas, & a potestate daemonum eruas, & me ad invisibiles evehas potentias.
units.tr: Holy Apostle Jude, I beg you through him who took you as his friend, that by your merits you would draw me away from the habit of my sins, rescue me from the power of demons, and lift me up to the invisible powers.

units.la: DE S. MATTHIA APOSTOLO.
units.tr: DE S. MATTHIA APOSTOLO.

units.la: Sancte Matthia, te suppliciter imploro, ut meritis & intercessionibus tuis, ab eodem Domino nostro Jesu Christo veniam peccatorum meorum in hoc seculo percipiam, & in futuro vitam æternam possideam.
units.tr: Holy Matthias, I humbly implore you that, by your merits and intercessions, I may receive from the same Lord Jesus Christ forgiveness of my sins in this age, and may possess eternal life in the age to come.

units.la: DE MARTYRIBUS.
units.tr: DE MARTYRIBUS.

units.la: Vos Christi martyres, Nos valde fragiles Precibus nos justo judici Sincerisjugiter commendare curate. Amen.
units.tr: You martyrs of Christ, we who are very frail, commend us continually and sincerely with your prayers to the just Judge. Amen.

units.la: Item: O beata beatorum Martyrum solennia, O devote recolenda Victorum certamina. Digni dignis fulgent signis, Et florent virtutibus, Illas propter condecenter Veneremur laudibus. Fide, voto, corde toto Adhaserunt Domino, Et invicti sunt addicti Atroci martyrio. Carcerati, trucidati Pertulerunt plurima, Igne laesi, ferro casi Tormentorum genere.
units.tr: Also: O blessed solemnity of the blessed martyrs, O conflicts of the conquerors to be devoutly recalled. Worthy ones shine with worthy signs and flourish in virtues; let us fittingly honour them with praises. With faith, with vow, with whole heart, they clung to the Lord, and being unconquered, they were given over to a savage martyrdom. Imprisoned and slaughtered, they endured very many things; wounded by fire and felled by the sword, they were subjected to kinds of torment.

units.la: Dum sic torti cedunt morti Carnis per interitum, Ut electi sint adepti Beatorum pramia. Per contemtu mundanorum Et per bella fortia Meruerunt Angelorum Victores consortia. Ergo facti coharedes Christo in caelestibus, Apud ipsum vota nostra Promovete precibus. Ut post hujus finem vita Et post transitoria, In perenni mereamur Exultare gloria.
units.tr: While thus tortured they yield to death through the destruction of the flesh, so that the chosen might obtain the rewards of the blessed. Through contempt of worldly things and through brave wars they merited, as victors, fellowship with the Angels. Therefore, having been made joint heirs with Christ in heaven, promote our vows with your prayers before him, so that after the end of this life and after its passing things, we may deserve to exult in everlasting glory.

units.la: Et: Ad vos clarissimi Sanctorum Dei martyres, mente & corde ego nimius peccator proclamo, quatenus vos cum sanctissima oratione vestra, innumeras peccatorum meorum sordes, apud Dominum nostrum Jesu Christum, aliquatisp diminuere & delere digneamini, ut ultra vitam meam grandi meorum criminum pondere gravatum non inveniat.
units.tr: And: To you, most renowned martyrs of God, I, an excessive sinner, cry out with mind and heart, that you would deign, with your most holy prayer, to diminish and blot out, in some measure, before our Lord Jesus Christ, the countless filths of my sins, so that he may not find me weighed down by the great burden of my crimes beyond my life.

units.la: DE UNO MARTYRE.
units.tr: ON ONE MARTYR.

units.la: O Martyr Christi, Laudari qui meruisti, Ergo tua laudi Nos instantes pius audi, Nostra Deo votafac o martyr pie nota, Omnibus hoc praestaRecolentibus hac tua festa, Posti summas laudes, Ut pertingant, ubi gaudes, Rege sub aterno, Cum sanctiusjure jurperno. Amen.
units.tr: O martyr of Christ, who have earned to be praised, therefore hear us, pious one, as we press our praise upon you. Pious martyr, mark the vows we make to God and grant them to all who remember your feasts. Bring our highest praises so that they may reach where you rejoice. Reign under the eternal law, with the saints, by a right that endures forever. Amen.

units.la: ITEM:
units.tr: ALSO:

units.la: Martyr Dei tui precatus munere Nostrum reatum dilue Arcens mali contagium, Vitae removens tadium. Soluta sunt jam vincula, Tui sacrati corporis, Nos solve vinclis seculi, Amore Dei Filii.
units.tr: Martyr, by the gift of your God, wash away our guilt, ward off the contagion of evil, and remove our weariness of life. Now the bonds of your consecrated body are loosed; by the love of God's Son, loose us from the chains of the world.

units.la: Adesto, Domine, supplicationibus nostris, quas in beati N. martyris tui solennitate deferimus, ut qui nostrae justitiae fiduciam non habemus, ejus, qui tibi placuit, precibus adjuvemur.
units.tr: Be present, Lord, to our supplications, which we offer at the solemnity of your blessed martyr N., so that we, who have no confidence in our own righteousness, may be helped by the prayers of him who pleased you.

units.la: DE INNOCENTIBVS.
units.tr: CONCERNING THE INNOCENTS.

units.la: Quorum precibus sacris deprecamur, dele pie nostra crimina vitae, ut quos laudibus tuis junxeras, nobis isthinc dones clemens favere.
units.tr: By their holy prayers we beseech you: mercifully wash away the sins of our life, so that you, who joined them to your praises, may graciously grant us their favour from there.

units.la: Iterum: Clari filioli, duces pusioli, nos juvate precibus, quos Christus, innocentem mortem vestram miserans, pro sese maturatam, placidus exaudiens, nos regno suo dignetur.
units.tr: Again: Bright little sons, little leaders, help us with your prayers. May Christ, who pitied your innocent death, which he hastened on your behalf, graciously hear you and deem us worthy of his kingdom.

units.la: DE S. STEPHANO protomartyre.
units.tr: CONCERNING ST STEPHEN, THE FIRST MARTYR.

units.la: SEQUENTIA.
units.tr: SEQUENCE.

units.la: O Stephane, signifer Regis summi bone nos exaudi. Proficue qui es pro tuis exaudi-tus inimicis.
units.tr: O Stephen, standard-bearer of the highest King, good one, hear us. You who were heard to good purpose for your enemies.

units.la: Paulus tuis precibus, Stephane, te quon-dam dam persecutus, Christo credit, & tecum tri- pudiat in regno, cui nullus persecutor ap- propinquat.
units.tr: Paul, once persecuting you, Stephen, believed in Christ through your prayers, and exults with you in the kingdom, which no persecutor draws near.

units.la: Nos proinde, nos supplices ad te clamantes & precibus pulsantes.
units.tr: Therefore we, as suppliants, cry out to you and knock with our prayers.

units.la: Oratio sanctissima nos tua semper conciliet Deo nostro.
units.tr: May your most holy prayer always commend us to our God.

units.la: Ad eundem: Sancte protomartyr, & diuinissime Levita Christi, Stephane, ad te confugio, te invoco, te supplicitêr & obnixè deprecor, ut intercedere digneris pro me nimis fragili & indigno, ad Dominum Jesum Christum,
units.tr: To the same: Holy first martyr and most divine Levite of Christ, Stephen, I flee to you, I call upon you, and I earnestly and urgently beg you to deign to intercede for me, who am too frail and unworthy, before the Lord Jesus Christ.

units.la: Adjuva me, quaeso, immaculate & invictissime testis veritatis, ut quia tuo exemplo, nec innocenter vivere, nec gloriose mori valeo, saltem co necesso mihi, per Dei misericordiam, & tuæ intercessionis merita, spatio vitæ meæ, sordes ita congruâ emundatione diluam, ut in articulo mortis ab auditione malâ liberatus, sententiam perpetuæ damnationis evadam.
units.tr: Help me, I pray, immaculate and most unconquered witness of the truth. Since I can neither live innocently nor die gloriously after your example, at least in the span of my life, through God's mercy and the merits of your intercession, may I wash away my filth with such fitting cleansing that, freed at the hour of death from evil hearing, I may escape the sentence of everlasting damnation.

units.la: Iterum:
units.tr: Again:

units.la: Sancte Dei pretiosè Protomartyr Stephane, Qui virtute charitatis Circumfusus undique Dominum pro inimico Exorasti populo: Fundo preces pro devotè Tibi nunc collegio, Ut tuo propitiatus Interventu Dominus Nos purgatos à peccatis Jungat cœli civibus.
units.tr: Holy Stephen, precious first martyr of God, who, surrounded on every side by the power of charity, begged the Lord for the people who were your enemies: I now pour out devout prayers for this college of yours, so that the Lord, being propitiated by your intercession, may cleanse us from our sins and join us to the citizens of heaven.

units.la: SEQUUNTUR MARTYRES alii ex ordine Calendarii. DE S. SEBASTIANO. 20. Ianuarii.
units.tr: THE MARTYRS THAT FOLLOW IN ORDER OF THE CALENDAR. CONCERNING ST SEBASTIAN. 20 January.

units.la: INTROITUS:
units.tr: INTROIT:

units.la: Egregie Christi martyr Sebastiane, princeps & propagator sanctissimorum praeceptorum, ecce nomen tuum in libro vitae caelestis adscriptum est, & memoriale &c.
units.tr: Outstanding martyr of Christ, Sebastian, prince and propagator of the most holy precepts, behold, your name is written in the book of heavenly life, and a memorial, etc.

units.la: COLLECTA:
units.tr: COLLECT:

units.la: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus, qui meritis beati & gloriosi Martyris tui Sebastiani, quandam generalem pestem hominum mortiferam revocasti, praesta supplicibus tuis, ut qui pro consimili peste revocanda, ad ipsum, sub tua confidentia, confugiunt ejus meritis & precibus ab ipsa & omni tribulatione liberemur, &c.
units.tr: Almighty and eternal God, who through the merits of your blessed and glorious martyr Sebastian once recalled a certain general deadly plague of men, grant to your suppliants, who flee to him in your trust for the recalling of a similar plague, that by his merits and prayers we may be freed from this and from every tribulation, etc.

units.la: Graduale: O Sancte Sebastiane, Christi athleta gloriosissime, qui pro Christo relinquisti terrenae militiae principatum, & suscepisti immane supplicium, intercede pro nobis ad Dominum.
units.tr: Gradual: O St Sebastian, most glorious athlete of Christ, who for Christ gave up the leadership of earthly military service and underwent a monstrous punishment, intercede for us with the Lord.

units.la: O Sancte Sebastiane, Christi martyr egregie, cujus meritis tota patria Lombardiae liberata a mortifera peste, libera nos ab ipsa & a maligno hoste.
units.tr: O St Sebastian, outstanding martyr of Christ, by whose merits the whole land of Lombardy was freed from deadly plague, free us from it and from the evil enemy.

units.la: O Sancte Sebastiane, imploramus non inane tuum clemens auxilium, ut possim obtinere per te pestis mortiferae apud Jesum remedium.
units.tr: O St Sebastian, we implore your kind aid, not in vain, that through you we may obtain with Jesus a remedy for deadly plague.

units.la: Secreta: Subveniant nobis, Domine, meri- ta tua, intercedente beato Sebastiano Martyre tuo, ut ab imminentibus peccatoro no- strorum periculis, te mereamur protegente eripi, & suis precibus liberari, per &c.
units.tr: Secret: May your merits, Lord, come to our help, through the intercession of your blessed martyr Sebastian, so that, from the impending dangers of our sins, we may deserve to be snatched away under your protection and freed by his prayers, through etc.

units.la: Complenda:
units.tr: Postcommunion:

units.la: Da, quæsumus Domine, populo tuo salutem mentis & corporis, interventu beati Sebastiani, martyris tui, ut bonis operibus inhærendo, tuæ semper virtutis, & eorum meritorum mereamur protectione defendi.
units.tr: Grant, we beseech you, Lord, to your people health of mind and body, through the intercession of blessed Sebastian, your martyr, that by cleaving to good works we may always deserve to be defended by the protection of your power and of his merits.

units.la: De eodem. Deus, qui gloriosum tuum martyrem Sebastianum, in tua fide & dilectione tam ardente tolidasti, da nobis miseris peccatoribus, ejus meritis & intercessione, in omni tribulatione auxilium, in persecutione solatium, in angustia subsidium.
units.tr: Of the same. O God, who made your glorious martyr Sebastian so ardent in your faith and love, grant us wretched sinners, by his merits and intercession, help in every tribulation, solace in persecution, and support in distress.

units.la: Offertorium: Martyr egregie, decus militiæ, athleta Dei, ora Dei Natum, ut avertat a nobis indignationem suam. Martyr suffragia effunde pia, ut epidemia non sit noxia, in hac patria, aut in alia, quæ subsidia deposcit tua. Audi talia præconia. Hæc, prece pia, danturque præmia. Miles ejus nobis, Halleluja.
units.tr: Offertory: Outstanding martyr, glory of the soldiery, athlete of God, pray to God's Son that he may turn away his indignation from us. Martyr, pour forth devout intercessions, that the epidemic may not be harmful in this land or in another, which asks for your aid. Hear such praises. By this pious prayer, let rewards be given. His soldier for us, Hallelujah.

units.la: Item:
units.tr: Likewise:

units.la: Ora pro nobis, Christi martyr Sebastiane, ut pestem epidemiæ illæsi mereamur pertransire, & promissionem Christi Jesu obtinere.
units.tr: Pray for us, Sebastian, martyr of Christ, that unharmed we may deserve to pass through the epidemic plague and obtain the promise of Christ Jesus.

units.la: Pz
units.tr: Pz

units.la: O beate Sebastiane, magna est fides tua, intercede pro nobis, ad Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, ut a morte epidemiæ, & ab omni infirmitate corporis & animæ, tua intercessione liberemur.
units.tr: O blessed Sebastian, great is your faith; intercede for us with our Lord Jesus Christ, that by your intercession we may be freed from the death of epidemic and from every infirmity of body and soul.

units.la: DE S. VINCENTIO. 22. Januarii.
units.tr: ON SAINT VINCENT. 22 January.

units.la: Vir inclytus Vincentius, martyr Domini pretiosus, cujus intercessio nobis obtineat veniam, qui per tormenta passionis æternam meruisti palmam, & sempiternam coronam.
units.tr: Illustrious man Vincent, precious martyr of the Lord, whose intercession may obtain pardon for us, you who through the torments of your passion have merited the eternal palm and the everlasting crown.

units.la: O beate Vincenti, martyr Christi inclyte, exora pro me Deum omnipotentem, ut tua prece placatus, mihi condonet meorum veniam commissorum, & in bono opere finem reddat perseverabilem.
units.tr: O blessed Vincent, illustrious martyr of Christ, pray to almighty God for me, that, being moved by your prayer, He may pardon me the forgiveness of my sins and grant an enduring end to my good works.

units.la: [DE S. BLASIO. 3. Februarii.
units.tr: [ON ST BLAISE. 3 February.

units.la: Sancte Blasi, vir laudande &c. Qui dat lapsis relevamen, Et infirmis dos juvamen. Tu pro nobis intercede, Ut cœlesti nos mercede Ditet Deus cum beatis Regno suæ claritatis.
units.tr: Holy Blaise, a man to be praised, etc. You who give relief to the fallen and help as a dowry to the weak, intercede for us, that God may enrich us with the heavenly reward and the kingdom of his glory among the blessed.

units.la: Deus, qui per orationem beati Blasii martyris tui atque pontificis, cunctis ejusdem memoriam facientibus, à quacunque tribulatione latione, infirmitate, seu adversitate tenerentur, liberari concessisti: concede propitius, ut cujus memoriam agimus in terris, eodem deprecante, gloriam consequamur in coelis.
units.tr: O God, who hast granted that through the prayer of blessed Blaise, thy martyr and bishop, all who call his memory to mind may be freed from whatever tribulation, infirmity or adversity holds them, grant graciously that we, whose memory of him we celebrate on earth, may by his intercession attain glory in heaven.

units.la: Te simul fusis precibus rogamus,
units.tr: We beseech you together with our outpoured prayers,

units.la: Civium fautor maneas tuorum,
units.tr: Be the patron of your citizens,

units.la: Ad thronum Christi memor esto nostri,
units.tr: Be mindful of us before the throne of Christ,

units.la: Optime Blasi.
units.tr: Best Blaise.

units.la: DE EODEM, MANTUANUS.
units.tr: CONCERNING THE SAME, MANTUANUS.

units.la: Adsis Sancte tuis, & nos dignare clientes
units.tr: Be present, holy one, to your people, and deign to keep us

units.la: Custodire; nihil nobis angina, nec ulli
units.tr: your clients; let neither quinsy nor any disease

units.la: Officiant morbi: tua praesentissima nobis
units.tr: harm us; let your most present protection

units.la: Sit tutela salus: tibi mitia corda fuerunt
units.tr: be our safety. Your heart has always been

units.la: Semper, & es solitus voces audire precantū.
units.tr: gentle, and you are wont to hear the voices of those who pray.

units.la: Tu nurui reddis cicurem, tu guttura verbo
units.tr: You make the daughter-in-law gentle to her husband's family; you open throats

units.la: Suffocata aperis: & nos audire memento.
units.tr: choked by a word. Remember to hear us also.

units.la: DE S. PANCRATIO.
units.tr: CONCERNING ST PANCRATIUS.

units.la: 12. Maji.
units.tr: 12 May.

units.la: O martyr invictissime,
units.tr: O most unconquered martyr,

units.la: Pancrati beatissime,
units.tr: most blessed Pancras,

units.la: Qui in Christi confessione
units.tr: who in the confession of Christ

units.la: Perdurasti in persecutione,
units.tr: endured through persecution,

units.la: Tuo mereamur precamine
units.tr: may we, by your intercession,

units.la: In bonis mala vincere.
units.tr: overcome evils with goods.

units.la: DE S. ERASMO.
units.tr: CONCERNING ST ERASMUS.

units.la: 3. Junii.
units.tr: 3 June.

units.la: Stet semper in tripudio
units.tr: May the assembly of the needy

units.la: Egenorum jam concio,
units.tr: always stand in rejoicing,

units.la: Habens civem in æthere,Qui suos scit reprimere,Defectus deprecamur:Etin mortis examineSic Erasmus præparatut,Nostros tergat ut reatus.
units.tr: having a citizen in heaven who knows how to restrain his own. We pray for our failings, and that in the trial of death Erasmus may so prepare us that he may wipe away our guilt.

units.la: Modò sancte Erasme, tibi commendo ômne consilium meum, & omnes actus meos, & omnia, quæ mihi subjecta sunt, in tuam sanctam fidem, ut eruas me ab omnibus adversitatibus, & à cunctis meis inimicis, corporalibus & spiritualibus, propter repromissum tibi à Deo spiritualiter concessum.
units.tr: Now, holy Erasmus, I commend to you all my counsel, all my actions, and all that has been entrusted to me, into your holy faith, that you may deliver me from all adversities and from all my enemies, bodily and spiritual, on account of the promise made to you by God in a spiritual manner.

units.la: ET:
units.tr: AND:

units.la: Fac nos ejus meritis & precibus, cunctas insidias omnium inimicorum nostrorum superare, & à paupertate corporis & animæ, ac morte perpetua liberari.
units.tr: By his merits and prayers, grant that we may overcome all the snares of all our enemies, and be freed from poverty of body and soul, and from eternal death.

units.la: DE S. LAURENTIO.
units.tr: CONCERNING ST LAWRENCE

units.la: 10. Augusti.
units.tr: 10 August.

units.la: Adest nanque festivitasEt dies venerabilis,Qua cœlum pro meritisLaurentius ingressus est.
units.tr: For the festival is here / and the venerable day, / on which Lawrence, by his merits, entered heaven.

units.la: Ipse dignetur DominumRogare clementissimum,Vt ab æternis ignibusNos servet & dæmonibus.
units.tr: May he deign to ask the most merciful Lord / that he keep us from the eternal fires / and from the demons.

units.la: EX MISSALI ROMANO.
units.tr: FROM THE ROMAN MISSAL.

units.la: Levita Laurentius bonum opus operatus est, quod per signum crucis cæcos illuminavit.
units.tr: The deacon Lawrence performed a good work, when by the sign of the cross he gave sight to the blind.

units.la: Q Lau-
units.tr: O Lau-

units.la: O Laurenti, militum Davidinvictissime Regis æterni, apud illum servulis ipsius deprecare veniam semper martyr milesque fortis, Amen.
units.tr: O Lawrence, most invincible soldier of David, of the eternal King, always martyr and brave soldier, pray to him on behalf of his servants that they may receive pardon. Amen.

units.la: DE S. ROCHO.
units.tr: ABOUT ST ROCH.

units.la: 16. Augusti.
units.tr: 16 August.

units.la: Collecta. Deus, qui es gloriosus in gloria Sanctorum, qui cunctis ad eorum patrocinia confluentibus, suæ petitionis salutarem præstas effectum, concede plebi tuæ, ut interdente beato Rocho, confessore tuo, quæ in ejus celebritate se devotam exhibet, a languore & epidemiæ peste, quam in suo corpore, pro tui nominis gloria passus est, sit libera, & tuo nomini semper sit devota.
units.tr: Collect. O God, who are glorious in the glory of the saints, and who grant a saving effect to the petitions of all who flock to their patronage, grant to your people that, through the intercession of blessed Roch, your confessor, those who devote themselves to his celebration may be freed from the sickness and the pestilential plague which he suffered in his own body for the glory of your name, and may always be devoted to your name.

units.la: GRADVALE:
units.tr: GRADUAL:

units.la: Tibi sancto Rocho honor sit & gloria, & deprecantes apud cœleste numen, tuis precibus a morbo epidemiæ salvos redde.
units.tr: Let there be honour and glory to you, holy Roch; and, interceding before the heavenly power, by your prayers restore us, who are saved, from the epidemic disease.

units.la: Fac quæsumus, beate Confessor Christi, ut apud Deum preces nostræ non sint vanæ, & nobis aëris temperiem concede, ut in fine tecum in cœlis congratulemur.
units.tr: We beseech you, blessed confessor of Christ, that our prayers before God may not be in vain, and grant us a mild air, so that at the end we may rejoice with you in heaven.

units.la: O beate confessor Roche, o quàm magna apud Deum merita tua, quibus credimus nos a morbo epidemiæ posse liberari, & aëris temperiem concede.
units.tr: O blessed confessor Roch, how great are your merits before God, by which we believe we can be freed from the epidemic disease; and grant us a mild air.

units.la: SEQUENTIA,
units.tr: SEQUENCE,

units.la: Gloriosus suffragator Sanctus Rochus consolator Cunctis venerabilis. Doctis scriptis Sancti Pauli Coepit corpus castigare Adolescens nobilis, Paterna oppida linquens, Pera, baculo gradiens, Exul quaerit Italos. Romam, aliaque loca Pestilentia vexata Cruce signavit agros. Principatu se abdicans, Et agris distribuens, Pauperatem elegit. Placentia pestilentes In hospitali degentes Morbos cunctos subegit, Percussos febre acuta Transfixus costa sinistra Galliam visitavit.
units.tr: Glorious intercessor, Saint Roch, comforter, venerable to all. Learned in the writings of Saint Paul, a noble youth began to chastise his body. Leaving his father's towns, he walked with a staff; an exile, he sought Italy. Rome and other places troubled by pestilence he marked with the cross. Renouncing his princely rank, and distributing his lands, he chose poverty. At Piacenza, in the hospital, among those stricken with plague, he overcame all diseases; those struck by acute fever, and pierced in the left side, he visited in France.

units.la: In paternis ut traditor Quinque annis maceratus Carcerem sustinuit. Tricesimo & secundo Migravit de vita anno, A nobis ignoratur. Tunc oravit ad Dominum, Ut invocans nomen suum A peste sanaretur. Omnes peste laborantes, Ad Rochum confugientes, Trucem evadunt mortem. Hac in tabula descripta, Latere ejus reperta, Hanc continebant fortem: ROCHE pater eximie, Succurre Epidemia, Quali truce vexamur. Medere nostris mentibus, Expulsis languoribus, Ut tecum gloriemur. Amen.
units.tr: Taken for a traitor in his father's lands, wasted away for five years, he endured prison. In his thirty-second year he departed from this life; of this we are ignorant. Then he prayed to the Lord that, calling upon his name, he might be healed of the plague. All who suffer from plague, fleeing to Roch, escape a grim death. On this tablet, written down and found at his side, they held this strong prayer: Roch, outstanding father, come to the aid of this epidemic with which we are cruelly afflicted. Heal our minds, drive out our sicknesses, so that we may rejoice with you. Amen.

units.la: ALIA SEQUENTIA:
units.tr: ANOTHER SEQUENCE:

units.la: Verbum credit, verbum edit, Verbo instanter obœdit, Per quod mira ostendit Rochus sacratissimus, Per quod ægros sanat multos, Exteros & peregrinos, Viduas & pupillos Pascit vir mitissimus, Ave caput Gallicorum, Patrone Italorum, Et sodalis Germanorum, Pater ululantium. Ave, morbos qui fanasti, Bona egenis donasti, Mundo lapsa impetrasti Vitam & imperium. Ave Roche serve Dei, Pater pie, signum spei Amatorque summae rei, Angelorum corona. Pro nobis Deum precare. Ne nos morbo det vexare Pestis epidemiae, Sed dare sempiterna gaudia. Amen.
units.tr: He believes the word, he eats the word, he obeys the word with unwavering zeal, through which the most holy Roch shows wonders, through which he heals many of the sick, foreigners and strangers, and that most gentle man feeds widows and orphans. Hail, head of the French, patron of the Italians, and comrade of the Germans, father of those who wail. Hail, you who healed diseases, who gave goods to the needy, who obtained for the fallen world life and dominion. Hail, Roch, servant of God, pious father, sign of hope and lover of the highest cause, crown of the angels. Pray to God for us, that the epidemic plague may not afflict us with disease, but grant us eternal joys. Amen.

units.la: Item: Vale Roche, Angelicae Vocis citatus famine Obtinuisti deificē, A cunctis pestem pellere. Ora pro nobis beate Roche, ut mereamur praeservari a peste.
units.tr: Also: Farewell, Roch, summoned by the voice of an angel, you obtained by divine favour to drive plague away from all. Pray for us, blessed Roch, that we may deserve to be preserved from plague.

units.la: Offertorium: Te beatum Rochum, Christi confessorem, exoratum facimus, & preces ad te patrem nostrum dirigimus, ut tua intercessione a languoribus epidemiae salvemur, & aeris temperie potiamur.
units.tr: Offertory: We make you, blessed Roch, confessor of Christ, our entreated advocate, and we direct our prayers to you, our father, that by your intercession we may be saved from the sicknesses of the epidemic and obtain a temperate air.

units.la: Secreta: Parce nobis, Domine, & flagella tuæ tuæ, quæ peccata nostra merentur, precibus & meritis beatissimi confessoris tui Rochi nobis misericorditer averte.
units.tr: Secret: Spare us, Lord, and in your mercy turn away from us, through the prayers and merits of your most blessed confessor Roch, the scourges which our sins deserve.

units.la: Communio: O quàm magnificum est nomen tuum, beate Roche, quod tuis intercessionibus multitudinem languentium nosti sanare, & nomen tuum gloriosum commemorantibus omnibus te propitium exhibere. Veni & salva nos à morbo ac epidemiæ pestæ, & aëris temperiem concede.
units.tr: Communion: O how glorious is your name, blessed Roch, that by your intercessions you know how to heal the multitude of the sick, and that you show yourself gracious to all who call your glorious name to mind. Come and save us from disease and the epidemic plague, and grant us a temperate air.

units.la: Complenda: Præsta, quæsumus, omnipotens Deus, ut qui cœlestia alimenta percepimus, intercedente beato Rocho Confessore tuo, per hæc contra omnia adversa mundi muniamur, ab omni morbo, & peste, ac subitanea morte liberemur.
units.tr: Postcommunion: Grant, we beseech you, almighty God, that we who have received heavenly food may, through the intercession of blessed Roch, your confessor, be fortified by it against all the adversities of the world, and be freed from every disease and plague, and from sudden death.

units.la: ALIA PRECATIO.
units.tr: ANOTHER PRAYER.

units.la: Deus, qui beato Rocho per angelum tuum, tabulam eidem afferentem, promisisti, ut, qui ipsum pie invocaverit, à nullo pestis cruciatu lederetur: præsta, quæsumus, ut, qui ejus memoriam agimus, meritis ejus ab æterna morte liberemur.
units.tr: O God, who through your angel bringing a tablet to blessed Roch promised that whoever invoked him devoutly would be harmed by no torment of plague: grant, we beseech you, that we who celebrate his memory may, by his merits, be freed from eternal death.

units.la: DE S. CORNELIO ET CYPRIANO.
units.tr: ABOUT SAINTS CORNELIUS AND CYPRIAN.

units.la: 13. Septembris.
units.tr: 13 September.

units.la: Infirmitatē nostram, quæsumus Domine, propipropitius respice, & mala omnia, quæ justè meremur sanctorum martyrum tuorum, pariterq; Pontificum Cornelii & Cypriani intercessione, propitiatus averte.
units.tr: We beseech you, O Lord, to look graciously upon our weakness, and, by the intercession of your holy martyrs and of the bishops Cornelius and Cyprian, mercifully turn away all the evils that we justly deserve.

units.la: DE S. LAMBERTO.
units.tr: ABOUT SAINT LAMBERT.

units.la: 17. Septembris.
units.tr: 17 September.

units.la: Intercessio, quæsumus Domine, beati Lamberti Martyris tui atq; Pontificis, tuam nobis non desinat placare justitiam, & nostrum tibi devotum efficere famulatum.
units.tr: May the intercession of blessed Lambert, your martyr and bishop, we beseech you, O Lord, never cease to appease your justice toward us and make us devoted to your service.

units.la: DE S. MAURITIO.
units.tr: ABOUT SAINT MAURICE.

units.la: 22. Septembris.
units.tr: 22 September.

units.la: Cui quapropter supplicantes, illi preces fundimus, ut, dignetur nobis Christū facere propitium, quem amavit, cum quo regnat, nunc & in perpetuum.
units.tr: Therefore we pour out our prayers to him, as we supplicate him, that he would deign to make Christ merciful to us, whom he loved, and with whom he reigns now and for ever.

units.la: DE SS. COSMA ET DAMIANO.
units.tr: ABOUT SAINTS COSMAS AND DAMIAN.

units.la: 27. Septembris.
units.tr: 27 September.

units.la: O Medici piissimi, | Aut moriamur spiritu, Qui meritis clarissimi, | Sed anima ob obitu In cœlis refulgetis, | Velociter surgamus. A peste, clade corporum | Et vivamus in gratia, Præservetis, & operum | Sacri cœli palatia Moribus ne languEamus, | Donec ingrediamur. Concede nobis indignis famulis tuis, ut qui sanctorum istorum martyrum gloriosam commemorationem agimus, ipsorum intercedentibus meritis, ab omnibus daemonum erepti insidiis, atq; cunctis hujus vitae adversitatibus, praesens tempus ita in tuis laudibus peragamus, ut missis peccatis omnibus, post hujus vitae pericula, ad gaudia transeamus securi.
units.tr: O most pious physicians, most renowned for your merits, you shine in the heavens; let us not die in spirit, but rise quickly and live in grace, and may you keep us from the plague and the ruin of our bodies, and from the sickness of our morals, so that we do not languish until we enter the holy palaces of heaven. Grant to us, unworthy servants of yours, that as we celebrate the glorious commemoration of these holy martyrs, by their intercessions we may be rescued from all the snares of the demons and from all the adversities of this life, and so spend the present time in your praises that, all our sins being put away, after the perils of this life we may pass securely to joy.

units.la: DE S. DIONYSIO, 9. Octobris.
units.tr: ON SAINT DIONYSIUS, 9 October.

units.la: Sancte Dionysi, Galliae Doctor, & inclyte martyr, te deprecor, ne despicias me, sed suscipias preces meas, & redime me ex omnibus paupertatibus & tribulationibus animae & corporis. Rogo te, S. Dionysi, tuosque socios, ut suscipiatis animam meam, quando praesentata fuerit ante tribunal judicis, & deprecemini regem potentem, ut per vestra suffragia merear liberari a tormentis perpetuis.
units.tr: Holy Dionysius, teacher of Gaul and famous martyr, I beseech you: do not despise me, but accept my prayers, and rescue me from all the poverties and afflictions of soul and body. I ask you, Saint Dionysius, and your companions, to take up my soul when it is presented before the judgment seat of the Judge, and to entreat the mighty King, so that by your intercession I may deserve to be freed from eternal torments.

units.la: DE S. GEREONE ET SOCIIS. 10. Octobris.
units.tr: Concerning St Gereon and his companions. 10 October.

units.la: Majestati sacrosanctae Militans, cum triumphante Jubilet Ecclesia, De triumpho Thebaeorum, Et salute peccatorum, Per horum suffragia. Hac patrona legione, Nos in bonis summe bona Loca potioribus. Ubi tui & amoris Sacri frui mereamur Sempiterna gloria. Amen.
units.tr: To the most holy Majesty the Church militant rejoices, together with the Church triumphant, over the triumph of the Theban soldiers and the salvation of sinners, through their intercession. Under this patron legion, may we, who are in the greatest good things, be placed in the better places, where we may deserve to enjoy your love and sacred eternal glory. Amen.

units.la: DE OMNIBVS SANCTIS Confessoribus.
units.tr: ON ALL THE HOLY CONFESSORS.

units.la: Omnes Sancti Sacerdotes & Confessores Dei, nolite me despicere, sed sicut optastis a Deo, hic adhuc positi in morrali corpore, audite me, ut vestro sacratissimo interventu, a peccatis exui, & a pœnis absolvi, & a cunctis tentationum periculis erui merear.
units.tr: All you holy priests and confessors of God, do not despise me. As you have asked of God, while you were still placed in mortal body, hear me, so that through your most sacred intercession I may deserve to be freed from sins, absolved from punishments, and rescued from all the dangers of temptation.

units.la: DE VNO CONFESSORE.
units.tr: ON ONE CONFESSOR.

units.la: Unde nunc noster chorus in honore, ipsius hymnum canit hunc libenter, ut pie ejus meritis juvemur, omne per ævum.
units.tr: Hence our choir now sings this hymn gladly in his honour, so that by his merits we may be devoutly aided for ever.

units.la: Et: Pastor bone, miserere Ecclesiæ, tuisq; precibus refove, confer opem plebi tuæ, preces intende, & pio juvamine maculas dilue.
units.tr: And: Good Shepherd, have mercy on the Church; refresh her with your prayers; bring help to your people; attend to our prayers and wash away our stains with your devoted aid.

units.la: In via nos adjuva, colloca in patriâ, redde, quæ speramus, bona.
units.tr: Help us on the way, place us in our homeland, and give us the good things we hope for.

units.la: Iterum: Tu splendorem præstas Ecclesiis miraculis & signis variis. Tu coruscas virtutum radiis. Tu protegas nos ab insidiis. Amen.
units.tr: Again: You give splendour to the churches by miracles and various signs. You shine with the rays of virtues. You protect us from snares. Amen.

units.la: Sancte N. nos tuos famulos pio precatu ab omni culpâ emunda, commendans Deo, cœlestium ut confortes faciat gaudiorum.
units.tr: Holy N., cleanse us your servants from all guilt by your devout prayer, commending us to God, that he may make us partakers of heavenly joys.

units.la: Intercessio nos; quæsumus Domine, beati N. confessoris commendet, ut quod nostris meritis non valemus, ejus patrocinio assequamur. Misericordiam tuam, quæsumus Domine, nobis, intercedente beato confessore tuo, clementer impende, & nobis peccatoribus ipsius propitiare suffragiis.
units.tr: We beseech you, Lord, let the intercession of blessed N., confessor, commend us, so that what we cannot obtain by our own merits we may attain by his patronage. We beseech you, Lord, mercifully bestow your mercy upon us, through the intercession of your blessed confessor, and be merciful to us sinners by his prayers.

units.la: DE CONFESSORE & Pontifice.
units.tr: ON A CONFESSOR AND BISHOP.

units.la: Infirmitatem nostram respice Omnipotens Deus, & quos pondus propriæ actionis gravat, beati N. martyris tui atq; pontificis intercessio gloriosa nos protegat.
units.tr: Almighty God, look upon our weakness, and let the glorious intercession of blessed N., your martyr and bishop, protect us, whom the weight of our own deeds burdens.

units.la: Deus, qui nos beati N. martyris tui atque Pontificis annua solennitate lætificas, concede propitius, ut, cujus natalitia colimus, de ejusdem etiam protectione gaudeamus.
units.tr: O God, who gladden us with the yearly solemnity of blessed N., your martyr and bishop, graciously grant that we who celebrate his birthday into heaven may also rejoice in his protection.

units.la: Exaudi, quæsumus Domine, preces nostras, quas in beati N. confessoris tui atque Pontificis solennitate deferimus, ut, qui dignè tibi meruit famulari, ejus intercedentibus meritis, ab omnibus nos absolvas peccatis.
units.tr: Hear, we beseech you, Lord, our prayers, which we offer in the solemnity of blessed N., your confessor and bishop, so that, by his intercessory merits, you may absolve us from all our sins, he who was worthy to serve you well.

units.la: DE S. BERNWARDO, CONFESSORE & Episcopo.
units.tr: ON ST BERNWARD, CONFESSOR AND BISHOP.

units.la: O gemma Saxoniæ, norma pietatis, decus tuæ patriæ, Bernwarde, dux pacis, nos opprestos erige, succurre turbatis ad Christum, dirige fontem bonitatis. Pie præsul Bernwarde, tuorum memor operum, sta coram summo judice, pro tuorum cœtu pauperum. Omnipotens sempiterne Deus, immensā clementiam tuam humiliter implorāmus, ut qui fragilitate carnis præpediti, innumerabiliter peccavimus, B. Bernwardi Confessoris tui atque Pontificis assiduis precibus adjuvemur, quatenus ejus suffragantibus meritis ab omni adversitate mentis & corporis liberemur.
units.tr: O jewel of Saxony, rule of piety, glory of your homeland, Bernward, leader of peace, raise us who are oppressed; help us who are troubled to Christ; direct us to the fountain of goodness. Devout prelate Bernward, mindful of your works, stand before the supreme judge for the company of your poor. Almighty, eternal God, we humbly implore your boundless mercy, that we, who through the frailty of the flesh have sinned countless times, may be helped by the constant prayers of blessed Bernward, your confessor and bishop, so that by his supporting merits we may be freed from every adversity of mind and body.

units.la: DE S. WILHELMO CONFESSORE.
units.tr: ON ST WILLIAM, CONFESSOR.

units.la: O Christi miles atq; discipule, beatissime Guilhelme, meritis venerande, qui seculi blandimenta devincendo, cœleste regnum meruisti, in quo nunc gloriosē coronatus exultas, nostros reatus piā prece relaxa, ut tuis adjuti patrociniis ad gaudia æternæ vitæ pervenire mereamur.
units.tr: O soldier and disciple of Christ, most blessed William, venerable for your merits, who, by overcoming the flatteries of the age, earned the heavenly kingdom, in which you now exult, gloriously crowned: loosen our guilt by your pious prayer, so that, aided by your patronage, we may deserve to attain the joys of eternal life.

units.la: DE EPISCOPIS.
units.tr: ON BISHOPS.

units.la: DE S. AMBROSIO, EPISCOPO Mediolanensi 4. Aprilis.
units.tr: OF ST. AMBROSE, BISHOP OF MILAN, 4 April.

units.la: O præsul beatissime Ambrosi, doctor inclyte, Vitæ meæ rege cursum Post hanc vitam trahe sursum Animam ad gaudia. Ubi Deum contemplari, Justis pie sociari Merear in gloria.
units.tr: O most blessed prelate Ambrose, renowned teacher, guide the course of my life; after this life draw my soul up to the joys above, that I may be deemed worthy to behold God and to be joined in glory with the righteous.

units.la: Ut, quem doctorem vitæ æternæ habuimus in terris, intercessorem semper apud te habere mereamur in cœlis.
units.tr: That we, who had you as a teacher of eternal life on earth, may be worthy always to have you as our intercessor with Thee in heaven.

units.la: DES. AVGVSTINO, EPISCOPO Hipponensi. 28. Augusti.
units.tr: ON ST AUGUSTINE, BISHOP OF HIPPO. 28 August.

units.la: Graduale: Augustine flos praesulum, qui clausa referasti, qui sacrae nobis poculum doctrinae propinasti, & haereses damnasti, nos visita, nos suscita, qui vitam praedicasti, Halleluja. Ave flos atque lumen doctorum, nos foedos luto vitiorum munda festive Augustine. Halleluja.
