units.la: Quam transfigunt amoro- Contemplante vultu Chri-
units.tr: Whom, as they gaze on the face of Christ,

units.la: Crucifixi stigmata. Electorum regulam, (sti,
units.tr: The stigmata of the Crucified pierce with love. The rule of the elect,

units.la: Pane cœli saturata Tu ab urbe Tiburtina
units.tr: Filled with the bread of heaven, you who came from the city of Tibur,

units.la: Stas a terris elevata Cœli transfis ad amœna
units.tr: Stand raised high above the earth, and pass to the pleasant places of heaven,

units.la: Mente hac creata Pietatis mater plena
units.tr: Created in this mind, full of mercy, mother,

units.la: Cœli clamans gaudia, Pia prece nos suprema
units.tr: Shouting the joys of heaven, with your last devout prayer

units.la: Gaude mater quam plaxisti Transfer ad solatia. Amen.
units.tr: Rejoice, mother, whom you have pleased. Lead us to comfort. Amen.

units.la: DE QVOLIBET SANCTO.
units.tr: ON ANY SAINT.

units.la: Hic sanctus N. cujus hodie Excuset apud Dominum
units.tr: This saint N., whose solemnities are celebrated today,

units.la: Celebrantur solennia. Nostrorum lapsus criminum,
units.tr: Pleads for us before the Lord and excuses the lapses of our sins,

units.la: Nam revelata facie Nos ac sanctorum gloriam
units.tr: For with face unveiled he sees the King in glory,

units.la: Regem cernit in gloria. Per ipsius suffragia,
units.tr: And through his intercessions, and those of all the saints,

units.la: Illic regina virginum (num Post præsentem miseriam
units.tr: There, as queen of virgins, surpassing the heights of the orders,

units.la: Transcendens culme ordi- (christi perducat gratia.
units.tr: May grace lead us after the present misery into Christ's presence.

units.la: DE RELIQVIIS SANCTORVM.
units.tr: ON THE RELICS OF THE SAINTS.

units.la: Domine, ne respicias peccata nostra, sed respice ad deprecationem Genitricis tuæ Mariæ, & per ejus sancta merita, & per intercessionem sanctorum tuorum Apostolorum Petri & Pauli, atque omnium Sanctorum tuorum, quorum reliquiæ sunt in isto loco, adjuva nos, sicut tu vides necessitatem nostram.
units.tr: Lord, do not look upon our sins, but look upon the prayer of your Mother Mary, and through her holy merits, and through the intercession of your holy Apostles Peter and Paul, and of all your saints whose relics are in this place, help us, as you see our need.

units.la: Et: Deus, qui ex omni coaptatione Sancto-rum æternum tibi condis habitaculum, da æ-dificationi tuæ incrementa cœlestia, ut, quo-rum hic reliquias pio amore complectimur, eorum semper meritis adjuvemur. Iterum: Propitiare nobis, quæsumus Domine, famulis tuis, per horum sanctorum tuorum N. & N. atq; aliorum, q in præsenti reqescentnt Ecclesiâ, merita gloriosa, ut eorū piâ intercessione ab omnibus semper protegamur adversis.
units.tr: And: O God, who from every joining of the saints builds for yourself an eternal dwelling, give to your building heavenly increase, so that we, who here embrace with pious love the relics of those whose merits we also enjoy, may always be helped by their merits. Again: We beseech you, Lord, be merciful to us your servants, through the glorious merits of these your saints N. and N., and of others who now rest in the Church, so that through their pious intercession we may always be protected from all adversities.

units.la: PRECES, AD INANIMATA etiam directæ.
units.tr: PRAYERS DIRECTED EVEN TO INANIMATE THINGS.

units.la: Ex missa De nomine Jesu:
units.tr: From the Mass On the Name of Jesus:

units.la: QUAM DEVOTE CELEBRANS, habituru sit pro qualibet vice annorum tria millia, de vera indulgentia, concessa à Bonifacio VI.
units.tr: WHOEVER CELEBRATES THIS MASS DEVOUTLY SHALL HAVE THREE THOUSAND YEARS OF TRUE INDULGENCE FOR EACH TIME, GRANTED BY BONIFACE VI.

units.la: Oratio: Deus, qui gloriosissimum nomen Jesu Christi, unigeniti filii tui, Domini nostri, fecisti fidelibus tuis summæ suavitatis affectu amabile, & malignis spiritibus tremendū atq; terribile, concede propitius, ut omnes, q hoc nomen Jesu devote venerantur in terris, sanctæ consolationis dulcedinem in præsenti percipiat, & in futuro gaudium exultationis & interminabilis beatitudinis obtineant in cœlis.
units.tr: Collect: O God, who by the tender affection of sweetest love made the most glorious name of Jesus Christ, your only-begotten Son, our Lord, lovable to your faithful, and terrible and dreadful to evil spirits, graciously grant that all who devoutly venerate this name of Jesus on earth may in the present life receive the sweetness of holy consolation, and in the future obtain in heaven the joy of exultation and of unending blessedness.

units.la: Graduale: Dulce nomen Domini nostri Jesu Christi melos auri, mel in ore, cordis verus jubilus, effugat mundi sibilum.
units.tr: Gradual: The sweet name of our Lord Jesus Christ is a song of gold, honey in the mouth, true joy of the heart; it drives away the hissing of the world.

units.la: TRACTUS:
units.tr: TRACT:

units.la: Dulce nomen Jesu Christi, Tollit luctum, affert fructū, Omnem auferens tristitiam, Et obductum & seductum Jucundans mentem jubilo. Purgat a nubilo.
units.tr: The sweet name of Jesus Christ removes grief and brings fruit, taking away all sadness, and gladdens the clouded and deluded mind with joy; it purges the mist.

units.la: Nominatum, invocatum,
units.tr: Named, invoked,

units.la: Honoratum, praedicatum,
units.tr: Honoured, preached,

units.la: Semper sonat dulciter.
units.tr: Always sounds sweetly.

units.la: Tam peccatum, quam reatum,
units.tr: Both sin and guilt,

units.la: Condonatum, expurgatum
units.tr: Forgiven and cleansed,

units.la: Reddit, mulcens leniter,
units.tr: It restores, soothing gently;

units.la: Nos defendit, nos accendit,
units.tr: It defends us, it kindles us,

units.la: Nos intendit & extendit
units.tr: It stirs us and carries us on

units.la: Hoc nomen in gaudium.
units.tr: This name into joy.

units.la: Secreta: In veneratione nominis dilectissimi Filii tui, Domini nostri Jesu Christi, salvatoris nostri, &c. deprecamur, ut in eodem nomine delectantes, salutarem sui propositi consequantur effectum.
units.tr: Secret: In the veneration of the name of your most beloved Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, our Saviour, etc., we beseech you that, delighting in that same name, they may attain the saving effect of their purpose.

units.la: Post communionem: Sacrosancta mysteria, quae sumsimus, Domine, in honorem nominis complacentissimi Filii tui, Domini nostri Jesu Christi, devotis praecordiis recolentes, quaesumus, ut incrementa nobis spiritualis exultationis accumulent, & affectum nostrum ad hoc salutiferum nomen Jesu nobis imprimendam accendant, &c.
units.tr: After Communion: O Lord, we who have received these most holy mysteries, calling them to mind with devout hearts in honour of the name of your most pleasing Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, beseech you that they may heap upon us increases of spiritual exultation, and kindle in us the desire to impress upon ourselves this saving name of Jesus, etc.

units.la: EX MISSA, IN SOLENNITATE, De imagine Jesu Christi.
units.tr: EX MISSA, IN SOLENNITATE, Concerning the image of Jesus Christ.

units.la: Majestatem tuam, clemens & omnipotens Deus, fusis precibus exoramus, ut, sicut passionem imaginis Domini salvatoris cuncta devodevotione, hodiernâ die fideliter recolimus? ita à cunctis erepti dæmonum adversitatibus, semper tibi placere valeamus.
units.tr: Almighty and merciful God, we beseech your majesty with outpoured prayers, that as we faithfully call to mind, with all devotion, the suffering of the image of our Lord and Saviour on this day, so, freed from all the assaults of demons, we may always be able to please you.

units.la: Secreta: Te, Domine, supplicitèr deprecamur, ut plebs tua Christianæ debita fidei celebrando, gloriosæ imaginis filii tui passione, æternæ vitæ consequi præmia merearur.
units.tr: Secreta: Lord, we humbly beseech you that your people, celebrating the faith owed to Christ, may by the suffering of your glorious Son's image merit to obtain the rewards of eternal life.

units.la: Post communionem: Tua nobis, piissime Deus, adsit clementia deprecantibus, ut, sicut venerandæ imaginis filii tui salvatoris mundi venerabilem hodiernâ die celebramus triumphum: ita quoque ab omni infestatione iniquorum spirituum erepti, incessanter adhæreamus laudibus tuis, &c.
units.tr: Post communionem: Most merciful God, may your clemency be present to us as we pray, so that, just as we today celebrate the venerable triumph of the venerable image of your Son, the Saviour of the world, we may likewise, freed from every attack of wicked spirits, cling unceasingly to your praises, etc.

units.la: PRECES AD PANACEUM DEUM.
units.tr: PRAYERS TO THE GOD OF ALL BREAD.

units.la: O panis dulcissime, | Nam reatum sceleris O fidelis animæ | Dono tanti muneris Vitalis refectio. | Clementer purificas, O paschalis victimæ | Arcte ut nos unias Agnus mansuetissime, | Et virtute munias Legalis oblatio. | Da digne te sumere. Caro carens carie, | Et carnales furias Quæ sub panis specie | Depellere nos facias Velaris divinitus. | Tecum pie vivere. Victu multivariæ | Sic refecti poculis Recrea nos gratiæ | Sanguinis, & epulis Septiformis spiritus, | Tuæ carnis optimis. Sumente, cu lumeris, | Seculorum seculis Quia nô consumeris, | Epulemur sedulis Æternè vivificas, | Veritatis azymis. Amen.
units.tr: O sweetest bread, living refreshment of the faithful soul: grant us worthily to partake of you. Sweetly cleanse us from the guilt of sin, and bind us closely to yourself, and strengthen us by your power. You, flesh that never decays, under the appearance of bread are divinely hidden. Refresh us with the drink of your blood and with the feast of your flesh, and let us live godly with you. Nourished by the cups of many kinds of sustenance, and by the best food of your flesh, let us feast diligently on the unleavened bread of truth. Seven-fold Spirit, you who are not consumed by those who partake, you eternally give life to the ages of ages. Amen.

units.la: ET, EX HYMNO: PANGELINGUA.
units.tr: AND, FROM THE HYMN: PANGE LINGUA.

units.la: Tantum ergo sacramentum | Et antiquum documentum Veneremur cernui, | Novo cedat ritui, &c.
units.tr: Therefore let us venerate this so great sacrament, bowing low, and let the old observance yield to the new rite, etc.

units.la: ET EX HYMNO: LAUDA SION.
units.tr: AND FROM THE HYMN: LAUDA SION.

units.la: Doctis sacris institutis, | Prater rerum ordinem. Panem vinum in salutis | Sub diversis speciebus, Consecramus hostiam. | Signis tantum, & non resDogma datur Christianis, | bus, Quod in carne transit pa- | Latent res eximia. Et vinu in sanguinem. (nis, | Caro, cibus: Sanguis potus e Quod non capis, quod non | Manet tamen Christus tovides, | tus: Animosa firmat fides, | Sub utraque specie.
units.tr: Under different kinds, by the sacred institution, we consecrate the sacrifice of salvation: bread and wine. Beyond the order of things, the Christians are given a doctrine: that bread passes into flesh and wine into blood. Things of wondrous excellence lie hidden under signs alone. The flesh is food, the blood is drink, yet Christ remains whole under either kind. What you cannot grasp, what you cannot see, a courageous faith confirms.

units.la: AD MAPPAM, QUA CHRISTUS
units.tr: TO THE TOWEL WITH WHICH CHRIST

units.la: usus est, dum Coenam celebraret.
units.tr: was used while he celebrated the Supper.

units.la: Hanc Monachi Abbatia Fonsensis in regno Portugalia sic invocant:
units.tr: The monks of the Abbey of Fonsa in the kingdom of Portugal invoke it thus:

units.la: Ora pro nobis sanctissima mappa Dei.
units.tr: Pray for us, most holy cloth of God.

units.la: AD CRUCEM CHRISTI.
units.tr: TO THE CROSS OF CHRIST.

units.la: O crux ave, spes unica, | Dulce lignum, dulces clavos, Hoc passionis tempore, | Dulcia ferens pondera, Auge pius iustitiam, | Quae sola fuisti digna fustire Reusq; dona veniam. | Et: Rege coelorum et Domine,
units.tr: Hail, O cross, our only hope, in this time of suffering. Sweet wood, sweet nails, bearing sweet weights, you alone were worthy to bear the King of heaven and the Lord. Pious one, increase justice, and grant pardon to the guilty. And: O King and Lord of heaven.

units.la: Item: Ecce lignum crucis, in quo salus pendit: venite adoremus.
units.tr: Likewise: Behold the wood of the cross, on which salvation hangs; come, let us adore.

units.la: Et: O crux gloriosa, o crux adoranda, o lignum pretiosum, & admirabile signum. Christe Rex piissime, hujus crucis signaculo, horis, momentis omnibus, munire nos non abnuas.
units.tr: And: O glorious cross, O cross to be adored, O precious wood and wondrous sign. Christ, most loving King, do not refuse to protect us with the sign of this cross, at every hour and moment.

units.la: Concede nobis, Domine, ut, qui ad sanctam crucem tuam adorandam veniunt, nexibus peccatorum liberentur.
units.tr: Grant us, Lord, that those who come to adore your holy cross may be freed from the bonds of their sins.

units.la: Alia, quae plus cruci Christi, quam illius Resurrectioni tribuitur.
units.tr: Another, which ascribes more to the cross of Christ than to his Resurrection.

units.la: Crucem tuam ADORAMUS Domine: Resurrectionem tuam sancta GLORIFICAMUS.
units.tr: We adore your cross, O Lord; we glorify your holy Resurrection.

units.la: Alia: Protege, Domine, plebem tuam per signum sanctae crucis, ab omnibus insidiis inimicorum omnium, ut tibi gratam exhibeamus servitutem, & acceptabile tibi fiat sacrificium nostrum.
units.tr: Another: Protect your people, O Lord, by the sign of the holy cross, from all the snares of all enemies, so that we may offer you a pleasing service, and that our sacrifice may be acceptable to you.

units.la: Iterum alia: Redemtor mundi, signo crucis ab omni adversitate custodi, qui salvasti Petrum in mari, miserere nobis.
units.tr: Again another: Redeemer of the world, guard us by the sign of the cross from every adversity, you who saved Peter in the sea, have mercy on us.

units.la: Ex missa in honorem S. Crucis.
units.tr: From the Mass in honour of the Holy Cross.

units.la: Oratio: Deus, qui unigeniti filii tui pretioso sanguine vivificae crucis vexillū sanctificare voluisti, concede quaesumus, eos, qui ejusdem sanctae crucis gaudent honore, tua quoque ubique protectione gaudere.
units.tr: Prayer: O God, who willed to consecrate the banner of the living cross with the precious blood of your only-begotten Son, grant, we beseech you, that those who rejoice in the honour of the same holy cross may also rejoice in your protection everywhere.

units.la: CRUCIS INVENTIO.
units.tr: THE FINDING OF THE CROSS.

units.la: O crux, lignum triumphale, Mundi vera salus, vale, Inter ligna nullum tale Fronde, flore, germine, Medicina Christiana, Sanos salva, agros sana, Quod no valet vis humana- Fit in tua nomine. (ha Assistentes crucis laudi, Consecrator crucis, audi, Atq; servos tua crucis, Post hanc vitam, vera lucis Transfer ad palatia. Quos tormento vis servire, Fac tormenta non sentire, Sed cum dies erit ira Nobis confer & largire Sempiterna gaudia, Amen. Secreta : Sacrificium, Domine, quod tibi immolamus, placatus intende, ut ab omni nos eruat bellorum nequitiâ, & per vexillum sanctæ crucis filii tui, ad conterendas adversariorum insidias, nos in tuæ protectionis securitate constituat.
units.tr: O cross, triumphal wood, true salvation of the world, farewell. Among trees there is none like you, in leaf, flower and bud. Christian medicine, save the healthy, heal the sick, which human strength cannot do, is done in your name. Hear, O cross, you who assist at the praise of the cross, and you who consecrate it, and grant that after this life your servants, bearing your cross, may be carried to the palaces of true light. Those whom the torment compels to serve, make them not feel the torments, but when the day of wrath comes, grant us and bestow upon us everlasting joys. Amen. Secreta: Lord, look favourably upon the sacrifice we offer you, that it may deliver us from all the wickedness of wars, and by the banner of the holy cross of your Son, for crushing the snares of our adversaries, establish us in the security of your protection.

units.la: Communio : Per signum crucis de inimicis nostris libera nos Deus noster.
units.tr: Communio: By the sign of the cross, deliver us from our enemies, O God our God.

units.la: CRUCIS EXALTATIO.
units.tr: THE EXALTATION OF THE CROSS.

units.la: Laudes crucis attollamus.
units.tr: Let us raise up the praises of the cross.

units.la: Nos, q; crucis exultamus
units.tr: We also rejoice in the cross

units.la: Speciali gloriâ.
units.tr: with special glory.

units.la: Nam in cruce triumphamus,
units.tr: For in the cross we triumph,

units.la: Hostem verum superamus
units.tr: and we overcome the true enemy

units.la: Vitali victoriâ.
units.tr: with life-giving victory.

units.la: Dulce melos tangat coelos,
units.tr: Let a sweet song touch the heavens;

units.la: Dulce lignu dulci dignum
units.tr: let us sing a sweet melody

units.la: Canamus melodiâ.
units.tr: worthy of the sweet wood.

units.la: Voci vita non discordet,
units.tr: Let the voice not be out of tune with life,

units.la: Dū vox vita nō remordet,
units.tr: since the voice of life does not bite back;

units.la: Dulcis est symphonia.
units.tr: the harmony is sweet.

units.la: Servi crucis cruce laudant,
units.tr: The servants of the cross praise with the cross,

units.la: Qui per cruce sibi gaudent
units.tr: and by the cross they rejoice

units.la: Vita dari munera.
units.tr: that the gifts of life are given.

units.la: Dicant omnes, dicat singuli:
units.tr: Let all say, let each one say:

units.la: Ave salus totius seculi,
units.tr: Hail, salvation of the whole world,

units.la: Arbor salutifera,
units.tr: saving tree,

units.la: O quàm felix, q; praclara
units.tr: O how happy and how glorious

units.la: Fuit hac salutis ara,
units.tr: was this altar of salvation,

units.la: Rubens agni sanguine.
units.tr: reddened with the blood of the Lamb.

units.la: Agnus sine maculâ,
units.tr: The Lamb without blemish,

units.la: Qui mundavit seculâ
units.tr: who cleansed the world

units.la: Ab antiquo crimine.
units.tr: from the ancient crime.

units.la: Hac est scala peccatorum,
units.tr: This is the ladder of sinners,

units.la: Per q; Christus rex coelorum
units.tr: through which Christ, king of heaven,

units.la: Ad se traxit omnia.
units.tr: drew all things to himself.

units.la: Forma hac cujus ostendit,
units.tr: Its form shows this:

units.la: Qua terrarū comprehendit
units.tr: by it he embraced

units.la: Quatuor confinia.
units.tr: the four boundaries of the lands.

units.la: Non sunt nova sacramenta,
units.tr: These are not new sacraments,

units.la: Nec recenter est inventa
units.tr: nor has this religion of the cross

units.la: Crucis hac religio.
units.tr: been recently invented.

units.la: Ista dulces aquas fecit,
units.tr: This wood made the waters sweet;

units.la: Per hanc silex aquas jecit.
units.tr: through it the rock poured out water,

units.la: Moysis officio.
units.tr: by the office of Moses.

units.la: Nulla salus est in domo,
units.tr: There is no salvation in a house

units.la: Nisi cruce munit homo
units.tr: unless a man fortifies its lintels

units.la: Superliminaria.
units.tr: with the cross.

units.la: Neque sensit gladium,
units.tr: Whoever has done such things

units.la: Nec amisit filium,
units.tr: has neither felt the sword

units.la: Quisquis egit talia. Ligna legens in Sareptá, Spem salutis est adepta Pauper muliercula. Sine lignis fidei, Nec lechitus olei Valet, nec farinula. Roma naves universas In profundum vidit mersas, Una cum Maxentio. Fusi Thrces, casi Persa, Sed & partis dux adversa Victus ab Heraclio. Inscriptuvis, sub figuris Ista latent, sed jam patent Crucis beneficia. Reges credunt, hostis cedunt, Sola cruce, Christo duce Unus fugat millia. Ista suos fortiores Semper facit, & victores, Morbos sanat & langueres, Reprimit daemonia. Dat captivis libertatem, Vita confert novitatem, Ad antiquam dignitatem, Crux reduxit omnia.
units.tr: nor lost his son. The poor little widow gathering sticks in Sarepta obtained hope of salvation. Without the wood of faith, neither the jar of oil nor the little handful of meal is of any use. Rome saw all her ships sunk in the depths, together with Maxentius. The Thracians were routed, the Persians fell, and the leader of the opposing side was conquered by Heraclius. These things lie hidden under inscriptions and figures, but now the benefits of the cross are plain. Kings believe, enemies yield; with the cross alone, with Christ as leader, one man puts thousands to flight. It always makes its own people stronger and victorious, heals diseases and weakness, and drives out demons. It gives liberty to captives, brings newness of life, and the cross has restored all things to their ancient dignity.

units.la: Offertorium: Protege, Domine, plebem tu-um, per signum sanctæ tuæ crucis, ab omni-bus insidiis inimicorum omnium, ut tibi grata exhibeamus servitutem, & acceptabile fiat sacrificium nostrum.
units.tr: Offertory: Protect your people, O Lord, by the sign of your holy cross, from all the snares of all enemies, so that we may offer you a service pleasing to you, and that our sacrifice may be made acceptable.

units.la: Post communionem: Domine, quos sanctæ crucis lætari fecisti honore, ejus quoq; per-petuis defende subsidiis.
units.tr: After communion: O Lord, those whom you have made glad with the honour of your holy cross, defend also with your continual help.

units.la: AD S. CRUCEM, CORONAM spineam, sudarium, clavos, & lanceam.
units.tr: At the Cross, the Crown of Thorns, the Shroud, the Nails, and the Spear.

units.la: Adoramus, in nomine tuo, Christe, tuæ victoriosæ crucis vexillum, tuum diadema spineum, tuum sanctum linteum, tuos ru-bentes sanguine clavos, ac tuo sacro lateri immersam lanceam.
units.tr: We adore, in your name, O Christ, the banner of your victorious cross, your crown of thorns, your holy linen cloth, your nails reddened with blood, and the spear plunged into your sacred side.

units.la: Ad lanceam.
units.tr: To the spear.

units.la: Ave ferrum triumphale, Intrans pectus tu vitale. Cœli pandis ostia. | Facundata in cruore, Felix hasta, nos, amore Per te fixi, fauci{a}, &c.
units.tr: Hail, triumphal iron, piercing your living breast. You open the gates of heaven. | Made fruitful in blood, happy spear, we, fixed through you by love, ...

units.la: AD SANCTUM SUDARIUM CHRISTI.
units.tr: TO THE HOLY WINDING-SHEET OF CHRIST.

units.la: Cadurei Portugalenses vicini gloriantur de particulâ Sudarii Christi. In horum processio- nali extant hæ preces, quas decantare solent:
units.tr: The Cadurci and the neighbouring Portuguese boast of a small part of Christ's winding-sheet. In their processional book these prayers are found, which they are accustomed to chant:

units.la: Sancte Sudarii, ora pro nobis.
units.tr: Holy Winding-sheet, pray for us.

units.la: De eadem: Sudarium Christi liberet nos, à peste, & à morte tristi.
units.tr: From the same: May the winding-sheet of Christ deliver us from plague and from sad death.

units.la: Ex missâ sancti Sudarii.
units.tr: From the Mass of the holy winding-sheet.

units.la: Oratio: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus, qui in memoriam passionis unigeniti filii tui, sanctam ejus sindonem, cum expresså ipsius effigie, venerandam reliquisti in terris, tribue, quæsumus, ut per virtutem ejusdem sanctæ sindonis faciem tuam contemplari merea- tur in cœlis.
units.tr: Prayer: Almighty, everlasting God, who in memory of the passion of thine only-begotten Son hast left upon earth his holy shroud, venerable, with the true image of himself upon it; grant, we beseech thee, that through the power of that same holy shroud he may be counted worthy to behold thy face in heaven.

units.la: PROSA.
units.tr: SEQUENCE.

units.la: Plaudat cœli hierarchia, | Granum tegit palea, Nova sonat harmonia, | Radix Christus dum marcescit, Novo ducta cantico, | Ramus homo tunc surescit, Huic concordans in hac via, | Salva Dei idea, Lauder promat Ecclesia, | Gaude felix Sabauda, Linteo Dominico, &c. | Gaude tota Ecclesia, Sindon, per quam gaudia, | Nova laudis gloria. Felix jam Ecclesia | Artus fracti solidantur, Sumens, exaltatur, | Ægri currunt, & curantur, Montem nubes operit, | Virtutum frequentia, Deum Sindon contegit, | Rea pete suffragiat, Homo sublimatur, | Clama, voca auxilia, Aurum latet occultatum | Plebs egena. Sidus jaces obumbratum, | § ¶ Dei Deo laudes pro linteo, Prece semper sedula,
units.tr: Let the heavenly hierarchy applaud; a new harmony resounds, led by a new song. The husk covers the grain, Christ the root withers, and man the branch rises up. In agreement with this, in this way, the divine idea is safe; let the Church put forth praise. Rejoice, happy Savoy, in the Lord's linen, etc. Rejoice, whole Church: the shroud, through which joys come, a new glory of praise. Now the Church is happy. The broken limbs are made firm; taking it up, they are lifted; the sick run and are healed. The clouds cover the mountain, a multitude of virtues; the shroud covers God. Seek help, the guilty one supports; man is raised up. Cry out, call for aid; the gold lies hidden, the needy people. You lie, a star overshadowed,

units.la: Christi demum Sefligio, Apud curam Dei patris
units.tr: at last, the image of Christ, before the care of God the Father

units.la: Voce plena. Cum precibus tua matrü
units.tr: with full voice. With the prayers of your mother

units.la: Tua morte suscitatos Commenda per secula,
units.tr: by your death, raised up, commend us through the ages,

units.la: Bone Iesu, redemtos Amen.
units.tr: good Jesus, redeemed. Amen.

units.la: Secreta: Accepta tibi sint, Domine, virtute sanctae sindonis, haec munera, cuius pro totius mundi salute, accepta extitit, filii tui passio gloriosa.
units.tr: Secret prayer: Let these gifts be acceptable to you, O Lord, through the power of the holy shroud, whose glorious passion of your Son was accepted for the salvation of the whole world.

units.la: Post Communionem. Satiasti, Domine, in via familiam tuam muneribus sacris, quaesumus, ut per virtutem sanctae sindonis, facie tua in patria nos satiare digneris.
units.tr: After Communion: You have satisfied, O Lord, your family on its way with holy gifts; we beseech you that, through the power of the holy shroud, you would deign to satisfy us with your face in the fatherland.

units.la: QVORSVM PERTINET RECITATIO ISTA EXEMPLORUM, DE PRECIBUS AD MARIAM & ALIOS SANCTOS, QUIN ETIAM AD ALIA DIRECTIS?
units.tr: TO WHAT END IS THIS RECITAL OF EXAMPLES, OF PRAYERS TO MARY AND OTHER SAINTS, AND OF THOSE DIRECTED TO OTHER THINGS?

units.la: Primùm, ut juxta Prophetae dictum, Gentibus turpitudo, & regnis ignominia Pontificiae idololatriae palam offendatur, quia sub specie pietatis honorem Deo uni debitum transtulerunt ad Σελήνην, sive Deipa-ram virginem, & alias creaturas; contra expressum dictum, quod in Esaia 42. extat: Gloriam meam non dabo alteri.
units.tr: First, that, according to the saying of the prophet, the shame of the nations and the disgrace of the kingdoms, the idolatry of the Papists may be openly exposed; for under the appearance of piety they have transferred to the moon, that is, to the Virgin Mother of God, and to other creatures, the honour due to the one God; contrary to the express word in Isaiah 42: "My glory I will not give to another."

units.la: Deinde, ut fraudulentia Iesuitarum agnoscatur, qui (vel dissimulando, vel palliando ea, quae publice in libris Pontificiis extant, & tum authoritate Pontificum confirmata sunt, tum adhuc in Ecclesiis Romano Pontifici adductis dictis leguntur, & cantantur) turpitudinem istam Papatus tegere conantur: ut in Catechesi utraq; Mariam, non tam ut auxiliatricem & salvatricem invocandam, quàm ut veneratione & honore dignam (salutandam, ejusque intercessionem petendam esse, pue-ris persuadere satagunt. Cur autem non diserte atque expresse rejiciunt ac damnant illa, quæ proximis istis seculis, publica autho-ritate, in communi Ecclesiæ Romanæ praxi usitata fuerunt, & adhuc sunt, si candidè agere eis propositum est?
units.tr: Next, that the deceit of the Jesuits may be recognised. They, either by dissembling or by palliating those things which stand publicly in Papist books, and which have been confirmed by the authority of the popes, and are still read and sung in the churches and brought forward to the Roman Pontiff, try to cover up this foulness of Popery. So in both catechisms they labour to persuade boys that Mary is to be saluted and her intercession sought, not so much as a helper and saviour to be invoked, but as one worthy of veneration and honour. But why do they not plainly and expressly reject and condemn those things which, in these recent centuries, were in use by public authority in the common practice of the Roman Church, and still are, if it is their purpose to act candidly?

units.la: Sed addam appendicis loco narrationem, non ante multos annos à Martino Ilengrino publicè editâ: unde liquidè apparebit, quicquid alioqui simulent aut dissimulent Jesuitæ: reipsa tamen eos retinere invocationem Mariæ & cultum idololatricum. Quem ille quidem, ex ipsius etiam Diaboli testimonio, impudentissimè confirmare audet.
units.tr: But I will add, by way of an appendix, a narrative published not many years ago by Martin Ilengrinus, from which it will clearly appear that, whatever the Jesuits otherwise pretend or dissemble, they in fact retain the invocation of Mary and idolatrous worship. He indeed boldly, and most shamelessly, confirms this even by the testimony of the Devil himself.

units.la: Narrat enim, obscuram quandam puellam adductam esse ex peculiari quadam Mariæ revelatione ad lacellum beatæ virginis in antiqua Ottingen: cumq; Canisio præsidè Litania cantaretur, in qua Dei Patris, Filii, & Spiritus sancti misericordia & auxilium invocabatur, Diabolum nihil fuisse motum. Mox verò cùm Litania de beata virgine Maria incho-aretur, cœpisse illum in obscura turbari, clamare & furere, ibi tum Canisium, fabulas
units.tr: For he relates that a certain obscure girl was brought, by a special revelation of Mary, to the little chapel of the blessed Virgin in old Ottingen; and when the litany was being sung under the presidency of Canisius, in which the mercy and help of God the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit were invoked, the Devil was not moved at all. But soon, when the litany concerning the blessed Virgin Mary was begun, he began to be troubled in the obsessed girl, to shout and rage. Then Canisius, the author of this fable,

units.la: hujus actorem, ligneam Mariæ imaginem ar- reptam capiti puellæ imposuisse. Diabolum igitur alta voce exclamaffe: Ah mulier, quid me calcas, & caput meum conteris? Tandem cum ex puella obsessa execundum ei effet, satisfactionis loco injunctum ipsi abexorcista fuisse, ut per obsessam aliquot Paternoster & Ave Maria recitaret. Tum verò Diabolum cum gemitu & indignatione præfatum, quòd invitus hoc cogeretur facere, orationem Dominicam supplicem & devotè peroraffe: sed cùm in salutatione angelica ad hæc verba pervenisset (Ave Maria gratiâ plena) sonorâ & clarâ voce attexuisse: O Maria, gratia & misericordia tua sit super omnes illos, qui hanc tuam capellam visitant: Ah ora pro illis omnibus. Atque ita relicto poste fœtore, ex obsessa egressum esse.
units.tr: having seized a wooden image of Mary, placed it on the girl's head. The Devil therefore cried out in a loud voice: "Ah woman, why do you tread on me and crush my head?" At last, when he had to be driven out of the possessed girl, the exorcist imposed on him, as a satisfaction, that through the obsessed girl he should recite some Our Fathers and Hail Marys. Then indeed the Devil, with groaning and indignation at being forced to do this against his will, recited the Lord's Prayer humbly and devoutly; but when he came in the angelic salutation to these words (Hail Mary, full of grace), he added in a sonorous and clear voice: "O Mary, may your grace and mercy be upon all those who visit this your chapel; ah, pray for them all." And so, leaving behind a stench, he went out of the possessed girl.

units.la: Dubiumne ergo esse potest, quin teste ipso Satana, celebranda atq; invocanda sit Maria? & in prima Evangelii promissione legendum sit, non Ipsum femen mulieris, sed, Ipsa mulier conteret caput serpentis? O Satanæ & Jesuitarum impudentissimam impudentiam!
units.tr: Can there then be any doubt, with Satan himself as witness, that Mary is to be celebrated and invoked? And should it not be read in the first promise of the Gospel not "the seed of the woman" but "she herself shall crush the head of the serpent"? O the most shameless impudence of Satan and the Jesuits!

units.la: APPENDIX DE MAGICA ET SUPERSTITIOSA BENEDICTIONE & CONSECRATIONE CREATURARUM SUB PAPATU.
units.tr: APPENDIX ON THE MAGICAL AND SUPERSTITIOUS BLESSING AND CONSECRATION OF CREATURES UNDER THE PAPACY.

units.la: I. De pertinentibus ad personas.
units.tr: I. Concerning things pertaining to persons.

units.la: Baculi pastoralis, qui Abbati traditur.
units.tr: The pastoral staff, which is handed to the Abbot.

units.la: Suffentator imbecillitatis humanæ Deus benedic baculum istum, & quod in eo exterius designatur, interius in manibus hujus famuli tui, tuæ propitiationis clementia operetur.
units.tr: God, the sustainer of human weakness, bless this staff, and by the clemency of your propitiation, work inwardly in the hands of this your servant what is outwardly signified in it.

units.la: Annuli Abbatis.
units.tr: The Abbot's ring.

units.la: Creator & conservator humani generis, datorgratiæ (spiritualis, largitor æternæ salutis, tu Domine, emitte tuam benedictionem super hunc annulum, ut, quicunque hoc sacrosanctæ fidei signo insignitus inceffrit, in virtute cœlestis defensionis ad æternam sibi proficiat salutem.
units.tr: Creator and preserver of the human race, giver of spiritual grace, bestower of eternal salvation, you, Lord, send your blessing upon this ring, so that whoever is marked with this sign of the most holy faith may, under the power of heavenly protection, advance to eternal salvation.

units.la: Mitræ ejusdem.
units.tr: His mitre.

units.la: Domine Deus, pater omnipotens, cujus præclara bonitas est, & virtus immensa, a quo omne datum optimum, & omne donum perfectum, totiusque decoris ornamentum, benedicere & sanctificare dignare hanc mitram hujus famuli tui capiti imponendam.
units.tr: Lord God, almighty Father, whose bright goodness and immense power, from whom comes every best gift and every perfect gift, and the adornment of all grace, deign to bless and sanctify this mitre, to be placed on the head of this your servant.

units.la: Mox: Imponimus, Domine, capiti hujus famuli tui galeam munitionis & salutis, qua-tenus tenus decorata facie & armato capite, cornu- bus utriusq; Testamenti terribilis appareat adversariis veritatis, & te eilargiente gratiam, impugnator eorum robustus existat. Sicut Moyses cornutus incedebat, & Aaron mitratus, five cum tiara.
units.tr: Soon after: Lord, we place upon the head of this your servant the helmet of protection and salvation, so that, with his face adorned and his head armed, he may appear terrible with the horns of both Testaments to the adversaries of truth, and, by your gracious gift, may be a strong opponent of them. Just as Moses went forth horned, and Aaron mitred, or with the tiara.

units.la: Et Chirothecarum.
units.tr: And of the gloves.

units.la: Ut quicunque ministrorum tuorum, sacrorum pontificum, his velare manus suas cum humilitate voluerit, tam cordis quàm operis eimunditiem tua misericordia submittiter, quemadmodum Jacob pelliculis hoedorum paternam benedictionem: ita & hic &c.
units.tr: Grant, by your mercy, that whoever of your ministers, the holy bishops, wishes with humility to cover his hands with these, may be cleansed in heart as well as in work, just as Jacob received his father's blessing by means of the skins of kids. So also here, etc.

units.la: Veli Abbatissæ.
units.tr: The abbess's veil.

units.la: Rogamus, ut super hanc vestem, ancillæ tuæ capiti imponendam, benedictio tua benignè descendat, & sit hæc vestis benedicta & consecrata, immaculata & sancta praesentis ancillæ tuæ.
units.tr: We ask that your blessing descend graciously upon this garment, to be placed on the head of your handmaid, and that this garment may be blessed and consecrated, unblemished and holy, for your present handmaid.

units.la: Vestis virginis vel Sanctimonialis.
units.tr: The garment of a virgin or nun.

units.la: Præsta, clementissime pater, ut supradictis famulabus tuis sint hæ vestes salutis protectio, hæc cognitio religionis, hæ initium sanctitatis, hæ contra omnia tela inimici robusta defensio, ut centesimi muneris opulentia, fructus dono, continentia perseverante, dicentur.
units.tr: Grant, most merciful Father, that these garments may be a protection of salvation, a knowledge of religion, a beginning of holiness, and a strong defence against every weapon of the enemy, for your aforesaid handmaids, so that, with the abundance of the hundredfold gift, the fruit of the gift and steadfast continence, they may be called blessed.

units.la: Coronarum.
units.tr: Of crowns.

units.la: Benedic, Domine, ornamenta ista, ut sint remedium salutare generi humano, & præsta pręsta per invocationem tui nominis,ut,quę- cunque ea pottaverint,corporis sanitatem & animæ tutelam percipiant.
units.tr: Bless, Lord, these adornments, so that they may be a saving remedy for the human race, and grant, through the invocation of your name, that whoever wears them may receive bodily health and protection of the soul.

units.la: De annulo ejusdem.
units.tr: On the ring of the same.

units.la: Accipe annulum fidei, signaculum Spiri- tus Sancti, ut sponsa Dei voceris, si ei fideli- ter & mundè servieris.
units.tr: Receive the ring of faith, the seal of the Holy Spirit, so that you may be called the bride of God, if you serve him faithfully and purely.

units.la: VESTIMENTI, PUERI VEL puellæ, pro voto.
units.tr: Garments for a boy or girl, in fulfilment of a vow.

units.la: Domine Jesu Christe, qui pro nostra salu- te suscipiens humanam naturam, te vesti- mento carnis induere dignatus es, benedicti- one sanctâ tuâ benedic ista parvula, vesti- menta, quæ pro gratiis tibi exolvendis omni cum devotione, sanctoque voto & venera- tione beatissimæ Mariæ, infans iste (five pu- ella ista) super se suscepturus est. Infunde in eum, quæsumus, tuam sanctam benedictio- nem, ut cum primum induerit hoc religio- nisimile vestimentum, intercedente Sancto N. descendat super eum gratia tua, quæ pro- tegat illum (vel illam) ab omni malo men- tis & corporis.
units.tr: Lord Jesus Christ, who, to secure our salvation, took upon yourself human nature and deigned to clothe yourself in the garment of flesh: by your holy blessing, bless these little garments, which this infant (or this girl) is about to put on, with all devotion, in holy fulfilment of a vow and in veneration of the most blessed Mary, so as to pay you thanks. Pour into him (or her), we beseech you, your holy blessing, so that as soon as he (or she) puts on this religious garment, your grace may descend upon him (or her), through the intercession of Saint N., and protect him (or her) from every evil of mind and body.

units.la: CATECHUMENI, SI jam sit baptizandus.
units.tr: CATECHUMEN, if he is now to be baptized.

units.la: Exi ab eo immunde spiritus, & da locum Spiritui sancto paracleto.
units.tr: Go out from him, unclean spirit, and give place to the Holy Spirit the Paraclete.

units.la: †N. accipe Spiritum sanctum.per istam in- fufflationem, & Dei benedictionem.
units.tr: †N., receive the Holy Spirit through this insufflation, and the blessing of God.

units.la: † Signum Salvatoris Domini nostri Jesu Christi, in fronte tuo pono, Ac-
units.tr: † I place on your forehead the sign of the Saviour, our Lord Jesus Christ, Ac-

units.la: Accipe signum crucis, tam in fronte, quàm in corde.
units.tr: Receive the sign of the cross, both on the forehead and on the heart.

units.la: Preces nostras, quæsumus domine, clementer exaudi, & hunc electum tuum crucis dominicæ, cujus eum impressione signatus virtute, custodi. &c.
units.tr: Graciously hear our prayers, we beseech you, O Lord, and keep this your chosen one, marked by the impression of the Lord's cross, by its power. Etc.

units.la: Benedictio alia : Benedic † omnipotens Deus hanc creaturam salis benedictione cœlesti, ad effugandum inimicum, quod tu Domine sanctificando sanctifices, benedicendo benedicas, fiatque omnibus accipientibus perfecta medicina permanens in visceribus eorum, in nomine Domini nostri Jesu Christi, qui venturus est judicare vivos & mortuos, & seculum per ignem.
units.tr: Another blessing: May almighty God bless † this creature, salt, with heavenly blessing, to drive away the enemy. What you, O Lord, sanctify by consecrating, bless by blessing, so that it may become a perfect and lasting medicine in the bowels of all who receive it, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, who is to come to judge the living and the dead, and the world by fire.

units.la: N. accipe salem sapientiæ, ut propitiatio sit tibi in vitam æternam.
units.tr: N., receive the salt of wisdom, that it may be a propitiation for you unto eternal life.

units.la: Deus patrum nostrorum, Deus universæ conditor veritatis, te supplices exoramus, ut hunc famulum tuum respicere digneris propitius, & eum, primum pabulum salis gustantem, non diutius esurire permittas, quò minùs cibo expleatur cœlesti. &c.
units.tr: God of our fathers, God, creator of all truth, we humbly beseech you that you deign graciously to look upon this your servant, and do not allow him, tasting for the first time the food of salt, to hunger any longer, so that he may not be less filled with heavenly food. Etc.

units.la: Ergò maledicte diabole recognosce sententiam tuam, & da honorem Deo vivo & vero, da honorem Jesu Christo, filio ejus, & Spiritui sancto, ut exeas & recedas ab hoc famulo Dei. Quia ita eum sibi Dominus noster Jesus Christus ad suam sanctam gratiam & benedictione, fontemque baptismatis vo-[illegible, ~1 letters] eáte dignatus est, per hoc signum Sanctæ Crucis, quod nos in fronte ejus damus, tu, maledicte Diabole, nunquam audeas violare, per eum, qui venturus est judicare vivos & mortuos.
units.tr: Therefore, cursed devil, acknowledge your sentence, and give honour to the living and true God, give honour to Jesus Christ his Son and to the Holy Spirit, and depart and withdraw from this servant of God. For our Lord Jesus Christ has deigned to call him to his holy grace and blessing and to the font of baptism [illegible], through this sign of the holy cross, which we place on his forehead; you, cursed devil, never dare to violate it, through him who is to come to judge the living and the dead.

units.la: Audi maledicte Satana, adjuratus per nomen Dei æterni, cum tua victus invidia, tremens gemensque discede, nihilque sit tibi commune cum fervo Dei, jam cœlestia cogitante, renunciaturo tibi & seculo tuo. Da igitur honorem adventienti Spiritui sancto, qui ex summâ cœli arce descendens &c.
units.tr: Hear, cursed Satan, adjured by the name of the eternal God: vanquished by your own envy, depart trembling and groaning, and let nothing be shared between you and the servant of God, who now thinks on heavenly things, and who will renounce you and your world. Therefore give honour to the Holy Spirit who is coming, who descends from the highest citadel of heaven, etc.

units.la: Exorciso te immunde spiritus, in nomine ✝ Patris, & Filii, & Spiritus ✝ sancti, ut exeas & recedas ab hoc famulo Dei (ab hac famula Dei.) Ipse enim tibi imperat, maledicte damnate, qui siccis pedibus super mare ambulavit, & Petro mergenti dexteram porrexit. &c.
units.tr: I exorcise you, unclean spirit, in the name of the ✝ Father, and of the Son, and of the ✝ Holy Spirit, that you go out and withdraw from this servant of God (from this servant of God, if a woman). For he himself commands you, cursed and damned one, who walked upon the sea with dry feet and stretched out his right hand to Peter as he sank. Etc.

units.la: Nec te lateat Satana, imminere tibi pœnam, imminere gehennam, imminere tibi diem judicii, diem, qui venturus est velut clibanus ardens, in quo tibi atq; universis angelis tuis æternus veniet interitus. Quapropter, Diabole, da honorem Deo vivo, & vero, & Jesu Christo, filio ejus. In cujus nomine atq; virtute adjuro te, quicunque es, immunde spiritus, ut exeas, & recedas ab eo &c. Ephęta, quod est, adaperire nares & odo-rem suavitatis. Tu autem effugare Diabole, appropinquabit enim judicium tuum.
units.tr: Let it not escape you, Satan, that punishment threatens you, that Gehenna threatens you, that the day of judgment threatens you, the day which is to come like a burning furnace, in which eternal destruction will come upon you and upon all your angels. Wherefore, Devil, give honour to the living and true God, and to Jesus Christ his Son. In whose name and power I adjure you, whoever you are, unclean spirit, that you go out and withdraw from him, etc. Ephphatha, that is, be opened, to the nostrils and the sense of sweet savour. But you, Devil, flee away, for your judgment draws near.

units.la: Benedictio fontis: Exaudi nos, omnipotens Deus, & in hujus aquæ substantiam, tuam immisce virtutem, ut abluendi per eam, & sanitatem simul & vitam mereantur æter-nam.
units.tr: Blessing of the font: Hear us, almighty God, and mingle your power into the substance of this water, so that those who are washed in it may obtain health and at the same time eternal life.

units.la: Exorcisso te, creatura aquæ, in nomine Dei patris omnipotentis, & in nomine † Jesu Christi, filii ejus, & in virtute spiritus † Sancti. Exorcisso te, omnis virtus Diaboli, ut omnis fantasia eradicetur & effugetur ab hac creatura aquæ, ut fiat fons aquæ, salientis in vitam æternam, ut qui ex eâ baptizatus fuerit, fiat templum Dei vivi, & spiritus sanctus habitet in eo, in remissionem peccatorum, in nomine Domini nostri Jesu Christi.
units.tr: I exorcise you, creature of water, in the name of God the almighty Father, and in the name of † Jesus Christ his Son, and in the power of the † Holy Spirit. I exorcise you, every power of the Devil, that every illusion may be uprooted and driven out of this creature of water, so that it may become a fountain of water springing up into eternal life, so that whoever is baptized in it may become a temple of the living God, and the Holy Spirit may dwell in him, for the remission of sins, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

units.la: Post infusionem olei chrismatis: Sanctificetur & fœcundetur fons iste, in nomine patris, & filii, & Spiritus † sancti. Amen.
units.tr: After the pouring in of the chrism oil: May this font be sanctified and made fruitful, in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the † Holy Spirit. Amen.

units.la: II. DE TEMPLO: ET AD ILLUD pertinentibus.
units.tr: II. CONCERNING THE TEMPLE, AND THOSE THINGS PERTAINING TO IT.

units.la: IN TEMPLI EXTRVCTIONE.
units.tr: IN THE BUILDING OF THE TEMPLE.

units.la: Ad primum structura lapidem: Hunc lapidem collocandum, in tuo nomine confirma. Benedic, Domine, creaturam istam lapidis, ut sit remedium salutare generi humano.
units.tr: At the laying of the first stone of the structure: Confirm this stone, which is to be laid, in your name. Bless, O Lord, this creature of stone, that it may be a saving remedy for the human race.

units.la: IN TEMPLI dedicatione.
units.tr: At the Dedication of the Temple.

units.la: Psallat Ecclesia, mater illibata, & virgo sine virgâ. Hic novam prolem gratia parrurit fœcundam Spiritu sancto. Angelici cives visitant hic lnos, & corpus sumitur Jesu. Fugiunt universa corporis nocua, pereunt peccatricis animæ crimina. Hic vox lætitiæ personet. Hic pax & gaudia redundant. Hæc domo Trinitatis laus & gloria semper resultet.
units.tr: Let the Church, the unspotted mother and virgin without a man, sing praise. Here she brings forth by grace a new offspring, made fruitful by the Holy Spirit. Angelic citizens visit here the hymns, and the body of Jesus is received. All harms of the body flee, and the sins of the sinful soul perish. Here let the voice of joy resound. Here peace and gladness overflow. Let praise and glory to the Trinity ever resound in this house.

units.la: ORATIO EPISCOPI, POSTQUAM in omnes templi angulos, pollice infinitam crucium multitudinem pinxerit.
units.tr: The Bishop's Prayer, after he has marked with his thumb an countless multitude of crosses in every corner of the temple.

units.la: Sanctificetur & consecretur hoc templum, in nomine Patris † Filii †, & Spiritus sancti, Amen.
units.tr: Let this temple be sanctified and consecrated in the name of the Father, † and the Son †, and the Holy Spirit. Amen.

units.la: AD INFUSIONEM AQUÆ IN vinum, dum consecratur templum, precatio:
units.tr: At the Pouring of Water into Wine, while the Temple Is Consecrated: a Prayer.

units.la: Immitte Domine Spiritum sanctum tuum super hoc vinum, cum aqua & sale & cinere mixtum, ut armatum cœlestis defensione virtutis, ad consecrationem hujus Ecclesiæ & altaris tui proficiat.
units.tr: Send forth, Lord, your Holy Spirit upon this wine, mixed with water, salt and ash, so that, armed with the heavenly defence of your power, it may serve for the consecration of this Church and of your altar.

units.la: AD AQUAM, IN EADEM templi consecratione.
units.tr: At the Water, in the Same Consecration of the Temple.

units.la: Sanctificare per virtutem Dei, unda cœlestis &c. Tu perdis Ægyptios &c.
units.tr: Be sanctified through the power of God, heavenly water, etc. Thou didst destroy the Egyptians, etc.

units.la: IN TEMPLI DEDICATI
units.tr: On the Dedication of the Temple

units.la: anniversaria.
units.tr: On the anniversary.

units.la: Deus, qui non per singulos annos, hujus sancti templi tui consecrationis reparas diem, & sacris semper mysteriis representas incolumes, exaudi preces populi tui, & praesta, ut quisquis hoc templum, beneficia petiturus, ingreditur, cuncta se impetrasse laetetur.
units.tr: O God, who do not renew the day of the consecration of this your holy temple year by year, but always keep it unimpaired through the sacred mysteries, hear the prayers of your people and grant that whoever enters this temple to seek blessings may rejoice that he has obtained all things.

units.la: Graduale: Locus iste a Deo factus est inaestimabile sacramentum, irreprehensibilis est. Bene fundata est domus Domini, supra firmam petram.
units.tr: Gradual: This place was made by God an inestimable sacrament; it is blameless. The house of the Lord is well founded upon a firm rock.

units.la: 2. De rebus in templo. IN BAPTISTERIO,
units.tr: 2. Concerning the things in the temple. In the Baptistery,

units.la: aqua.
units.tr: water.

units.la: Oratio: Precamur, omnipotens Deus, ut tuae majestatis imperio sumat haec aqua unigeniti tui gratiam, de Spiritu sancto, qui hanc aquam regenerandis hominibus praeparatam, arcana sui luminis admixtione fecunderet, ut sanctificatione concepta, ab immaculato divini fontis utero, in novam renata creaturam, progenies coelestis emergat. Et quos aut sexus in corpore, aut aetas discernit in tempore, omnes in unam pariat mater infantiam. Procul ergo hinc, jubente te, Domine, omnis spiritus immundus abscedat, procul tota nequitia diabolicae fraudis abstat. stat. Nihil hîc loci habeat contrariæ virtutis admixtio, non insidiando circumvolet, non latendo surripiat, non inficiendo corrúpat.
units.tr: Prayer: We beseech you, almighty God, that by the command of your majesty this water may receive the grace of your Only-begotten Son, through the Holy Spirit, who, by the secret mingling of his light, may make fruitful this water prepared for regenerating men, so that, conceived in sanctification from the immaculate womb of the divine fountain and reborn as a new creature, a heavenly offspring may emerge. And let the mother bring forth into one infancy all whom sex distinguishes in the body or age in time. Therefore, at your command, Lord, let every unclean spirit depart far from here, and let all the malice of diabolical deceit keep far away. Let the admixture of a contrary power have no place here: let it not circle about to ambush, nor steal in by hiding, nor corrupt by infecting.

units.la: Consecratio: Sit hæc sancta † & innocens creatura libera ab omni impugnatoris incur-su, & totius nequitiæ purgata discessu: sit fons † vivus, aqua † regenerans, unda † purificans, ut omnes hoc lavacro diluendi, operante in eis Spiritu sancto, perfectæ purgationis indulgentiam cõsequantur. Unde benedico te, creatura aquæ, per Deum † vivum, per Deum † verum, per Deum † sanctum. &c.
units.tr: Consecration: Let this creature be holy † and innocent, free from every assault of the attacker and cleansed by the departure of all wickedness: let it be a living † fountain, a regenerating † water, a purifying † wave, so that all who are to be washed in this bath may, with the Holy Spirit working in them, obtain the indulgence of perfect cleansing. Wherefore I bless you, creature of water, by the living † God, by the true † God, by the holy † God, etc.

units.la: Cereis in aquam positis, dicit sacerdos: Descendat in hanc plenitudinem fontis, virtus Spiritus sancti.
units.tr: With the candles placed in the water, the priest says: May the power of the Holy Spirit descend into this fullness of the font.

units.la: Et postquam ter in aquam sufflavit, addit: Totamque hujus aquæ substantiam regenerandi fœcundet effectu. Hîc omnium peccatorum maculæ deleantur, hîc natura ad imaginem tuam condita, & ad honorem sui reformata principii, cunctis vetustis squaloribus emundetur, ut omnis homo hoc sacramentū regenerationis ingressus, in veræ innocantiæ novam infantiam renascatur.
units.tr: And after he has breathed three times into the water, he adds: May he make the whole substance of this water fruitful with the effect of regeneration. Here may the stains of all sins be blotted out; here may nature, created after your image and restored to the honour of its first origin, be cleansed of all ancient filth, so that every man who enters this sacrament of regeneration may be reborn into the new infancy of true innocence.

units.la: Tandem pollice dextro in novum chrisma intinăo, & fonte in modum crucis signato, concludit: In nomine patris, & filii, & spiritus sancti, sanctificetur fons iste ex eo renascentibus in vitam æternam.
units.tr: Finally, dipping his right thumb into the new chrism, and marking the font in the form of a cross, he concludes: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit, may this font be sanctified for those who are to be reborn from it into eternal life.

units.la: T ʒ
units.tr: T ʒ

units.la: DE ALTARI.
units.tr: Concerning the Altar.

units.la: Sanctificetur hoc altare, in honore Dei omnipotentis, & gloriosæ virginis Mariæ, ut omnium sanctorum, & ad nomen ac memoriam sancti N. in nomine patris, filii, & spiritus † sancti.
units.tr: Let this altar be sanctified, in honour of Almighty God, of the glorious Virgin Mary, of all the saints, and to the name and memory of Saint N., in the name of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit.

units.la: Et factis altaris crucibus: Supplices tibi Domine preces fundimus, ut lapidis hujus exemplitam materiam supernis sacrificiis tribuendam, ipse tuæ dotari sanctificationis ubertate præcipias, qui quondam lapideis legem scripsisti in tabulis.
units.tr: And the crosses having been made on the altar: We pour out suppliant prayers to you, O Lord, that you would command this stone, its material fashioned to be given over to heavenly sacrifices, to be endowed with the abundance of your sanctification, you who once wrote the law on stone tablets.

units.la: Postea Pontifex cum aqua benedicta camenum parat, quod sic benedicit: Sanctifica & benedic has creaturas calcis & sabuli per Christum.
units.tr: Afterwards the Bishop prepares the cement with holy water, and blesses it thus: Sanctify and bless these creatures of lime and sand, through Christ.

units.la: Reliquias sanctorum, allaturus eas, in altari reconditum: Fac nos, quæsumus Domine, Sanctorum tuorum tibi specialiter dedicatorum, membra digne contingere, quorum patrocinia inceßanter cupimus habere. &c.
units.tr: The relics of the saints, about to be brought and placed in the altar: Grant us, we beseech you, O Lord, to touch worthily the members of your saints, who have been specially dedicated to you, whose patronage we constantly desire to have. etc.

units.la: Sepulchrum reliquiarum in altari ad hunc modum chrismat: Consecretur & sanctificetur hoc sepulchrum in nomine Patris, Filii, & Spiritus † sancti. Pax huic domui.
units.tr: The tomb for the relics in the altar is anointed in this manner: Let this tomb be consecrated and sanctified in the name of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit. Peace be to this house.

units.la: Lapidem altaris, (quod Sigillum nominant) quo sepulchrum clauditur, ita benedicit, sub cruce, & cum chrismate: Consecretur & sanctificetur hæc tabula (seu hic lapis) per istam unctionem & Dei benedictionem, in nomine Patris, & Filii, & Spiritui Sancti. Pax tibi.
units.tr: The stone of the altar (which they call the Seal), with which the tomb is closed, he blesses thus, under the cross and with chrism: Let this table (or this stone) be consecrated and sanctified through this anointing and God's blessing, in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Peace be to you.

units.la: Ad singulas cruces super altare factas: Sanctificetur & consecretur lapis iste in nomine Patris, Filii, & Spiritus Sancti, in honorem Dei & gloriosæ virginis Mariæ, omnium sanctorum, ad nomen & memoriam sancti N. Pax tibi.
units.tr: At each cross made upon the altar: Let this stone be sanctified and consecrated in the name of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit, in honour of God and of the glorious Virgin Mary, of all the saints, and to the name and memory of Saint N. Peace be to you.

units.la: Et ad singulas duodecim cruces, in parietibus ebrifmatas: Sanctificetur & consecretur in nomine Patris. &c.
units.tr: And at each of the twelve crosses anointed on the walls: Let it be sanctified and consecrated in the name of the Father. etc.

units.la: Benedictio incensi, super altare cremandi: Dignare respicere, benedicere, & sanctificare hanc creaturam incensi, ut omnes languores, omnesque infirmitates, cunctaque insidiæ inimici, odorem ejus sentientes, effugiant & separentur a plasmate tuo.
units.tr: Blessing of the incense to be burned upon the altar: Deign to regard, bless, and sanctify this creature of incense, so that all languors, all infirmities, and all the snares of the enemy, perceiving its odour, may flee and be cut off from your creature.

units.la: Collecta ad Altare: Altare maneat perpetuum, ut, quicquid deinceps super illud oblatum consecratumve fuerit, dignum tibi fiat holocaustum, atque omnium hic offerentium sacrificia, a te, pio Domino, benigne suscipiantur, & per ea, vincula peccatorum nostrorum absolvantur, maculæ deleantur, veniæ impetrentur, gratiæ acquirantur, quatenus una cum sanctis & electis tuis vitam percipere merceantur æternam.
units.tr: Collect at the Altar: Let this altar remain perpetual, so that whatever is afterwards offered and consecrated upon it may become a worthy holocaust to you, and that the sacrifices of all who offer here may be graciously received by you, O kind Lord, and through them the bonds of our sins may be loosed, our stains wiped away, pardon obtained, grace acquired, so that together with your saints and elect we may deserve to receive eternal life.

units.la: Et: Omnipotens Deus, hoc altare, spiritu- alibus sacrificiis deputandum, praesenti benedictione sanctificare, & oblationibus, à tuis famulis, devotionis studio impositis, benedicere, & spirituali hoc placatus incenso, feper promte preces eorum exaudire digneris, &c.
units.tr: And: Almighty God, deign to sanctify this altar, set apart for spiritual sacrifices, by your present blessing, and to bless the offerings placed upon it by your servants with the zeal of devotion; and, being appeased by this spiritual incense, always to hear their prayers promptly. etc.

units.la: Iterum: Domine Jesu Christe, super hanc Altaris tabulam, corporis tui ministrandam hostiam benedicas, & consecratam suscipias, &c.
units.tr: Again: Lord Jesus Christ, bless upon this altar-table the victim of your body to be administered, and receive it when consecrated. etc.

units.la: Ornamentorum Templi & Altaris benedictio:
units.tr: Blessing of the Ornaments of the Church and Altar:

units.la: Quia olim voluit Dominus multa ornamenta & vasa esse in tabernaculo, &c.
units.tr: Since the Lord once willed that there be many ornaments and vessels in the tabernacle, etc.

units.la: CONSECRATIO ORNAMENTORUM Altaris.
units.tr: CONSECRATION OF THE ORNAMENTS OF THE ALTAR.

units.la: Patina, ad conficiendum in ea corpus Christi.
units.tr: Paten, to be used for consecrating the body of Christ in it.

units.la: Corporalia, ad tegendum involvendum corpus & sanguinem Christi.
units.tr: Corporals, to cover and wrap the body and blood of Christ.

units.la: Calices, in usum divini ministerii.
units.tr: Chalices, for use in the divine ministry.

units.la: Linteamina: ut divinis cultibus apta esse,
units.tr: Linens, that they may be fit for divine worship,

units.la: fiant.
units.tr: be made.

units.la: Stola: ut ministri altaris, qui ea induuntur, septiformi Spiritus sancti gratia replean-tur.
units.tr: Stole, so that the ministers of the altar who put them on may be filled with the sevenfold grace of the Holy Spirit.

units.la: Eucharistialis seu vasculi, quo Christi corpus includitur, ut virtute Spiritus sancti novum fiat Christi sepulchrum.
units.tr: Pyx, or little vessel in which the body of Christ is enclosed, so that by the power of the Holy Spirit it may become a new sepulchre of Christ.

units.la: Crucis: ut sit inimicis Christi obstaculum, & credentibus in ipsum perpetuum victo-riæ vexillum. Cum precatiunculâ, post-quam aquæ aspersio & incensum adhibita fuerint, ut orantes inclinantésve ad illam crucem, corporis & animæ sanitatem inveniant.
units.tr: Cross: so that it may be an obstacle to the enemies of Christ, and a perpetual banner of victory to those who believe in him. With a short prayer, after sprinkling with water and incense have been applied, so that those who pray and bow before that cross may find health of body and soul.

units.la: Thuribuli, ut, quod offertur in eo, sit fuga dæmonum, phantasmatum repulsio, cogitationum immundarum excussio, ficq; nos efficiamur Christo boni odoris templum.
units.tr: Censer, so that what is offered in it may be a flight of demons, a repelling of phantoms, a shaking off of unclean thoughts, and that we may thus be made a temple of good odour to Christ.

units.la: Thymiamatis, ut sit contra diaboli incursiones munimen firmum.
units.tr: Of incense: so that it may be a firm defence against the assaults of the devil.

units.la: Capsarum, in quibus sanctorum ossa reponuntur.
units.tr: Of caskets, in which the bones of saints are laid up.

units.la: Patenæ & Calicis consecratio.
units.tr: Consecration of the Paten and Chalice.

units.la: Per nostram benedictionem, hoc vasculum & patena sanctificentur, corporis ac sanguinis Domini nostri Jesu Christi novum sepulchrum, sancti spiritus gratia efficiantur.
units.tr: By our blessing, let this little vessel and paten be sanctified, and by the grace of the Holy Spirit be made a new sepulchre of the body and blood of our Lord Jesus Christ.

units.la: Vestimentorum Sacerdotalium.
units.tr: Of the Priestly Vestments.

units.la: Hæc consecrare digneris, ut divinis cultibus & sacris mysteriis apta & benedicta existant, hisque sacris vestibus Pontifices, Sacerdotes seu Levitæ tui indutí, ab omnibus impulsionibus seu tentationibus malorum spirituum muniti & defensi esse mereantur.
units.tr: Deign to consecrate these, so that they may be fit and blessed for divine worship and the sacred mysteries, and that your Pontiffs, Priests, or Levites, clothed in these sacred vestments, may deserve to be guarded and defended from all the onslaughts and temptations of evil spirits.

units.la: Item: Omnibus hac veste utentibus gratiam sanctificationis sacri mysterii tui benignus concede, ut in cospectu tuo sancti & immacumaculati atque irreprehensibiles appareant, & auxilium misericordiæ tuæ acquirant.
units.tr: Likewise: Graciously grant to all who use this vestment the grace of sanctification of your sacred mystery, so that they may appear holy, unspotted, and blameless in your sight, and obtain the help of your mercy.

units.la: Crucis, & imaginum ac idolorum aliorum.
units.tr: Of the cross, and of images and other idols.

units.la: Ligni crucis: Rogamus te, sempiterne Deus, ut digneris benedicere hoc lignum crucis, ut omnibus hic genu flectentibus, ac tuæ majestati supplicantib", cordis compunctio, & admissorum concedatur remissio.
units.tr: Of the wood of the cross: We beseech you, eternal God, to deign to bless this wood of the cross, so that to all who kneel here and supplicate your majesty, contrition of heart and remission of sins may be granted.

units.la: Item: Sanctificetur illud lignum crucis, ut orantes inclinantesque se, propter Deum, ante istam crucem inveniant corporis & animæ sanitatem.
units.tr: Likewise: Let this wood of the cross be sanctified, so that those who pray and bow before this cross, for God's sake, may find health of body and soul.

units.la: Et: Digneris benedicere hoc lignum crucis, ut fit remedium salutare generi humano, fit soliditas fidei, bonorum operum profectus, & redemtio animarum, sit solamen & tutela contra sæva jacula inimicorum.
units.tr: And: Deign to bless this wood of the cross, that it may be a saving remedy for the human race, a firmness of faith, an advance in good works, and the redemption of souls, and a solace and protection against the cruel darts of enemies.

units.la: Imaginis Mariæ virginis:
units.tr: The Image of the Virgin Mary:

units.la: Sanctifica, Deus, hanc formulam beatæ virginis, ut tuis fidelibus salutaris auxilii opem ferat, tonitrua aut fulmina, si invaluerint, nocentia celerius expellantur, pluviarum quoque inundatio, aut civilium bellorum commotio, seu paganorum devastatio, ad præsentiam ejus comprimantur.
units.tr: Sanctify, O God, this image of the blessed Virgin, so that it may bring saving help to your faithful; and if thunderings or lightnings have grown strong, may they be driven away more quickly and do no harm; and may the flood of rains, or the uproar of civil wars, or the devastation by pagans, be checked at her presence.

units.la: Item: Hanc imaginem, in honorem piissimæ genitricis filii Dei, Domini nostri Jesu Christi, venerabiliter adaptatam, ita benedicere dicere & sanctificare digneris, ut, quicunq; eandem misericordiæ reginam & gratiosissimam Dominam nostram coram hac effigie supplicitèr honorare studuerit, & de instantibus periculis eruatur, & in conspectu divinæ majestatis tuæ de commissis & omissis veniam impetret, atque mereatur gratiam in præsenti, quam desiderat adipisci, & in futuro perpetuam salvationem cum Electis tuis valeat gratulari.
units.tr: Likewise: Deign to bless, speak over, and sanctify this image, reverently fitted to the honour of the most pious Mother of the Son of God, our Lord Jesus Christ, so that whoever has zealously sought to honour devoutly, before this likeness, the Queen of mercy and our most gracious Lady, may be rescued from impending dangers, may obtain pardon before the sight of your divine majesty for the sins committed and omitted, and may deserve to obtain in the present the grace he desires, and in the future to rejoice in everlasting salvation with your Elect.

units.la: Johannis Evangelistæ: Præsta, ut omnes, illam cum reverentia intuentes, precesque coram illa fundentes, pro quacunque necessitate oraverint, exaudiantur. Sit hæc imago dæmonum sancta expulsio, Angelorum advocatio, fidelium protectio, ejusque in hoc loco potenter vigeat intercessio.&c.
units.tr: Of John the Evangelist: Grant that all who look upon it with reverence, and pour out prayers before it, may be heard in whatever need they have prayed. Let this image be a holy expulsion of demons, a summoning of angels, a protection of the faithful; and let its intercession flourish mightily in this place. &c.

units.la: Aliorum Sanctorum: Hanc, quæsumus, imaginē seu sculpturam, in honorem ac memoriam Beati N. Apostoli tui, vel Martyris, vel Confessoris, aut Pontificis, aut Virginis, adaptatam benedicere ac sanctificare digneris, ac præsta, utquicúq; coram illa ipsum gloriosissimum Apostolum tuum, vel martyrem, vel confessorem, vel virginem supplicitèr honorare studuerit, illius precibus ac obtentu à te gratiam in præsenti, & æternam gloriam obtineat in futuro.
units.tr: Of other Saints: We beseech you to deign to bless and sanctify this image or carving, fitted to the honour and memory of your blessed Apostle N., or Martyr, or Confessor, or Bishop, or Virgin; and grant that whoever has zealously sought to honour devoutly, before it, that most glorious Apostle, martyr, confessor, or virgin, may by their prayers and intercession obtain from you grace in the present and eternal glory in the future.

units.la: Anchoranum,
units.tr: For the Anchorage,

units.la: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus, majestatem tem tuam fupplicesexoramus, ut anchonam hanc, in qua gloriosissimæ imagines tuę & fi- lii tui Domini nostri Jesu Christi, gloriofæq; virginis Mariæ, aliorumque sanctorum N. depictæ sunt, benedicere & sanctificare digneris, antequam quicunq; ob devotionem fe ad ipsam devote adorandam inclina- verint, salutem mentis & corporis conse- quantur, & à cunctis periculis liberentur, & quicquid juste petierint, obtinere mereatur.
units.tr: Almighty and everlasting God, we humbly beseech your majesty to deign to bless and sanctify this altarpiece, on which the most glorious images of you and of your Son our Lord Jesus Christ, of the glorious Virgin Mary, and of other saints N. are painted; so that, before whoever inclines himself to devoutly adore it out of devotion, they may obtain health of mind and body, be freed from all dangers, and deserve to obtain whatever they have justly asked.

units.la: Incensi. Dignare respicere, benedicere, & sanctificare hanc creaturarum incensi,ut omnes languores, omnesque infirmitates, cunctæq; insidiæ inimici, odore ipsius fenti- entes, fugiant & separentur à plasmate tuo, quod filii tui pretioso sanguine redemisti,ut nunquam læsdatur à morsu serpentis antiqui, per Dominum. &c.
units.tr: Of incense. Deign to look upon, bless, and sanctify this creature of incense, so that all weakness, all infirmities, and all the snares of the enemy, perceiving its odour, may flee and be separated from your creature, which your Son redeemed with his precious blood, so that it may never be harmed by the bite of the ancient serpent, through the Lord. &c.

units.la: Item: Deus, mitte in hanc creaturam incensi & thymiatis, odoris tui virtutem, ut fit fervis tuis incrementum tutelaq; defensionis, nec intret hostis in viscera eorum, nec habitum ibi vel sedem possit habere.
units.tr: Likewise: O God, send into this creature of incense and frankincense the virtue of your fragrance, so that it may be an increase and protection of defence for your servants, and that the enemy may not enter into their inward parts, nor be able to have a dwelling or seat there.

units.la: Et: Benedicere dignare, ut ubicunq; fumus aromatum ejus adfuerit, in virtute tui nominis sancti, omnis spirituum immundorum incursus effugare, atque in odorem fragrantiffimum, tibi Domino, perpetua suavitate redolere possit.
units.tr: And: Deign to bless it, so that wherever the smoke of its aromatics has come, in the power of your holy name, every onslaught of unclean spirits may be put to flight, and it may be able to exhale to you, Lord, in a most fragrant odour, with everlasting sweetness.

units.la: Item: Tua immensæ majestatis dextera hanç hanc creaturam incensi benedicere, & sanctificare digneris, ut in virtute sancti nominis tui omnes immundorum Spirituum phantasticos incursus effugare, omnesq; morbos, reddita sanitate, expellere, ubicunq; fumus ejus afflaverit, mirabiliter possit, atq; tibi omnipotenti Deo odore fragrantissimo perpetua suavitate redolere.
units.tr: Likewise: May your right hand of immense majesty deign to bless and sanctify this creature of incense, so that in the power of your holy name it may wonderfully be able to put to flight all phantasmal onslaughts of unclean spirits, and to drive out all diseases, restoring health, wherever its smoke has breathed upon, and to exhale to you, almighty God, with a most fragrant odour and everlasting sweetness.

units.la: Aqua benedicta seu lustralis confectio, seu consecratio.
units.tr: Holy water, or the preparation and consecration of lustral water.

units.la: Salis exorcismus: Exorcizo te, creatura salis, per Deum † vivum, per Deum † verum, per Deum † sanctum, per Deum, qui te per Helisaeum Prophetam in aquam misi jussit, ut sanaretur sterilitas aquae, ut efficiaris sal exorcizatum in salutem credentium, ut sis omnibus te sumentibus sanitas animae & corporis, & effugiat atq; discedat ab eo loco, quo aspersum fueris, omnis phantasia vel nequitia & versutia diabolicae fraudis, omnisque spiritus immundus adjuratus, per eum, qui venturus est judicare vivos & mortuos, & seculum per ignem.
units.tr: Exorcism of the salt: I exorcise you, creature of salt, by the living † God, by the true † God, by the holy † God, by God, who commanded you to be cast into water by the prophet Elisha, so that the barrenness of the water might be healed; that you may become salt exorcised for the salvation of believers, that you may be health of soul and body to all who take you, and that every phantasm, or wickedness, and every cunning of diabolical fraud may flee and depart from the place where you have been sprinkled, and every unclean spirit be put under oath by him who shall come to judge the living and the dead, and the world by fire.

units.la: Oratio: Immensam clementiam tuam, omnipotens aeterne Deus, humiliter implora-mus, ut hanc creaturam salis, quam in usum humani generis tribuisti, bene † dicere ac sanctificare tua pietate digneris, ut sit omnibus sumentibus salus mentis & corporis, & & quicquid ex eo tactum vel aspersum fue-rit, careat omni immunditia, omniq; impu-gnatione spiritualis nequitiæ, per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum &c.
units.tr: Prayer: We humbly implore your immense mercy, almighty eternal God, that you would deign by your goodness to bless † and sanctify this creature of salt, which you have bestowed for the use of mankind, so that it may be health of mind and body to all who partake of it, and whatever has been touched or sprinkled with it may be free from all uncleanness and from every assault of spiritual wickedness, through our Lord Jesus Christ, &c.

units.la: Aqua exorcismus: Exorcizo te, creatura aquæ, in nomine †Dei patris omnipotentis, & in nomine †Jesu Christi filii ejusdem, Domini nostri, & in virtute Spirit. sancti, ut fias aqua exorcizata, ad effugandam omnem potestatem inimici, & ipsum inimicum eradicare & explantare valeas, cum Angelis suis apostaticis, per virtutem ejusdem Domini nostri Jesu Christi, qui venturus est judicare vivos & mortuos, & seculum per ignem.
units.tr: Exorcism of the water: I exorcise you, creature of water, in the name of † God the Father almighty, and in the name of † Jesus Christ his Son, our Lord, and in the power of the Holy Spirit, that you may become exorcised water, to drive away all the power of the enemy, and that you may be able to root out and uproot the enemy himself, with his apostate angels, through the power of the same our Lord Jesus Christ, who shall come to judge the living and the dead, and the world by fire.

units.la: Oratio: Deus, qui ad salutem humani generis, maxima quæque sacramenta in aqua-rum substantiâ condidisti, adesto propitius invocationibus nostris, & elemento huic, multimodis purificationibus præparato, virtutem tuæ benedictionis infunde, ut creatura tua mysteriis tuis serviens, ad abjiciendos dæmones, morbosque pellendos, divinæ gratiæ sumat effectum, ut quicquid in domibus, vel in locis fidelium hæc unda resperserit, careat omni immunditiâ, liberetur à noxa, non illic resideat spiritus pestilens, nor aura corrumpens: discedât omnes insidiæ lacentis inimici, & si quid est, quod aut incolumitati
units.tr: Prayer: O God, who for the salvation of the human race have established the greatest sacraments in the substance of waters, be propitious to our invocations, and pour the power of your blessing into this element, prepared by many purifications, so that your creature, serving your mysteries, may take on the effect of divine grace for driving out demons and banishing diseases. Whatever this water sprinkles in houses or in the places of the faithful, let it be free from all uncleanness and from harm; let no pestilent spirit dwell there, nor corrupting air. Let all the snares of the lurking enemy depart, and whatever envies the health of the inhabitants or their peace, let it flee at the sprinkling of this water, so that the wholesomeness, secured through the invocation of your holy name, may be defended against every assault, through the Lord, etc.

units.la: lumitati habitantium invidet, aut quieti, aspersione hujus aquæ effugiat, ut salubritas per invocationem sanctitui nominis expedita, ab omnibus sit impugnationibus defensa, per Dominum. &c.
units.tr: ...of the inhabitants or their peace, let it flee at the sprinkling of this water, so that the wholesomeness, secured through the invocation of your holy name, may be defended against every assault, through the Lord, etc.

units.la: II. MIXTIO SALIS ET aquæ benedictæ.
units.tr: II. THE MIXING OF SALT AND HOLY WATER.

units.la: Hæc commixtio fit in nomine patris & filii & Spiritus † sancti.
units.tr: This mixing is made in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy † Spirit.

units.la: Oratio: Deus invictæ virtutis autor, & insuperabilis imperii Rex, ac semper magnificus triumphator, qui adversæ dominationis vires reprimis, qui inimici rugientis saevitiam superas, qui hostiles nequitias potenter expugnas, te Domine trementes & supplices deprecamur ac petimus, ut hanc creaturam salis & aquæ dignanter aspicias, benignus illustres, pietatis tuæ more sanctifices, ut ubicunque fuerit aspersa, per invocationem sancti tui nominis, omnis infestatio immundi spiritus abjiciatur, terrorque venenosi serpentis procul pellatur, & præsentia sancti spiritus nobis misericordiam tuam poscentibus, ubique adesse dignetur.
units.tr: Prayer: O God, author of invincible power, King of unconquerable dominion and ever magnificent triumpher, who restrain the strength of hostile rule, who overcome the savagery of the roaring enemy, who powerfully overthrow hostile wickedness: we beseech and ask you, Lord, trembling and suppliant, that you would deign to look graciously upon this creature of salt and water, and sanctify it, illuminating it with the kindness of your loving-kindness, so that wherever it is sprinkled, through the invocation of your holy name, every assault of the unclean spirit may be cast out, and the terror of the venomous serpent be driven far away; and that the presence of the Holy Spirit may deign to be everywhere present to us who ask for your mercy.

units.la: III. ASPERSIO AQUÆ BENEDICTÆ.
units.tr: III. THE SPRINKLING OF HOLY WATER.
